Kagrama fatgo kavukva'ma hanana zamo'a Hankavenentake Anumzamofo avurera amne zankna nehanigeno, knare kavukva'ma hnana zamo'a, Anumzamofona aza osugahie.
Hagi kagrama Anumzamofo agorga nemaninka, mono'ma hunentanana amanahu knazana atregeno kazeri havizana nehuno keaga huganteresino?
I'o kagra rama'a kumi hunka nevankeno kumikamo'a hihi huno mareri'nea agafare Anumzamo'a keaga hunegante.
Hagi roneka'amo'za kagripinti'ma zagoma nofi hunaku'ma hazagenka, zagoni'ma eme nenamita ete erisaze nehunka kukena'zamia erintanke'za zamavufaga zamavapako vu'naze.
Ana nehunka tinku'ma nehaza vahera tina nozaminka, zamagaku'ma nehaza vahera ne'zana ozami'nane.
Kagrama kagesa antahi'nana, hankave vahe'mo'zage'za mopa eri nafa'a nehazage'za, mopama eriga vahe'mo'zage enerize hunka kagesa nentahine.
Kento a'nanemo'zama zamazama hananegu'ma kagrite'ma ne-azana zamatranke'za amne nevazagenka, megusa mofavre nagazmia zamazeri haviza nehane.
E'ina hu'negu menina hazenke zamo'a kukomo hiaza huno, maka asoparega kazeri kagigenka mani'nankeno antri hanaza huno koro'zamo'a kagrite ne-e.
E'ina agafare hanizamo'a kavua rehani higenka nonkankeno, ti hageno refiteaza huno knazamo'a, kagrira rufitenegante.
Hianagi menina Jopuga antahio, Anumzana rankrerfa hu'nea Anumzankino amunagamuma me'nea hanafitamina zamagatereno amenagame monafi nemanie.
Hianagi kagra amanage hunka nehane, nagrama nehua navu'nava zana inankna huno Anumzamo'a keno antahino nehie? Agra haninentake hampompi mani'neankino inankna huno tage amara huno nerageno, refkora huno tagegahie?
Tapa hampomo Anumzamofo avurera anteso higeno norage. Ana nehigeno agra monamofona agatereno onaga'a vano nehuno norage.
Hanki Jopuga antahio, ko'ma kumi vahe'mo'zama hu'naza zamavu'zmava nehunka zamage ante'za nehampi?
Nozamima azeri oti'zama ki'naza tra'ma timo hageno erino viankna huno ana kumi'ma nehaza vahera tavava ozafa ore'ne'za kasefa vahe mani'neza frigahaze.
Anage nehu'za Hankavenentake Anumzamo'a na'a hurantegahie. Tatarenka vuo hu'za nehaze.
Anage nehazanagi e'i ana Anumzamoke nozamifina knare'nare fenozana eri antevi tezmante'ne. E'ina hu'negu kefo zamavu'zamava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'zama nentahi'za antahintahia nagra ovaririgahue.
Kefo avu'ava zama nehaza vahe'ma Anumzamo'ma zamazeri havizama hige'zama, fatgo avu'ava'zama nehaza vahe'mo'za nezamage'za muse nehaze. Ana nehanage'za ke'zami omne vahe'mo'zama nezamage'za zamagiza regahaze.
Ana nehu'za, anage hugahaze, ha' vahetimofona tamagerfa hu'za zamazeri haviza nehazageno, tevemo fenozamia tefanane hie hu'za hugahaze.
Hagi Jopuga menina Anumzamofonte kagraka'a anteraminka nemaninka, kasunku hunka Agrane kea eri fatgo nehunka krimpa fru hunka manio. E'inama hanankeno'a, nomani zanka'afina maka zamo'a knare hugahie.
Amama kavumaro'ma antekema kasamuana antahiso'e nehunka, kagu'afi erintegeno meno.
Hanki kagrama ete rukrahe hunka Hankavenentake Anumzamofonte'ma esnankeno'a, maka knazanka'a eri netreno ete nomani'zanka'a eri so'e hugantegahie. E'ina hu'negu menina nomanizankafima kefo kavukva zama me'neniana eri atro.
Ana nehunka goligu'ma kavesikavesi'ma nehana zana netrenka, knare zantfama hu'nea golima Ofiri mopafinti'ma eri'nana golia atregeno havemoke'ma hu'nea tinkagomupi vino.
Ana nehunka atregeno Hankavenentake Anumzamo goli ka'agnara huno nemanino, knare zantfama hu'nea silvagnara huno manino.
Anama hanigenka kagra Hankavenentake Anumzamofona tusi muse hunentenka, kesga hunka Anumzamofona antahimigahane.
Kagra Anumzamofontega nunamuna hanankeno, nunamunka'a antahi kamigahie. Ana nehanigenka kagrama huvempama hu'nana keka'a amage antegahane.
Kagrama nazano hunaku'ma kagesama nentahinka anazama tro'ma hnana zamo'a knare zanke nehanigeno, kama vanana kampina tavi'mo remsa huganteno vugahie.
Hanki mago'a vahe'mo'zama knafima mani'nesnagenka kagrama hunka, zamaza huo hunkama hanankeno'a, Anumzamo'a zamagu'vazigahie.
Kumi'ma nehaza vahe'enena Anumzamo'a zamagu vazigahie. Na'ankure kagrama Anumzamofo avure'ma agruma hunka mani'nana zanku huno zamagura vazigahie.
Hanki Jopu'a amanage huno kenona hu'ne.
Nagrira menina mani'zanimo'a amuho nehige'na keha regahuanki'na, rentarako hune'na karagira orugahue.
Anumzamo'ma mani'nea kuma'ma nagrama ke'noresina, Agrama mani'nea kumapi menina vusine.
Anama hute'na kegagani'a Agri avure eri'na vute'na, nazama huno keagani'ma refko huno antahinogura kehara ome husine.
Anama hute'na keaganire'ma nonama huno keagama nasamisnia nanekea antahi ama' huresine.
Anumzamo'a Agra tusi'a hankave'areti hara renanteno, nazeri havizana hugahifi? I'o anara osu nagri nanekerera agesa ante'neno antahi so'e hisine.
Hagi nagrama fatgo vahe'ma mani'nenugeno refko huno nenageno, Agrama hazenkea omane'ne hanige'na mani vava hu'na vusine.
Zage hanati kaziga hake'na vuanagi onke'noe. Zage fre kaziga hake'na vuanagi Anumzamofona onke'noe.
Noti kaziga hake'na vu'noanagi, Anumzamo'a fraki'nege'na onke'noe. Sauti kaziga hake'na vu'noanagi navumo'a onketfa hu'ne.
Hianagi nagrama kama vanoma huana, nageno antahino hu'ne. Ana hu'neankino renaheno'ma kesanige'na, tevefima golima krazageno avusesema hiaza hugahue.
Na'ankure maka zupa nagra Anumzamofo kante nagia rente'na vano nehu'na, Agri avu'ava'za amage nente'na, ru kantera vugantigma nosue.
Anumzamofo kasegea namefira huomi'na amage ante'noe. Ana nehu'na ne'zama hiaza hu'na naneke'a erintogeno nagu'afi me'ne.
Hianagi Agrake Anumzana mani'neankino nazano hunaku'ma haniazana amne hanigeno, mago vahe'mo'a retro'ma hania antahintahi'a eri otregahie.
Ana hu'neankino nazano nagrite'ma tro hugahue huno antahintahima hu'nesniazana amne hugahie. Na'ankure nagri'ma hunantesiazana rama'a zantami retro hunte'neankino, Agrake keno antahino hu'ne.
Ana hu'neanki'na menina Agri avurera tusi nahirahi nerege'na, Agri hankavegu'ma nagesama nentahi'na tusi koro nehue.
Anumzamo'a maka hankaveni'a eri netreno, Hankavenentake Anumzamo'a Agra nazeri koro nagesa hu'ne.
Hanizamo eme nazeri kagige'na hanizampi havizantfa hu'na mani'noanagi, kea tagane'na omanigahue.
Nahigeno Hanavenentake Anumzamo'a keagama refko hukna huhampri onte'nesniane? Ana hu'nege'za Agri'ma amage'manentaza vahe'mo'za ana knama kesagura amnefina avega ante'za mani'nazageno amne zanknara nehie?
Kefo avu'ava'zama nehaza vahe'mo'za havige hu'za vahe mopa hanarenakura, kanagi kana eri kasi ogantu'a nente'za, sipisipi afutamina musufase'za zamagra afu kevufi eri havia nehaze.
Megusa mofavreramina rezmatga hu'za donki afuzamia nevre'za, nofi'ma hu'nazana vahe'mo'za eme neramita erisaze nehu'za, kento a'nemokizmi bulimakao afura avre'za nevaze.
Ana nehu'za zamunte omane vahera kama nevazafintira amanefi zamaretufe netraze. Ana hazage'za zamunte omne ana vahe'mokizmi zamagoro hu'za ome fra'nekize.
Ka'ma kokampi afi donki afu'mo hiaza hu'za, zamunte omane vahe'mo'za makazupa ne'zankura hakevava nehu'za, mofavre'zamimofoma zamisaza ne'zanku'enena nehakaze.
Vahe hozafinti ne'zana ome nehamre'za, havi avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmi waini hozafinti waini raga neragi'za, mago'ama atre'nazama'a ome tagi vagare'naze.
Hagi zamavufagarera kukena omnege'za zasiku nehu'za kenagera mase'za vano nehu'za, mago'zana erigonofize.
Agonaregati'ma runo eanko'mo eme zamahe nefarige'za, noma manisaza zanku huge'za havegampi mani'za vano nehaze.
Kento a'nemokizmi zamasumpinti megusa mofavre nagara, eme zamavaresga hu'za nevu'za, nofi'ma hu'nazana ome paneseta ete ome zamavareta eho nehaze.
Hagi zamunte omne kukena zamavatera omnenege'za zamavapako vano nehu'za, vu'za hozafintira vahe ne'zana ome hamare'za eri nezamizanagi, zamagra'a zamagaku nehaze.
Zamagra olivimofo raga'ane, wainimofo raga'a regatiti hu'za tima'a e'nerizanagi, magore hu'za tima'a ne'za onkazageno zmanankemo'a tusiza huno hagage nehie.
Frinaku'ma karagi'ma neraza vahe'mokizmi zamageru'mo ran kumapintira ome ra hu'ne. Ana nehazage'za zamahe kuzafa'ma ante'naza vahe'mo'za zamazama hanaza vaheku zavira netaze. Hianagi Anumzamo'a zavi'ma netazazana antahizamino rukrahera huno nozamage.
Kefo zamavu zamava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za masazamofona ha'renente'za, masazamofo kante'ma vu'zankura zamavesra nehige'za afete nemanize.
Nanterama zahufama masama osu'negeno'a, vahe'ma zamahe fri vahe'mo'za oti'za vu'za zamunte omne vahe'ene keonke zanku'ma atupa'ma nehaza vahera ome zamahe nefri'za, musufa vahekna hu'za kenagera vano nehu'za ke'onke'zana musufa nesaze.
Vere a'nanema zamazeri savari'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za avega ante'nazageno, zagemo'a tami nefarege'za amanage nehaze. Tavugosarera refite'nesnunke'za vahe'mo'za oragegahaze nehu'za, tavaravereti zamavugosarera ana'nekize.
Kumazafa vahe'mo'za kenage vano nehu'za, vahe'mokizmi nona anafe hu'za kumazafa nesaze. Ana nehu'za ferura zamavu nemase'za, masama hiama'a ke'za antahi'za nosaze.
Kenage'ma hanima kintrakoma hiana e'i zamagritera nantera nese. Ana nehige'za kenage'ma amanovazi'zama fore'ma huno vahe'ma zamazeri koro'ma nehia zana ke'za antahi'za hu'nazanki'za korora nosaze.
Hianagi timofo agremo'ma ame huno vagareaza hu'za fanane nehaze. Maka zama zamagrama ante'naza zamo'a kazusifi mesnige'za, zamagra'a ante'naza waini hozafinagi novaze.
Zagemo'ma aisima te ze'zema higeno kekokako'ma hu'nea mopafima ufreankna hu'za kumi'ma nehaza vahera fri vahe kuma'mo zamazeri nakrinige'za frigahaze.
Ana hina kasema zamante'naza vahera anta'zmimo'za antahi ozamigahaze. Ana nehanageno zamavufagamo'a haganentake hanige'za kanintamimo'za nenesage'za, vahe'mo'za mago'enena antahi ozamigahaze. Kumi'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za zahoko tuno zafa eri hantagiankna hu'za tami'za masegahaze.
Kumi'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za mofavrema kase onte'naza naravo a'nea rezmatga hu'za keonke'zazmia eneri'za, kento a'nenenema zamazama hu'zankura zamavesra nehaze.
Hianagi zago vahe'ma mani'za vahe'mo'za ra zamagima e'neri'za vahera Anumzamo'a Agra'a hankave'areti zamazeri netre. Ana vahe'mo'za maka zampina knare hu'za vugahazanagi, henka'a ome haviza hugahaze.
Anumzamo'a zamatrenigeno mago zamo'a hazenkea ozamisnige'za, knare hu'za manigahaze. Hianagi Anumzamo'a maka'zama hazazampina avua anteno nezamage.
Hagi zamagra atupa knafi ra zamagia eri'za mani so'e hute'za, ruga'a vahe'ma fri'za nevazaza hu'za frigahaze. Ana hugahazankino witi ragamo'ma afu re'nege'zama kazinteti rukafari zankna hu'za frigahaze.
Nagrama havigema nehanugeno'a, iza nagrikura huno havige nehane hunora nazeri kori'sigeno, nagri nanekemo'a amne zanknara hugahie?
Hagi anante Suha mopareti ne' Bildati'a amanage huno Jopuna kenona hunte'ne,
Anumzamo'a hankavenentake hu'neanki'za maka vahe'mo'za Agrikuke korora hugahaze. Ana hu'neankino maka zama monafima me'nea zantamina Agrake kegava hu'nege'za Agri avesi amage ante'za, mani fru hu'za nemanize.
Iza amuhara hu'nesnia vahe'mo monafima mani'naza sondia vahe'a hamparigara hu'ne? Hagi ama mopafintira ina vahe'moka hunka nagritera Agri masamo'a remsa hunonante hunka hugahane?
Inankna huno mopafi vahe'mo'a Anumzamofo avurera fatgoa huno nemanino, agrua huno manigahie?
Ikamo'ene hanafimo'za remsa hutfa hu'nazanagi, Anumzamofo avurera ana masamo'a rumsa osu'ne.
Tagra mopafi vahe'mota kaninkna huta hagirafagna hu'none.
Hagi anante Bildati'ma hia nanekerera Jopu'a amanage huno kenona hunte'ne,
Inankna hunka hankavezamima omne'nea vahera zamaza nehunka, zamagra'ama zamaza osuga vahera zamagura vazi'nane.
Kagra inankna hunka knare antahi'zama omne'nea vahe'mofona antahintahia neminka, oku'ma me'nea knare antahi'zanka'a erinte ama hane?
Ama ana knare antahintahi zanka'a igati eri'nane? Ana hu'nankeno iza avamu'mo kagri kagipina huvazino ama'na nanekea huamara nehie?
Fri'naza vahe'mokizmi hankro'ma hagerimofo agu'afima nemaniza naga'mo'za Anumzamofonkura tusi koro nehazageno zamahirahi nere.
Fri vahe kumapima nemaniza vahe'mo'za Anumzamofo avurera frara oki amate mani'naze. Vahe'ma zamazeri havizama nehia kumapima me'nea zantamima Anumzamo'ma kenaku'ma hiana, mago zamo'a avurera anteso osu amate me'negeno nege.
Hanki noti kaziga me'nea mona anami kankamumpi tro huntegeno me'negeno, Anumzamo'a anami kankamumpi tro huntegeno mago'zamo'a azeoriaza me'ne.
Hanintirima huno antarakoma hu'nea hampompi Anumzamo'a ko tina eri ano vazintegeno me'ne. Hianagi knagura huno ana timo'a rufuragu vazinora evunoramie.
Ana nehuno hamponteti kini tra'a erirefitegeta nonkone.
Hagerimofo agofetura Anumzamo'a mago avame'zanteti isagana ante'ne. Ana hu'neankino ana isagamo hanine masanena refko hunezanante.
Anumzamo'ma monamofoma azeri konerigeno'a, monama tro huno regarinte'nea tra'mo'a torevare nehie.
Anumzamo'a hankave'areti higeno avunemanentea hagerimo'a, ome rurava nehe. Agra knare antahi'zanteti, hagerimofo agu'afima Rehapu'e nehazageno'ma nemania afi'zaga rehapanetie.
Anumzamo'ma asimu'ma antegeno'a, anamima me'nea monamo'a rumsa hutfaza nehie. Ana nehuno hagerimpima mani'neno vanoma nehia osifavea Agra azanuti ahe fri'ne.
Ama ana maka zama fore'ma hiana, Anumzamo'a hankave'areti tro'ma hu'nea zamofona, amne agema'a fore higeta kone. Hagi Agra menina sumi ke huno kea nehigeta nentahunanki, monagefinti'ma rankema huno'ma keagama hanigeta, inankna huta tagra antahi amara hugahune?
Jopu'a mago'ene keaga'a amanage huno hu'ne,
tamagerfa huanki kasefa'ma huno mani'nea Hankavenentake Anumzamo'a, kankamuna onamino knare avu'avara hunonanteno, natrege'na tusi natazampi manue.
Menima kasefa'ma hu'na mani'ne'nama nasimu'ma nentoana, Anumzamo nasimura namige'na mani'noe.
Nagra havige nanekea nosu'na, havigea hu'na vahera revatga osugahue.
Hagi tamagrama nehaza nanekegura, tamage nehaze hu'na osugahue. Ana nehu'na kefo avu'ava zana osu'na, mani fatgo hu'na mani'nena frigahue.
Nagra fatgo navu'nava'ma nehua zana kegava hu'ne'na, ana avamenteke mani'na vugahue. Nagrama kasefa'ma hu'na mani'na vanuanknafina, kumi hu'noe hu'na antahintahi hakarea osugahue.
Nagri'ma ha'ma renenantaza vahera, kefo avu'ava'zama nehaza vahe'ma Anumzamo'ma zamazeri havizama nehiaza huno zamazeri haviza nehuno, nagri'ma zamefi hunenamiza vahera, kumi'ma nehaza vahe'ma zamazeri havizama nehiaza huno zamazeri haviza hugahie.
Hagi Anumzamofoma amage'ma nontaza vahera, amuha zazamia omanegahie. Ana hanigeno Anumzamo'a ana vahera zamahe fananehu vagaregahie.
Ana vahe'mofo avate'ma knazamo'ma esanigeno zavi'ma atesniana, Anumzamo'a antahi omigahifi?
E'i ana Hankavenentake Anumzamofona musena hunonte'za, Anumzamofontega nunamuna osugahaze.
Nagra menima rempima huramisuana, mago'zana eri frara okigahuanki, Anumzamofo hankave'a erinte ama hu'na tamasamigahue.
Ana hankave'a tamagra'a ko ke'naze. Hianagi na'a higeta amunte omane nanekea hantageta eri hakarea nehaze?
Kefo avu'ava'zama nehu'za, vahe'ma zamazeri havizama nehaza vahera, Hankavenentake Anumzamo'a miza zamia huhampri zamante'neanki'za erigahaze.
Ana rama'a mofavrea antegahazanagi, ana mofavre naga'zmia hapi zamahege, zamagaku hu'za frige hugahaze.
Hagi mago'ama ofri'ma manisaza vahera, ruzahu ruzahu krimo zamahe frisnige'za, kento a'nane nagazmimo'za ana vahekura zamasunkura hu'za zavira otegahaze.
Kefo zamavu'zamava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za rama'a zago eri atru nehu'za, kukenanena rama'a eri tru hanageno hihi huno marerigahianagi,
fatgo zamavu'zmava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za ana kukena eri nehankresnage'za, ke'zami omne vahe'mo'za ana vahe'mokizmi zagoa refko hu'za erigahaze.
Kefo zamavu'zmava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'zama noma kisazana, pamponkemofo nomo'ma hiaza huno hankave'a omane no negi'za, mani'ne'za hozama kvama hanazana tona no kizankna hu'za nona kigahaze.
Kumi'ma nehaza vahe'mo'zama nozamifima masazana zago vahekna hu'za nemasaze. Hianagi mase'nafinti'ma oti'zama kazana, maka fenozamimo'a igafi freno omnetfa nehie.
Timo'ma hageno eaza huno, hazenke zamo'a eno eme zamavareno fregahie.
Zage fre kazigati zaho'mo eme zamazeri komenkame huno zamavaresga huno fresnige'za, ko'ma mani'naza nonkumatera omanigahaze.
Ana zahomo'a ana vahekura asunkura huozmanteno zamazeri haviza hanige'za, ana zahomofo hankavegu koro nehu'za zamagare'za fregahaze.
Hianagi maka vahe'mo'zama ana zama fore haniaza nege'za, zamaza rupro nehu'za tusi zamagiza regahaze.
Vahe'mo'za mopafinti silva kafi'za e'neri'za, golia tevefi kre'za erigru hu'za e'nerize.
Ainia mopafinti kafi'za eneri'za, have krefrage'za kopa e'nerize.
Mopa agu'ama golima me'nea havegu'ma nehakaza vahe'mo'za ofenkame hanintirima hu'neama'afi tavi tagizageno remasa hu'nege'za, tavi masare ana haveramina hake'za e'nerize.
Ana vahe'mo'za mopa agu'afina vahe'ma ovu'are keria kafi'za ufrete'za, ana kerifina nofite urami'za ihimareaza hu'za vute ete nehu'za eri'zana e'nerize.
Hagi mopamofo agofetura vahe'mo'za hoza eri'za nentaze. Hianagi mopamofo agu'afina goligu'ma nehakraza, tusi teve hanavazi'za haveramina kre nefragazageno tevemo'a tusi amuho huno mopa temara'mra nehie.
Anampinti'ma e'nerizana zago'amo'ma marerisa havema safaema nehaza have e'neri'za, golima me'nea mopanena kafi'za e'nerize.
Goligu'ma nehakraza vahe'mo'zama ana kerifima unefraza kana oku'a me'nege'za, namamo'zane tumpamo'zanena zamavua onke'naze.
Ana nehazage'za zamavufaga rama nehaza afi zaga kfamo'za anankerifina zamagia rente'za vano nosazage'za, laioni mo'zanena anankerifina zamagaka renontaze.
Goli eri'zama e'neriza vahe'mo'za kazinkazima hu'nea haveramina ru frage mafrage hunetre'za, agona kafi'za eri ankrinesaze.
Ana vahe'mo'za haveramimpina kafi'za ufre'za, zago'amo'ma marerisa haveramina ke'za e'nerize.
Anama nehu'za ana vahe'mo'za mopa kafi'za tima agafama huno'ma ne-eama'a renkaninere'za marerisa zantamima oku'ama fraki'nea zana erinte ama' nehaze.
Hianagi vahe'mo'za knare antahi'zana igati ome e'neri'za, ama' antahi'zana igati ome e'nerize?
Mago vahe'mo'e huno knare antahi'zane, ama' antahi'zama eri kumara keno antahinora osu'ne. Na'ankure ama mopafima nemaniza vahe amu'nompina knare antahi'zane, ama' antahi'zana onketfa hugahane.
Ra hagerimo'a huno, nagranena omani'ne nehanigeno, amefenkame mopa agu'afima me'nea tirumo'enena huno nagranena omani'ne huno hugahie
Knare antahi'zane, ama' antahi'zamofo mizama'amo'a rugatere'neankita, golireti'ene silvaretira miza osugahune.
Ofiri mopafinti'ma eri'naza golimofo mizama'ane, zago'amo'ma marerisa haverarena, Oniksine Safaema nehaza havemofo mizama'a agatere'ne.
Knare antahi'zamo'a golimofo mizane kritoraisie nehaza havemofo mizama'a agatere'ne. Ana hu'neankino goliretike'ma tro'ma hu'nesnia zanteti'enena, knare antahi'zana miza osegahie.
Hagi hagerimpima kororiema nehaza zama me'nea zanteti'ene, zago'amo'ma marerisa havema Jaspema nehaza haveretira miza osegahane. E'ina hu'neankino knare antahi'zamo'a periema nehaza zamofo mizanena agatere'ne.
Hagi zago'amo'ma marerisa havema topasiema nehaza havema Itiopia mopareti'ma eri'naza havemofona, knare antahi'zamo'a agatere'ne. E'ina hu'neankino knare antahi'zamo'a hentofaza huno agruma hu'nea golia agatere'ne.
E'ina hu'neankita, knare antahi'zamo'a igati ne-e? Hagi ama' antahi'zana inantega me'nesnigeta kegahune?
Mika zagamofo avurera knare antahi'zamo'a frakino me'neankino, knare avurgama hunte'negenoma anamifima hareno vanoma nehania namamo'enena onkegahie.
Fri vahe kumamo'ene vahe'ma zamazeri havizama hu kumamokea huke, knare antahi'zama hakeno ke kumara me'ne hazageta zaho kea antahino'e.
Knare antahi'zama eri kana Anumzamo Agrake keno antahino hu'ne. Ana hu'neankinka igati knare antahi'zana erighane. Anumzamo agrake antahi'ne.
Na'ankure maka zama ama mopamofo agofetu'ma me'nea zantamina Anumzamo'a keharu huno negeno, monamofo fenka kazigama me'nea zantamina nege.
Anumzamo'a zaho'mofona zaho'ma erisnia hankave'a avamente refko huno nemino, hampompima me'neno ko'ma arania zana tina, avamente refko huno Anumzamo'a ante'ne.
Ko'ene kopsi'nanena e'ikante megaha'e huno Anumzamo'a kasege retro hunte'negene ana kante amage nenta'e.
Hagi ana'ma huteno'a Anumzamo'a knare antahi'zama rezagane so'e huno keno erinte fatgo nehuno, knare huno me'ne huno nehie.
Ana nehuno Anumzamo'a amanage huno vahe'motagura hu'ne, Ra Anumzamofoma koro'ma huntezana, knare antahi'zana megeno, havi avu'ava zamofoma amefi'ma humisnanana, ama' antahi'zana erigahane hu'ne.
Jopu'a mago'ene keaga'a amanage huno hu'ne,
Ko'ma evia kafuramimpine ikampinema Anumzamo'ma knare huno kegavama hunantege'nama mani'na e'noaza hu'na, manisuegu antahintahia nehue.
Anumzamo agra nasenirera tavira remsa hunentege'na, mago zankura nagesa ontahi knare hu'na vu'noe.
Hagi ko'ma maka zamo'ma knare'ma higenama mani'noa knafina, nagrite'ene naga'ni'arera Anumzamo'a taragoteno knare aroneni'a mani'nege'na ke'noe.
Hankavenentake Anumzamo'ma nagranema taragotenoma mani'nea knafina, mofavre naganimo'za nagri tava'onte mani'naze.
Ana nehazage'na bulimakao afu zaga'nifintira ami rina rama'a nerati'na, olivi hozanifintira rama'a olivi raga tagite'na, masavena reratina rama'a erugeno viteno tima eviaza hu'ne.
Hagi korapara nagra ugota kva vahe mani'ne'na, rankumamofo kafante'ma keagama refkohu knazupa, zamagima me'nea vahe'mo'zama trate'ma unemanizage'na nagranena tra'nire umani'noe.
Kasefa vahe'ma nagrama neoge'zama nenage'za, mani kantugma nehu'za kankamuna nami'naze. Ana nehazage'za ozafanafa naga'mo'za, antahinenami'za oti'ne'za nenagazage'na vu'noe.
Kva vahe'mo'zama keagama nehazaretira nagrama neoge'zama nenage'za, kea osu mani'ne'za zamazanteti zamagitera rehamunki'naze.
Ran kumate'ma ugagota hu'za kegavama hu'naza kva vahera, zamagefunamo'a marerino zmavagunafare akamrege'za kea osu zamagira hamunki'za mani'naze.
Hagi nagrama keagama nehuge'zama antahi'za vahe'mo'za hu muse hunenantage'za, keagama nehuge'za nagaza vahe'mo'zanena knare keaga hunami'naze.
Na'ankure zamunte omane vahe'ene megusa mofavre naga'mo'zama, taza huo hu'za kema hazage'na, nagra zamaza hu'noe.
Amuha zazamima omanea vahera zamaza nehuge'za, nagrira husga hunante'naze. Ana nehu'na kento a'nanea zamaza nehuge'za tusi muse hu'naze.
Maka zama hu'noana fatgo kazigatike hu'noe. Ana nehugeno fatgo navu'nava zamo'a za'za kukenama antaninogeno'ma hiaza huno rufitenante'ne. Hagi fatgoma huno refkohu avu'ava'zamo'a, pristi vahe'mo'zama nentani'za kankrikna huno nasenirera me'ne.
Zamavuma asuhu'nea vahera kana zamaveri nehu'na, zamagiama haviza hu'nea vahera zamaza huge'za kana vu'naze.
Zamunte omane vahe'mokizmia nafa zamigna nehu'na, ke'na antahi'nama osu'noa vahe'ma keagafima otizage'na, zamaza hu'na keaga eri ante fatgo hu'noe.
Anumzamofoma amage onte vahe'mo'zama vahe'ma zamazeri havizama hazage'na, ana vahera zamagemazampa ru tavegri'na, zamagipintira eri vari'noe.
Nagrama antahuana, tamagerfa hu'na ama mopafina zazate musenkasea hu'na mani'na vute'na ome ozafa re'na frigahue hu'na nagesa antahi'noe.
Hagi zafamofo rafu'namo ofenkame uramino mopa agu'afinti ti anivazu higeno ani'namo tretre hiaza nehigeno atako'mo aninare runteankna hige'na nagra korapara mani'noane.
Nagri'ma ko'ma knare nagima nami'naza zamo'a nagripina amne kasefa huno me'ne. Ana nehige'na maka zupa kasefa hankavea erivava hu'na nevue.
Nagrama antahintahima vahe'mokizmima nezamuge'za, maka vahe'mo'za akohe'za mani'neza, nagri nanekea antahi'naze.
Hagi nagrama keagama huvagama retogeno'a, mago'mo'e huno nagri kerera antemino keaga osu'ne. Na'ankure nagrama hua nanekea antahiso'e hu'nagu anara hu'naze.
Vahe'mo'za komaranigu'ma avegama ante'nazageno koma rige'zama musema nehazankna hu'za, nagri nanekema antahi'zankura tusiza huno zamavesi'ne. Ana hige'za za'za knama ko'ma oru'nereti'ma ko'ma rigeno'ma maka zamofo ani'namo'ma muse nehuno ani'na eri mareankna hu'za nagri nanekea muse hu'za eri'naze.
Hagi vahe'mo'zama antahintahi hakarema nehu'za mani'nazage'na, kiza renezami'na knare navugosa huzami'noe. E'inama hua kazigati zamarimpa zamazeri hankaveti'noe.
Nagra kva vahezmi mani'ne'na, e'ina hiho, amana hiho hu'na vahera zamazeri ante fatgo nehu'na, mago kini ne'mo sondia vahe'amofo amu'nompi nemaniaza nehu'na, zavi'ma ataza vahera zamazeri tagane vahekna hu'noe.
Hianagi menina kasefa vahe'mo'za kiza zokago ke hunenante'za huhaviza hunante'naze. Ana kasefa vahe'mokizmi zamafahe'za nagri sipisipima kegavama nehaza kraramina zamagra kegava hugara osu'naze.
Hagi nagrama zamagoana hankave'zamia omane'neanki'za nagrira e'za eme naza hugara osu'naze. Na'ankure hankavezmimo'a hago zamagripintira vagare'ne.
Ana vahe'mokizmia zamunte omanege'za, zamagaku nehu'za atre'za vu'za vahe omani ka'ma kokampi umani'ne'za, kenagera ne'zankura hake'za vano hu'naze.
Ana nehu'za trazampintira aka tra'zana hu'za nene'za, brumu zafamofo rafu'na'anena eri tasagi hu'za ne'naze.
Ana vahera kumapintira zamahe kasopenetre'za, kumzufa vaheku'ma nehazaza hu'za kezatizmante'naze.
Ana'ma hazage'za vu'za, tinkagomupine muri kampine, have kampine umani'naze.
Anantegama umani'ne'za trazampi vano nehu'za, donki afu'mo'zama nehazaza hu'za ana trazampina eri tru hu'za mani'ne'za krafage hu'naze.
Hagi ana vahera zamagia omaneno neginagi vahe mani'nazanki'za zamahe kasopazage'za fre'naze.
Hagi ana vahe'mokizmi mofavre naga'mo'za, nagirevare zagamera nehu'za, huhaviza hunante'naze. Ana nehu'za nagrikura kiza zokago ke hunante'za, nazeri nagaze hu'naze.
Nagra zamagri zamavurera mago havi zaga manuge'za zamefi hunenami'za, nagritera erava'o nosu'za, navufi zamavetu ahenante'naze.
Ati karima reragareaza huno Anumzamo'a knaza namino nazeri ante ravahege'za, nazano hunante'naku'ma haza zana amne hu'naze.
Hazenke zama nehaza kasefa vahe'mo'za nazantmaga kazigatira oti'za, narotago hazage'na fre'na vano nehuge'za, kama vanufina krifu eme anaginte'naze.
Nagri'ma nazeri haviza nehu'za keonke'zama eri kazigati maka zana nehu'za, kama nevufina eme rehiza nehu'za, zamagrama antahi'zana agri'ma azahu vahera omani'ne hu'za nehaze.
Nagri'ma ha'ma hunantenaku'ma e'nazana vahe'mo'za, maka kazigati ankariserami'za e'za eme nazeri haviza hu'naze.
Ana hige'na menina tusi koro nehugeno, zaho'mo hampo erino viaza huno knare nagima e'neruazane fenozaninena erino vu'ne.
Hagi nagra menina hago fri'za nehugeno, natazamo'a maka zupa nazeri haviza nehie.
Kenagera zaferinanimo'a tusi nata negrigeno, ana natazamo'a naterenora novie.
Anumzamo'a hankavenentake azantetira kukenagna huno rufitenante'ne. Ana hu'neno azantetira za'za kukenama antaninoa kenamofo nananke kama'are azerino nanankena nazeri pro hu'za nehie.
Ana huteno hapapi matevuno natrege'na, kugusopagna nehu'na tanefakna hu'noe.
Ana hige'na naza hananegu Anumzamoka kagritega krafagea hu'noanagi, keni'arera nona osu'nane. Ana nehunka kagri kavure oti'noanagi, nagrira kamefi hunami'nane.
Kagra karimpa ahenenantenka, hankavenentake kazanteti nazeri haviza nehane.
Kagra kagigagi zaho atrankeno eno eme nazeri sga huno nefregenka, kagra ununko atrankeno eno eme nazeri haviza hu'ne.
Ana'ma nehanke'na nagrama antahuana, kagra nahe fritenka hunantesnanke'na maka vahe'mo'zama fri'za nevaza kumatega vugahue hu'na nagesa antahi'noe.
Hagi mago vahe'mo'ma knafima mani'neno'ma azahu zanku'ma krafama nehanigeno'a, tamagerfa huno mago'mo azana anteno aza hugahie.
Nagrama ko'ma knare hu'na mani'ne'na, knazampima mani'za vahekura zavira atenezmante'na, zamunte omane vahekura nagu'afina tusiza hu'na keke huzmante'noe.
Hianagi nagritera knare'za fore hanie hu'nama amuha'ma hu'noa zana forera osigeno, kefo zamo nagritera ne-egeno, tavi masagu'ma avegama ante'noana omegeno hanizamo e'ne.
Nagu'amo'a hazenkefi manino ne-eno mani frua osu'ne. Ana higeno maka zupa natazamo nazeri havizantfa hu'ne.
Nagrira knazamo rentrako higena hanizampi vano nehu'na, tavira onke'noe. Ana nehu'na kuma amu'nompima vahe'ma vano nehazafi mani'ne'na, iza naza hugahieha nehu'na zavira ate'noe.
Ana nehu'na zavi'matoa nagerumo'a, afi kramo'ene za'za agempunane namagu'ma ostritiema nehaza namamo'enema krafama neha'aza hu'ne.
Navufgamo'a ru ko'nagifa nehegeno, zaferinanifintira tusi amuho nehuno teve rukaru hu'ne.
Nagra hapue nehaza zavena nehe'na, nasunku zagamera nehu'na, konkena nere'na zavi zagamera hu'noe.
Hanki nagrama navuma kezani'afima mago huvempa kema hu'noana, mago mofa'ma negesuna havi antahintahia e'orisnue hu'na huvempa hu'noe.
E'inahu havi avu'ava'zama hanugeno'a, manisgama hu'nea Hankavenentake Anumzamo'a ana havi avu'ava zanirera havi mizana namigahie.
Havizama hu'za refkoma hu so'ema nosaza vahera Anumzamo'a knaza nezamino, kumi'ma haza vahetera hazenkeza atregeno ne-e.
Ana nehuno maka zama hua zampina Anumzamo'a avua anteno nenageno, nagama rerakaure'na vuana nenage.
Nagra mago vahera havigea hu'na revataga nosu'na, havige zantera nagia re'na ovu'noe.
Atrenkeno Anumzamo'a navu'navazania erinteno, fatgoma huno refko'ma nehia sigerire negeno refko huno nageno. Na'ankure nagrama fatgo navu'nava zama nehuana Agrake keno antahino hu'ne.
Hagi Anumzamofo kama atre'na hazama negre'na, navumo kea zante'ma havi antahintahima hu'na kumi'ma hu'nesnua kumiro, mago'a kumi'enema hu'nesnuana,
atrenkeno nagrama hankre'nesnua ne'zana, ru vahe'mo'za vasage'za neho. Hagi nagrama hankre'nesnua avimzana eri tasagi hutreho.
Hagi mago a'ma nege'na havi antahintahima eri'nesnuano, tvaonire'ma nemanisnia ne'mofo a'ma nege'na kenunuma hu'nesanuana,
atrenkeno nagri a'mo'a ru vemofo a' nemanina, ru venenemo'za a'ni'a ante'za maseho.
Hagi nagra mago vemofo a'enema hazenkema hu'nesanuana, nagra'a tusi nagaze eri nami'noanki'na, ana kumi'ma hu'nesua zantera mizama'a nagra'a erigahue.
E'i ana kumi'mo'a, mago tevegna hu'neankino, tevava huno nevuno, teve kumapi vugahie. Ana hu'neankino ana maka'zama ante'noa zana, tevemo te fanene hugahie.
Hagi ko'ma nagri eri'za venenemozane a'nemo'zanema, knazamima eri'za neazage'nama, knazazamima e'orinesnuana,
inankna hu'na Anumzamofo avurera nagra keagafina otigahue? Inankna hunka eri'za vaheka'a kegava hu'nane huno Anumzamo'ma nagenokama hanige'na, na'ane hu'na kenona huntegahue?
Na'ankure Anumzamo'a Agrake nagri'ene eri'za vahe'ni'anena, antatimofo arimpafina tro hurante'ne.
Hagi zamunte omane vahe'mo'zama mago'a zanku'ma kema nehazage'na, i'ora osu'na amne nezami'na, kento a'nanemo'zama zamazama hanuegu'ma nagrite'ma zamavuma nentazage'na amne zamaza nehu'na,
nagragukera ontahi'noanki megusa mofavreramina, ne'zana refko hu'na zami'noe.
Nagra osi'ma mani'noregati'ma eno meninte'ma e'neana, megusa mofavre nagara nafa zamigna hu'na kegava hunezmante'na, kento a'nane nagara zamaza hu'na e'noe.
Hagi nonkumazmima omne vahe'ma kukenagu'ma atupa'ma nehazage'na, kukena nezami'na, mago'a zanku'ma atupa'ma nehaza vahera kukenane nakreku'enena zami'noe.
Ana nehu'na zamazeri amuhoma hanigu sipisipi azokateti'ma trohu'naza nakre kura zamuge'za antani'za amuhogu'ma nehu'za musema nehu'za, nagrira husga hunante'naze.
Hagi keaga refkohu ne'mo'a, nagri kaziga antegahie nehu'na, nagra keagafina oti'na megusa mofavre naga'ma keagama huzmantesnuana,
nazamo'a nazo'nafinti rutasagi huramigahie.
Na'ankure nagrama koro'ma nehuana, Anumzamo'a knazana atreni'geno eme nazeri haviza hugahie hu'na nentahue. Hagi Anumzamo'ma hankaveareti'ma nazeri havizama nehaniana, nagrira amuhazani'a omane'ne.
Hagi nagra zagofina amuha zani'a nonte'na, golimo'a naza hugahie hu'na namentintia nosue.
Nagra'a nazapinti'ma erifore hu'na ante'noa zago fenokura navufga erisga nosu'na,
monare'ma me'neno nerea zagere'ene ikamo'ma knare zantfama huno remsama nehige'na monora huonte'na,
e'i ana zantera mago narimpa hu'na monora hunonte'na, nzantetira zanahe'na antakora osu'noe.
Hanki nagrama anama hu'nesanuana kumi hu'noankino, kema refko'ma hunantesnia nemo'a knaza namigahie. Na'ankure onagamu monafinkama nemania Anumzamofontera havige hu'na eri fraki'nogu anara hugahie.
Hagi ha' vahe'nimo'zama knazampima mani'nazage'na nezamage'na, nagra musena nehu'na zamagizana ore'noe.
Ana nehu'na magore hu'na zamazeri haviza hu nanekea hu'na kumira nosu'na, havizama hunante'nazarera nona osu'noe.
Hagi nagri nompima nemaniza eri'za vahe'nimo'za hu'za, maka eri'za vahe'a ne'zana nezamino magore huno zamatrege'za amnea novaza ne' mani'ne hu'za nagrikura nehaze.
Nagra ozamageno'a vahe'ma nonire'ma azage'na magore hu'na zamatroge'za megira omase'nazanki, kahana anagi hagaro nehu'na, zamavare nompi antoge'za maka zupa mase'naze.
Mago'a vahe'mo'zama nehazaza hu'na kumi'ni'a nagu'afina eri frakinaku hu'noanagi, anara osu'noe.
Hagi rama'a vahe'mo'zama nenage'za, kiza zokago kema hunenantesage'za, naga'nimo'zama eme nasami'zankura korera hu'na nompina omani'noe.
Hagi nagra nagesama antahuana, nagrama nehuankema mago vahe'mo'ma agesama anteno antahiresina knare hisine. Nagra nazanko avona ama antoanki atre'nenkeno Hankavenentake Anumzamo negeno kenona hunanteno. Hagi mago vahe'mo'ma nagri'ma keagama hunantenaku'ma hanuno'a avompi krenteno.
Anama hanige'na muse nehu'na ana avona nazo'nare erigofi'na vano nehu'na, kini fetori'ma hiaza hu'na nasenire antanigahue.
Ana nehu'na kini vahe'mofo mofavremo'ma hiaza hu'na, Anumzamofo avuga uoti'na nagra'ama maka navu'nava zama hu'nesanuana ome eri ama hu'na asamigahue.
Hagi mopa'nimo'ma haviza hu'nane huno'ma keagama hunantenigeno, hoza tinkamo'a tusi zavi'netenigeno,
mago vahe'mofo hozafinti ne'za musufa sege, ana hozamofo nefa ahe frige'ma hu'nesanuana,
anama eri nafa'ama hu'nesanua mopafina witimo'a ohesianki ave've trazamoke hageno marenerisanigeno, amne tra'zamo balimofo nona erino hageno marerigahie. Ama ana nanekema huvagareteno'a, Jopua kea osu'ne.
Jopuna 3'a rone'amo'za agri kere'ma ru'enema kenona hunte'zankura zamavaresra hu'naze. Na'ankure Jopu'ma agra'agu'ma huama huno, hazenkeni'a omane'neanki fatgo hu'na mani'noe huno'ma hu'nea zanku anara hu'naze.
Hianagi mago nehazave nera, Barakeli nemofokino agi'a Elihu'e. Ana hu'neankino agra Rami nagapinti nekino, Jopuna tusi arimpa ahente'ne. Na'ankure agrama agesama antahiana Anumzamo'a agri kumiku huno knazana nemianagi, nagafare Jopu'a huamara huno tamage hago kumi hu'nogeno Anumzamo'a knazana nenamie hunora nosie nehuno, Jopuna arimpa ahente'ne.
Ana nehuno Jopuna 3'a rone'a raminku'ene tusi arimpa ahezamante'ne. Na'ankure Jopu nanekere'ma kenona hunte so'ema nosu'za, Jopu'a hazenke hu'negeno Anumzamo'a knazana nemie hu'zama, hazenke'amofo agafama ke'za eri fore'ma osaza zanku anara hu'ne.
Elihu'a agra nehazave mani'negu huno kea osu mani'nege'za, Jopuna 3'a rone'amo'za zamagra ranra vaheki'za, Jopu'enena keaga vugote'za hu'naze.
Hianagi ana ranra naga'mo'zama Jopu nanekere'ma mago'enema kenona huontaza zankura, tusi arimpa ahe'ne.
Ana higeno Buzi kumateti ne' Barakeli nemofo Elihu'a amanage hu'ne, Nagra kasefa vahe manugeta tamagra ranra vahe mani'nazagu nagazegu nehu'na koro hu'na ke'nima huama huzankura ete azeri'noe.
Nagrama antahuana rama'a kafuma hu'naza vahe'mota knare antahi'zana huama hugahaze hu'noane. Na'ankure knare antahi'zamo'a e'inahu vahepinti ne-e.
Hianagi Anumzamo'a avamu'a huhu huvazigeno vahepina avamu'a mani'neankino, ana avamumo hige'za ama' antahi'zane vahera mani'naze.
Mago'a zupa ranra vahe'mo'za knare antahi'zana e'norizage'za, mago'a zupa kafuzmimo'ma rama'a hu'nea vahe'mo'za fatgo huno'ma refakohu avu'ava'zana antahi amara osu'naze.
E'ina hu'negu nagranena antahintahini'a Jopuga menina kasami'za huanki antahio.
Tamagrama keagama nehuta knare'nare antahintahima erinteta kema hugantugama hazankea, akohe'na mani'ne'na antahi'noe.
Nagra nagesama ante so'ema hune'na keagatamima antahufina, magomo'e huno Jopunkura havige hie hunora huama huonte'ne. Ana nehutma Jopu'ma hia nanekerera kenona huonte'naze.
Hagi tamagra amanage huta osiho, Jopuna agri knare antahi'zamo'a tagri antahi'zana agatereankino, agri kerera vahe'mo'a kenona huontesnianki, Anumzamoke kenona huntesie.
Jopu'a nagranena keaga osu'neanki tamagranenke keaga hu'ne. Hagi nagranema keagama hiresina, tamagrama kenonama huntazankna hu'na kenona huontosine.
Hagi tamagrira keagatamia omanegetma antahintahi hakare nehuta, Jopu'ma hia nanekerera kenona huonte'naze.
Hianagi tamagrama kenona osu, akoheta zazate'ma manizaza hu'na nagranena akohe'na manigahufi? I'o.
Nagranena antahintahini'a huama hu'na Jopuga kasamigahue.
Na'ankure rama'a naneke nagu'afina avite'neanki'na nagu'amo'ma huama huo huno'ma nazeri otisanige'na huama hugahue.
Hagi nagri nagu'afina mememofo avufgareti'ma tro'ma hu'naza tintafepima kasefa waini tima ante'nazageno'ma me'neno ruhavahavu huno rupro hunaku'ma hiaza nagu'amo'a hu'ne.
Hanki nagra menima kasaminaku'ma hanua nanekema kasamisnugeno'a narimpamo'a fru hugahie. Hagi menina nagu'afima avi'mate'nea nanekea hugaho hugahue.
Nagra mago vahe'mofo kazigagera antene'na agrikera azana nosu'na, mago vahera havigea hu'na husga huontegahue.
Hagi nagrama havigema nagiteti'ma hu'na vahe'ma husga hunte'zante'ma knare'ma hu'noresi'na, nagri'ma tro'ma hunante'nea Anumzamo'a nagrira nazeri fanane hiresine.
Hianagi menina Jopuga kagesa antenka mani'nenka nagrama maka nanekema hanuana antahio.
Nagra menina ete nagira reaka hu'na nanekea agafa hu'za hue.
Nagrama hanua nanekea fatgo nagu'areti hugahuanki'na, tamage naneke hugahue.
Anumzamofo Avamu'mo nagrira tro hunantegeno, Hankavenentake Anumzamo nasimura namige'na kasefara hu'na mani'noe.
Kagra Jopugama knare'ma hu'nesunka, nagrama keagama nehanugenka, kagra kazigatira antahintahia hutenka, nagri kerera kenona hunanto.
Kama antahio, kagrane nagranena Anumzamofo suza mani'no'ankino, nagri'enena higo mopa erino tro hunante'ne.
E'ina hu'negu nagrikura korora osuo. Na'ankure nagrama hanua nanekemo'a tusi knazana kamino kazeri korora osugahie.
Nagra nentahugenka maka nanekema hu'nampina hankavetinka kehara re'nane.
Kagra Jopuga hunka, nagra agru hugeno kumi'ni'ane hazenke'ni'anena omnegena ke'ni'a omne vahe mani'noe hunka hu'nane.
Hianagi Anumzamo'a ha' vahe'arema nehiaza hunenanteno, kefo zamavu'ava'zama nehaza vahe'ma zamazeri havizama nehiaza huno nazeri haviza nehie hunka hu'nane.
Hagi vahe'ma kinama hunezmantaza zafafi nagia erinteno Anumzamo'a kina hunante'neno, kama vanoma hufina avua anteno nenage hu'nane.
Hianagi Jopuga havige hu'nananki'na kaveri hugahue. Na'ankure maka ama mopafi vahera Anumzamo'a zamagatere'ne.
Ana hu'neanki kagra nagafare Anumzanena kehara renka, na'a higeno vahe'ma zamaza hinogu'ma kema nehazageno'a, kenona'a Anumzamo'a hunozmante hunka nehane.
Hianagi Anumzamo'a ruzahu ruzahu kampinti vahera keaga huneramianagi, Agri kea tagra keta antahita nosune.
Kenage'ma nompi masenonkeno, ava'nafine ava'nagna zampine Anumzamo'a nanekea eme nerasamie.
Hagi mago'a kenagera zmagesafi sumi huno koro kema zmasamiazamo, zamazeri korora nehie.
Anumzamo'ma e'inahu'ma nehiana, kefo avu'ava'zane avufgama erisgahu zane atreta tamagu'a rukrahe hiho huno anara nehie.
Hagi zamagra friza fri vahe kumatega ovanaze huno Anumzamo'a kegava hunezmante.
Hagi mago'a zupa zamagrama hu'naza kumite Anumzamo'a knazana zamige'za kri tafetera mase'nazageno, zaferina zamifintira zamata kri vava nehie.

Hanki ana ankeromo'ma ana vaheku'ma asunku'ma hunenteno'a amanage hiresine. Fri vahe kumapintira agu vazio. Na'ankure ana vahe'ma mizama seno ete zamavare kana ko ke'na erifore hu'noe.
Hagi ana ne'mofo avufgamo'a knare zantfa huno osi mofavre'mofo avufgamo'ma hiaza nehanigeno, ko'ma kasefa vahe'ma mani'negeno'ma avufgamo'ma knare'ma huno me'neaza hugahie.
Ana nehanigeno ana ne'mo'ma Anumzamofonte'ma nunamu hanigeno'a, Anumzamo'a muse huno nevre'nigeno agra Anumzamofo avufi negeno musena hugahie.
Ana'ma hanigeno'a ana nemo'a rone'amokizmia huama'ma huno zamasamisniana, nagra tamage kemofona eri rukrahe hu'na havige nehu'na kumi hu'noe. Hianagi Anumzamo'a nahe frigaragi kumini'a atrenanteno nahe ofri'ne.
Ana nehuno fri vahe kumapinti Anumzamo'a ete nagu'vazino navre'ne. Ana hu'negu hu'na menina ofri kasefa hu'na mani'nena masa negoe.
Tamagerfa huno maka zupa e'inahu avu'ava'zana Anumzamo'a vahe'mokizmia huzmanteneno, anahu avu'avara huno nevie.
Fri vahe kumapinti ete zamagu vazino zamavare'negu hu'za, ofri kasefa hu'za mani'ne'za asimu erino mani'zamofo masarera mani'za nevaze.
E'ina hu'negu mago'ene keaga kasamigahuanki Jopuga akohenka mani'nenka kagesa antenka antahi so'e huo.
Hianagi kagrama mago'a nanekema hunaku'ma hanunka, amne hananke'na antahigahue. Na'ankure nagri'ma nave'nesiana, vahe'mo'za kagri'ma ke'za antahi'zama hanazana ke'a omne'nea ne' mani'ne hu'za hanazegu nave'nesie.
Hianagi kagripima mago'a nanekema omane'nesiana, kagra akohenka mani'nenka, nagrama knare antahi'zama rempi hugamisuana antahio.
Hagi Elihu'a mago'ene amanage hu'ne,
Knare antahi'zama eri'nana ne'moka nagrama hanua nanekere kagesa antenka nentahinka, ama' antahi'zama eri'nana ne'moka nagrama hanua nanekea akohenka mani'nenka antahio.
Hagi ne'zama tagite erinteta haga'ama neta konaza huno, maka nanekema tagesamo'ma antahia nanekea, tagesamo'a rezagane so'e huno nentahie.
E'ina hu'negu inagemo fatgo huno knare hu'nefi tagra'a rezaganeta negeta, rempi huta antahisune.
Hagi Jopu'ma kema hifina anage hu'ne, nagrira ke'ni'a omane'neanagi, Anumzamo'a kema hu kankamuni'a eri atrege'na mago zana osu'noe huno hu'ne.
Nagrira mago hazenke'ni'a omanegeno keni'a omane'ne. Hianagi vahe'mo'za nagrikura havige ne' mani'ne hu'za nehaze. Nagrira kumini'a omane'neanagi natama namino nevia natazamo'a vagaoresnia avamente nevie.

Ana nehuno Jopu'a kumi'ma nehaza vahe'ene eri mago huno nemanino, kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'ene kna ahefrino nemanie.
Na'ankure Jopu'a huno, Anumzamofoma musema huntesnampintira mago zana e'origahane huno hu'ne.
E'ina hu'negu ama' antahi'zama eri'naza vahe'mota nagri naneke antahiho. Maka vahe'mo'zama antahi'nazana Anumzamo'a havi avu'avara nosia ne' mani'ne hu'za antahi'naze. Ana hu'neankino Hankavenentake Anumzamo'a mago hazenkea osugahie.
Vahe'mo'zama hu'naza avu'avate anteno rezaganeno negeno, mizana zamitere nehia Anumza mani'ne.
Tamagerfa huno Hankavenentake Anumzamo'a mago hazenke zana osugahie. Ana hu'neankino Hanavenentake Anumzamo'a fatgo huno refkoa hugahie.
Iza ama mopa tro huteno, kegava huo huno Anumzamofonkura hunte'ne?
Hagi Anumzamo'ma Agra'a avamu'ene, asimu'anema ete eriresina,
maka asimu'ma enerino kasefa'ma huno nemania zagamo'a fri vaganeregeno, maka vahe'mo'za fri'za ete mopasazaresine.

Anumzamo'a kini vahekura huno, mago zana huga vahera omani'naze nehuno, zamagima me'nea vahekura huno havi avu'avaza nehaza vahe mani'naze huno nehie.
Anumzamo maka vahera Agra'a tro huzmante'neankino, agi me'nea vahe'ene zago vahekukera nehuno, zamagi omne vahe'ene zamunte omne vahera zamage amne zanknara nosianki, Agri avurera mago avamenteke mani'naze.
Vahe'mo'za osi'a knafi ame hu'za nefrize. Kenage amu'nompi friza nevazageno, hankave vahera Anumzamo'a zamahe nefrie.
Na'ankure maka vahe'mo'zama haza zana Anumzamo'a negeno, maka avu'ava zama hazana nege.
Hanima nehia zamo'a Anumzamofo avua resoa osanigeno, maka kumira amate kegahie.
E'ina hu'negu tagra kna huhampri'neta ana knarera esanunkeno, Anumzamo'a refkoa huorantegahie.
Anumzamo'a mago hankave vahe'ma azeri havizama hunakura, vahera antahigeteno anara nosie. Ana'ma nehuno'a ana vahe nontera ruvahe azeri o'netie.

Hianagi ana zante'ma Anumzamo'ma nona huno havi avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'ma zamazeri havizama nosanigeno'a, iza huno Anumzamo'a havi avu'ava nehie? hunora hugahie. Hagi avugosama eri fra'ma nekisanigeno'a, mago vahe'mo'a keno eri forera osugahie. Hianagi Agrake mago'mago vahete'ene ama mopafima me'nea kumatamina kegava hu'ne.

Hagi izaga antahi'nankeno Jopu'a Anumzamofonkura huno, nagrama hu'noa kumi'mofo nona hunka nazeri haviza nehananki, mago'enena kumira osugahue hunora hu'ne?

Antahiho! Anumzana hankavenentake hu'neankino, ina ne'mo Agrama rempima hunezamiankna nera mani'ne?

Ana ko'mo'ma hampompinti'ma eramiana knare huno maka vahete runente.
