Anumzamo'a higeno Agrama mani'nea tavaontera kopsi'namo'a marave huno azeri kanegigeno, masa'amo'ma amefenkame'ma hagerimofo ro'are'ma uneramia zana ko.
E'inahu hankave'areti Anumzamo'a maka vahera kegava hunezmanteno, ne'zana rama'a zamige'za atupara nosaze.
Agra kevema hiaza huno kopasi'na azampi eri'neno, inantego ahetresuema huno hirega ahenetre.
Hagi Anumzamo'ma higeno monagema hiazamo'a, ununko atugahie huno hunerasamigeno, bulimakao afutamimo'za zamagranena anazanke hu'za nentahize.
Ama anazama fore'ma nehigeno'a nagu'amo'a antari nehigeno, tumo'nimo'a fakrofakro nehie.
Anumzamo'ma kema nehigeno agerumo'ma monagemo'ma nehiazama huno atineramiana tamagesa ante'netma antahi so'e hiho.
Ana monagemofo agasasa anami monafina atregeno vuno eno huvaga neregeno, kopasi'namofo masa'a atregeno mopamo'ma umetre eme atrema hu'nerega vuno eno nehie.
Hagi kopasi'nama erigetama ketonkeno anantera, Anumzamofona hankavenentake agerumo'a monagemo'ma hiaza higeta nentahune. Anumzamo'ma kema nehigeno'a, kopasi'namo'ma nehiaza huno masa'amo'a rumarave huno vuno eno nehie.
Anumzamofo agerumo'a monagemo'ma nehiaza hu'neankino, so'e zantfa huno knare hu'ne. Agra tusi'a hankave'areti, tagri antahi'zana agatereno ranra eri'zana e'neriankita, anazana tagra keta antahita osugahune.
Agra higeno ko'mopa komo'a moparera runentegeno, rankora huntegeno tusiza huno mopafina nerie
Ana'ma nehige'za maka vahe'mo'za eri'zana e'ori atre'za amne mani'ne'za, Agri hankave'a negaze.
Hagi ana knafina afi zagagafamo'za koro fre'za vu'za, fra'makiza nemaniza havegampino, kerigampi ome fra'nekize.
Hagi kagigagi zahomo'a agrama nemaniregati ne-egeno, ra zahomo'a zasi avareno ne-e.
Anumzamo'ma asimu'ma nentegeno'a tusi zasi nehigeno, tintamimo'a fonupareno kragenefe.
Anumzamo'a hampompina tina eri atru huno erivineteno, kopasi'na atregeno ana hampompina ruganani huno vuno eno nehie.
Anumzamo'a vuo huno'ma hunterega vuno hampomo'a ome eri tru hutere huno neme. E'ina hihoma huno huzmanteaza hu'za maka kaziga ama mopamofo agofetura vano nehaze.
Mago'a zupa Anumzamo'a vagaore avesizama'a zamaveri huge knazama zamige, hunaku kora atregeno nerie.
Jopuga kagesa ante'nenka ama nanekea antahio, Anumzamo'ma ruzahu ruzahu zantamima eri fore'ma nehia zantamina negenka antahintahia erio.
Anumzamo'a hakare zana kegava hu'neankino, kopsi'nama huntegeno hampompinti'ma ruganani huno'ma vuno eno'ma nehia zana kagra kenka antahinka nosampi?
Maka zama tro'ma hu'zana Anumzamo'a antahi ani' hu'neankino, hampoma ante agofetu agofetu huno antegeno anami kankamumpima me'nea zana kagra kenka antahinka nosampi?
Hagi sauti kazigati'ma zaho'ma ne-ea zahomo'a omegeno, anante maka zamo'a kazara osuno oti fatgo higeno'a, kamu'namo'a kukenaka'a pasunekie.
Anumzamo'a higeno bronsireti'ma tro'ma hu'naza kapoteti'ma masamo'ma rumarave nehiaza huno, amuho zamo'a hamponteti ome antegeno eneramie. Ana hu'neanki, kagra e'ina hu'zana hugara hu'nampi?
E'ina hu'negu tagra na'ane huta Anumzamofonkura hugahumpi rempi huramio. Tagripina mago antahi'zana omane'neankita, mago knare nanekea huta tagra'a tagura ovazigahune.
Nagrama mago nanekema hunaku'ma nehanugeno'a, mago'a Anumzamofona asami'nageno agesa ante'neno keagani'a antahi so'ea hugahifi? I'o anara osuno nagrira nazeri haviza hugahie.
Monafima me'nea hampoma zahomo'ma eri papama hutrenigeno, zagemo'ma tusiza huno amuhoma hanigeta, zagefina tavua onketfa hugahune.
E'ina avamente noti kazigati'ma tusi'a tavi'ma ne-ea tavimofo masa'amo'a goligna nehie. E'i Anumzankino avasase zama'amo azeri kaginte'negeno, hankavenentake masa zama'afi ne-e.
Hankavenentake Anumzamofona tusi'a hihamu'a me'neankita, Agri avatera erava'oa osugahune. Hianagi Agra fatgo huno refko nehia Anumza mani'neankino, tazeri havizana nosie.
Anama hiazamo hige'za vahe'mo'za Agrira koro hunentaze. Hagi ama' antahi'zane vahe mani'nonema hu'zama nehaza vahera antahi nozamie.
Hagi tusi'a kagigagi zaho erino efi Anumzamo'a mani'neno, Jopuna amanage huno kenona hunte'ne,
Jopuga kagrira knare antahi'zana omane'ne. Ana hu'neankinka Nagrama eri'zama erinaku'ma retro'ma hua zankura neginagi nanekea nehane.
Nagra menina kagenoka hu'za huanki, vene'ne antahi'za erinka oti hankavetio. Ana nehunka Nagri kere'ma kenonama hananku trotra huo.
Kagra iga mani'nankena ama mopamofona tra'a eri agafa hu'na trora hu'noe? Kagra e'i anazama antahi ama'ma hu'nesunka nasamio.
Ama mopamofo za'za'ane atupa'ane amu'noma'anema nofi'ma (measurement) avazu huno ke nofira iza tro hunte'ne? E'i ana zana kagra ko kenka antahinka hu'nampi?
Ama mopamo'ma agofetu'ma me'nea trara na'amo azeri hanavenetigeno, ome renage eme renage huntete'ma me'nea haveramina, ome regari eme regari hunte'ne?
Hagi kotu ofumo'za anazama nege'za magoka zamagira ante'za zagamera nehazage'za, ankero ramimo'zanena ranke hu'za kezati'za musenkasea hu'naze.
Hagerimo'ma ruvarehiramino mopafima ezankura ama anante megahane huno iza huntegeno me'ne?
Hagerimofona hamponteti Nagra kukenama hiaza hu'na eri ano vazinente'na, hagerina kumazu haninu eri anakinte'noe.
Ana nehu'na hagerimoka agaterenka ovunka, amare megahane nehu'na, hagerimo'ma ome atre eme atrema hu'nea ankina ankina, kafa erigi'na rentarako hunte'noe.
Ana nehu'na amanage hu'na asami'noe. Kavufgama erisgama nehana hagerimoka amare marenka eme netrenka, mago'enena agatarenka ovuo hu'na asami'noe.
Hagi Jopuga mago zupa masa huo hunka hankeno nanterana rumsa nehigenka, kotu masagura hunka remasa hunka marerio hunka hankeno anara hu'nefi?
Hagi kagra mago zupa huntankeno nanterama remasama hia masazamo'a, ama mopama ometre eme trema hu'nerega vuno eno huvaga nereno, havi avu'ava zama nehaza vahera zamazeri ama hige'za tavimofo korora hu'za fre'nazafi?
Zagema marerino rumasama higeno'a, kokamo'a ruzahe huno ama tfaza higeno, avonkrenankre tvaravemo'ma nehiaza huno avasese'amo'a so'e zantfa nehie.
Hagi zagema marerino remsama hige'za, kefo zamavu'zmava zama nehaza vahe'mo'zama hanimpima vano nehu'za, vahe'ma zamazeri havizama nehaza vahe'mo'za zamazana ruhantgi trege'za anara nosaze.
Kagra Jopuga hagerimpina uraminka hagerimo'ma agafa huno ne-ea kampuira ome negenka, hagerimo'ma amefenkame'ma urami'neama'a ome keme vunka kevaga re'nampi?
Fri vahe'mokizmi kuma kafaramima me'neama'a ko negenka, hanintirima hu'nea hanizamofo kafantamina ko ke'nampi?
Ama mopamo'ma ra huno vuno eno'ma hu'neana kagra kenka antahinka hu'nampi? Kagrama ana maka zantamima ko'ma antahi vagare'nesunka nasamio.
Masamo'ma mani'neno'ma ne-ea kumara kagra kenampi? Hanimo'ma nemania kumara iga me'ne?
Kagra kana ke'nana zanaveri hanankeke masamo'ene, hanimokea zanagrama nemani'a nonkumatega vuke eke hugahapi?
Kagra ko antahi'nane, na'ankure maka zana forera osu'negenka kagra ko fore hugota hu'nanankino, kafukamo'a rama'a hu'negahie!
Aisimo'ma aviteno me'neno eneramia nona ome negenka, ko'mopa ko'mo'ma aviteno me'neno eneramia nona ke'nano?
E'i ana zantamima retro huntogeno'ma me'neana, hazenke knama esanige'nama ha'ma hanuaza retro huntogeno me'ne.
Kopsinamo'ma ruganini huno vuno eno'ma nehia kana iga me'ne? Zage hanati kazigati zaho'ma erino vuno enoma nehia nonkuma'a iga me'ne?
Monafinti'ma avune ko'mo'ma herafi ramino'ma eneramia tinkana iza tro hunte'ne? Monamo'ma monagema huteno agasasama runo'ma vuno eno'ma hania kana iza varinte'ne?
Vahe'ma omani hagege ka'ma kokampina, iza kora atregeno runente?
Ana mopafina kora, zafane trazanena omanenegeno mago zana omanetfa hu'neane. Hianagi iza kora atregeno eno mopa eme rufru higeno, trazamo'a ete hageno marenerie?
Ko'mofona nafa'a mani'nefi? Iza ata komofona nafa'a mani'neno atregeno eneramie?
Aisimofona iza anta'a mani'ne? Hagi iza monafintira aisi atakora kase atregeno eneramie?
Zasi ko'matia knafina, tintamimo'a hankavetino havegna nehigeno, hagerimofo agofetu'ma aisima neramino'a azeri karagenefe.
Hagi Pleiadesie nehaza hanafitamima, monare'ma me'nea zana Jopuga seni nofitetira magopi anaki nezmantenka, Orioniema nehaza hnafitamima anaki zmante'nea nofira ahekanora hugahampi?
Ana nehunka kagra ana hanafitamina hananke'za, mago kafufina kna'zamire efore hutere nehanagenka, Beane mofavre naga'anema hu'za nehaza hanafitamina kagra kegava huzmantegahampi?
Monafima ruzahu ruzahu zantamima me'naza zamo'za amage'ma nentaza kasegea kagra antahi'nampi? Ana'ma hu'nesnunka kagra hananke'za ama mopafi maka zantamimo'zanena ana kasegea amage antegahazafi?
Kagra monafima me'nea hampona kezati misankeno, kora atrenigeno eramino kora kahegahifi?
Kopasi'nagu'ma hunka mago kaziga vuo hunka'ma huntesnankeno'ma nevuno'a, e'ina huoma hunka hunantana zana hugahue hunora hugahifi?
Iza knare antahi'zana, vahe agu'afina nenteno, ama' antahi'zana vahe'mofo antahi'zampina ante'ne?
Iza knare antahi'zampina avite'nesnimo maka hampontamina hamprigara hu'ne? Ana nehuno monafima me'negeno anampinti'ma ko'ma neria mopa kavoa eriragisigeno ko'mo'a herafiramigahie?
Anama higeno'a kugusopamo'a ome runtrako huno eme hanavetigeno, hihi huno magopi marenerie.
Zamagama netegenka Laioni anenta'a ramine, laioniraminena zagagafa ahezminke'za nenazafi?
Ana laioniramimo'za havegampine, kafoma ante'za nemaniza trazampinti etirami'za zamagra'a anara nosazafi?
Kotkotiema nehaza namaramimo'za ne'zanku'ma hake'za vano vanoma nehazageno, anenta'arimo'za ne'zama nesaza zanku'ma Anumzamo'naregama krafama nehazageno'a, iza ne'zana nezamie?
Hagi agonafima nemaniza afi meme afutamimo'za anenta'ma nentaza kna fatgoa kagra antahi'nampi? Kagra nezmaganke'za afi dia afu'mo'za anentara nentazafi?
Memene dia afumofo anentamo'zama nezmarera arimpafima nemaniza ikama'a antahi'nano? Nezamarera'ma kase zamantesnia kna kagra kenka antahinka hu'nampi?
Memene dia afumo'zama anenta'ma antenakura, zamaga renamagi'za mopare manine'za anentara antazageno zamatazamo'a amne nehie.
Ana hutazage'za ana anentatamimo'za ta'nopafi mani'ne'za nena hute'za, nezamarerana atre'zama nevu'za ete rukrahera hu'za nomaze.
Afi donki afu'ma rente'naza nofira iza katufegeno fru huno vano nehie?
Hagege huno tra'zama omane'nea ka'ma koka zamuge'za nemanizage'na, hagemoke'ma hu'nea mopa Nagra zamuge'za nonkuma zamia ante'za nemanize.
Ana donki afutamimo'za ran kumapima nemaniza vahe'mofo zamagasasankegura zamavaresra nehu'za, vahe'mo'zama zamazeri agazonema hunaku'ma kema nehazage'za, kezmia nontahize.
Ana donki afutamimo'za agonaramimpina vano nehu'za, tra'zama nesnagura hake'za vano nehaze.
Afi bulimakaomo'a fru huno mani'neno kagri eri'zana erigahifi? Ana nehuno hanima hanigeno'a bulimakao afu nompina emasegahifi?
Afi bulimakao afu'mofona kare namare zafare nofira rentetenka, hanankeno kamagera nevuno, hozafina mopa rekorino vugahifi?
Kagra ana bulimakao afu'mofo hankavegura antahineminka, atresnankeno amuhoma hu'nesia eri'zanka'a eri kantegahifi?
Kagra ana afi bulimakao afumofo hankavegu nentahinka atresnankeno, hozakafintira witia erino witi honama neharafina vugahifi?
Mananinkna za'za anankene namama Ostritsie nehaza namamo'a, muse nehuno agekona rutafra tafra nehie. Hianagi azokamo'a za'za aginkunane afi patomofo azoka knara osu'ne.
Ostriti namamo'za mopamofo agofetu amura antete'za zamatre'za vazageno mopamofo amuhomo zamazeri amuho hige'za nemanize.
Hagi vahe'mo'o, mago afi zagamo'o agiareti amu'ama rempoke zankura Ostritsimo'a agesa nontahie.
Zamagri'ma zamatama krige'zama kase zamante'naza zankura ontahi'za, ru namamo'ma kase zamante'nea anenta'ma hiaza hu'za kegavahu so'e nosaze.
Na'ankure Anumzamo'a knare antahi'zana nomino, antahi ama'ma hu'zana agripintira eri atre'negu huno anara nehie.
Hianagi ana Ostritsi namamo'ma otino agama nereana, tusi avune anteno agama nerea hosi afu'ene agumpima mani'nea vahera agatereno nevie.
Kagra Jopuga hosi afu'mofona hankavea neminka, anankempima me'nea azokara kagra hankeno fore huno me'nefi?
Kagra hosi afu'mofona hankavea aminkeno ranra kenumo'zama nehazaza huno takaunerefi? Hosi afu'mo'zama zamageru'ma nerazazamo'a vahera zamazeri koro nehie.
Ana hosi afu'mo'za zamagra'a hankavegu nentahi'za, haru hu'za mareri'za tami'za nehu'za zamagareti mopa rentrako nehu'za, hatera zamagare'za nevaze.
Hosi afumo'za korora hu'za antahintahi hakarea osu, bainati kazinteti'ma ha'ma nehazage'za hapintira atre'za korora nofraze.
Ana hosi afumo'za hapima nevazageno kevegumo'a vagare vagare nehigeno, karugaru kevereti'ene keveretira zagemofo masamo'a rumarave nehie.
Ha'ma agafa hunaku nehigeno, paziveteti'ma ufema regeno'a, hosi afumo'a haru huno marerino tamino nehuno manirava oheno, aga zanteti hankavetino mopa nemasagie. Ana nehuno agareno ha'pina unefre.
Paziveteti'ma ufema neraza krafagema hosimo'ma nentahino'a, oho huno nehuno ha'ma afete ne-egeno'a, ha'mofo mna nentahie. Ana nehuno hate'ma ugotama hu'naza sondia vahe'mokizmi zamagerura nentahino, sondia vahe'mo'zama ivigema hu'za aza zamagasasankea nentahie.
Jopuga kagri antahi'za amage anteno, tumpamo'a ageko'na rutarerino sauti kaziga enevifi?
Hagi kagra hankeno tumpamo'a haresga huno marerino vahe'mo'ma mareoriga'afina nona negifi?
Ana tumpamo'a have ra'nafi manino vano nehuno, kenagera anampinka nemase. Hagi nozamimo'a hankave kuma'zami me'neanki'za knare hu'za nemanize.
Ana kumate'ma manine'za, ahe'zama nenaza zaga afete mani'nazanagi, amne nezamagaze.
Hagi tumpamo'ma mago zagama aheteno'a, ana zaga erino eno anenta'amofona eme amigeno, korama'a anivazu huno nene. Frino kasri'nesia zagamofo avufgama me'nesirega, tumpamo'za ome atru nehanagenka zamagegahane.
Anante Ra Anumzamo'a amanage huno Jopuna asami'ne,
Kagra hankavenentake Anumzamofona keha' rentenka nevunka, Agrira azeri fatgo hunaku nehampi? Ana hugahue hunka hanananagi, Nagrama kagenokama hanugenka, Nagri kerera, kenona hugahampi?
Anante Jopu'a amanage huno kenona Ra Anumzamofona hunte'ne,
Nagra amne zaga mani'noanki, inankna hu'na kagri kerera kenona hugahue? Nagra nzanteti nagira ruhamunki'na manigahue.
Nagra ko rama'a nanekea hu'noanki'na, mago'enena keaga osugahue.
Hagi kagigagi zahomo'ene komo'ene huno efi Ra Anumzamo'a mani'neno, Jopuna amanage huno asami'ne,
Kagra vene'ne antahintahi erinka oti hankavetio. Na'ankure mago'a kagenoka hugahuanki, eri ama hunka kagra kenona hunanto.
Kagra hanavetinka keaga hunka, nagri navu'navamo'a knare hu'ne hunka nehane. Hianagi nagrira huhaviza nehunka, Jopuga kagra'agura mani fatgo hu'na mani'noe hunka nehane.
Kagri hankavemo'a Anumzamo'na hankavegna hu'nefi? Kagrama kageru'ma nerankeno'a, Anumzamo'nama nageru'ma nerugeno monagema hianknara huno, kagri kagerumo'a monagea nehifi?
Hagi kagra knare'ma hu'nesanunka, kukena hiaza hunka hihamu hanaveka'afi mani'nege'za, vahe'mo'za negage'za rankagi negami'za husga huganteho.
Kagra krimpa ahe'zana atregeno eama nehaningenka, zamavufaga rama nehaza vahera zamazeri fenkami atro.
Zamavufga rama nehaza vahera krimpa ahenezamantenka, uruha zamagege'za zamavufaga anteramiza maniho.
Ana nehunka ana vahera kugusopafi asene zamantenka, fri vahe kumapi kina huzmanto.
Jopuga anama hananke'na knare'za hane hu'na kagri kagia husga hugahue. Na'ankure kagrika'a hankavemo kaguvazigahie.
Hagi kagri'ma tro hu'noa zama hu'na hanavenentake tusizaga hipopotamosiema nehaza afi zaga tro huntogeno mani'neno bulimakao afu'mo'ma trazama nenea zama huno trazama neneana ko.
Ana zagamofo amagenafima me'neno hihamuma nemia ame'a negenka, amurugufima me'neno hankavema nemia ame'a ko.
Ana zagamofo risonamo'a sida zafamo'ma hiaza huno hankavenentake hu'ne. Hagi agia zampima me'nea ame'amo'a magopi eri tru hutere hu'neankino tusi hankaveti'ne.
Ana hipopotamosimofo zaferinamo'a bronsireti'ma tro'ma hu'naza paipugna higeno, agia zampi zaferinamo'a aini zafagna hu'ne.
Anumzamo'na mago'a zaga kfama tro'ma huzmante'nofintira hipopotamosimo'a maka ruzamagatere'ne. Ana hu'neankino tro'ma hunte'nesimoke, ahesnigeno frigahie.
Hagi agona ramimpima afi zaga kfamo'zama zokago'ma nerazafi, hipopotamosimo'ma nenea trazamo'a hageno marenerie.
Nerga asinagna traza lotusine, uha'enema tirupima nehaga'a trazamofo agafafi frakino nemase.
Tinkenare'ma hageno mareneria trazanku'ma lotusiema nehaza trazampi freno mase'negeno, tona'mo reso huntegeno nemanie.
Hagi tusi avunema anteno hageno ea tinkura korora nosuno, Jodani timo'enema hageno ankena regama varehiramino ea zanku'enena korora nosie.
Hagi avunteno mani'neno kvama hu'nesnia vahe'mo'a aze'origahie. Ana nehuno agonagampina nofitetira renteno avazu huno ovugahie.
Hagi agaza hunte tusizankna osifavema Leviataniema nehaza osifavekrerfa, hagerimpima nemaniana Jopuga hukuretira avazu nehunka, nofitetira agefu'narera anakigahampi?
Agonagampina nofira rentetenka, avazu hunka nevunka, ameragempina reraponentenka nofira rentegahampi?
Ana'ma hanankeno'a kasunku hunantenka natro hunora fru kea hugahifi?
Ana nehuno nagra mago narimpa huanki'na kagri eri'za vahe manine'na, kazokazo eri'za erigante vava hu'na vugahue hunora hugahifi?
Namama avrenka kegavama nehana zana hunka kegava nehunka, nofitera rentetenka ne'one mofaneka'a zaminanke'za zokagora rentegahazafi?
Hagi zago vahe'mo'za ana zagama mizasenakura, mizama'agura keha rete'za, ana zaga ahe'za akafari osi osi hu'za eri'za maketifina zagorera ome atregahazafi?
Hagi ana zaga, nozamema nehaza keveretira asenifine avufgafinena ahegresogreso hugahampi?
Hagi ana zagamofo avufgare'ma kazama antenka kesanunka, henka'anena anara osugahue hunka hugahane. Na'ankure ana'ma hanugeno'ma henka'ama ha'ma hunantesniana, havizantfa hugahie hunka kagesa antahigahane.
Hagi antahio, kagrama hunka ana zagama azerisanue hunka'ma kagesama nentahisanunka anara osuo. Na'ankure ana zagama azerisanuema huno hania vahera ana zagamo'a refaki hutregahie.
Mago vahe'mo'a ana leviatani'ema nehaza zaga azeri oraotigahie. Ana'ma haniana iza oti hankaveti'neno hara hunantegahie?
Iza mago zana nami'nesanigu hu'na, ete nona hu'na amigahue? Na'ankure ama mopafima maka zama me'nea zantamina, Nagri zanke me'ne.
Hagi leviataniema nehaza zagama hage rimpima nemania zagamofo hankavene, avufgane agia azankrefagura eri ama hu'na kasamigahue.
Ana zagamofo avufagare'ma me'nea irira iza eri kanope netreno, agofetu agofetu'ma huno'ma hankave avufgama me'neana iza reraponegahie?
Ana zagamofona ave krerfa hunte'neanki'za, vahe'mo'za koro nehaze. E'ina hu'neankino, iza ana zaga aheno agemzampa atavegrigahie?
Ana zagamofo amagenafina iri'amo'a, magopi rukamaretere huno evuevu hu'neankino hankavetino hankogna hu'ne.
Ana zagamofo iri'amo'a, magopi akamareno hantohanto hu'neankino, zahomo'ma ufrega kana omane'ne.
Mago mago irimo'a agu'afinka, mago irite rukamaretere huno azeri hankaveti'ne. Ana hu'neankino eri kanopeno eri rure'rurera hugara osu'ne.
Hagi ana zagamo'ma kasi'ma haniana, agonagampintira teve ruganani huno vuno eno nehigeno, avurgafintira nantera zagema marerino zagemo'ma remsama hiaza nehie.
Ana zagamofo agipintira teve ruganani huno vuno eno nehigeno, agipintira tevemo'a hagna hagna huno atineramie.
Ana nehigeno kavofima tima tagino, tevere kre'negeno krakra hiaza huno, agonagampintira amu'mo'a rugasu huno enevie.
Hagi agipinti'ma evia zahomo'a tanknu'zafima tevema nerea tevea hukru higeno rukaru nehigeno, teve nefamo'a agipintira hagna hagna huno nere.
Ana zagamofo anankempina tusi'a hankave me'neankino, inantego vanoma hiana, tusiza huno vahera zamazeri koro nehie.
Ana zagamofo avufgamo'ma marerino tamino'ma hu'nea ma'amo'a, magopi ruhampri ruhampri huno antrako huno hankaveti'neankino, eri pahesi rure rure'ma hu'amo'a amuho hu'ne.
Ana zagamofo tumo'amo'a havegna huno hanavetineankino, witima refuzafunepaza havegna hu'ne.
Ana zagamo'ma o'manetige'za hankave vahe'mo'za koro nehu'za, na'a hugahune hu'za kanku nehakaze.
Ana hu'neankino bainati kazintetiro, keveretiro, karugru keveretiro, osi have kazintetira mago vahe'mo'a ana zaga ahegara osu'ne.
Hagi ainireti'ma tro'ma hu'naza ha' zantamima ana zagamo'ma keana, trazankna huno keamne zankna nehuno, bronsireti'ma tro'ma hu'naza ha' zantamima keana, kasari'nea zafagna hu'ne.
Vahe'mo'za kevea ahe tresnageno mani'nesnirega vugahianagi, korora ofregahie. Gumi atifina havea erinte'za ahegahazanagi ana havemo'a hagege trazamo'ma avufgare'ma avako'ma hiankna hugahie.
Kumpa kanoma kesaniana, trazankna huno ke amnezaneseno, karugru kevema matrevuno atresigeno esania zamofo agasasama nentahino'a kiza regahie.
Ana zagamofo asagufima me'nea irimo'a, mopa kavomo'ma rupararo vazigeno asane'neankna hu'ne. Ana hu'neankino, mopafima regararo heno'ma nevigeno'a, mopa vazikekurino nevie.
Hagi hagerimpima nevigeno'a, kavofima tima afino tevefi kre'negeno timo'ma krakra hiaza huno, hagerimo'a krakra huteno masavemo'ma ze'ze'ma nehiaza nehie.
Ana zagamo'ma hagerimpima nevigeno'ma, amefi'ma timo'ma agrege'ma huno nevia zamo'a rumsa huno efeke hu'neankino, mago kavrinteaza nehie. Ana nehigeno ana zamo'a tavava ozafamofo efeke azoka kna huno efeke nehie.
Ama mopafina mago agrikna zaga omani'neankino, mago zagagura korora nosie.
Maka zagama mani'naza zagafina, agra zamagatereno avufga ra nehie. Ana hu'neankino maka afi zagama mani'nazana zamagatereno kini mani'ne.
Hagi anante Jopu'a amanage huno Ra Anumzamofona kenona hunte'ne,
Nagrama antahi'noana nazano hunaku'ma hanana zana amne nehanankeno, mago vahe'mo'a e'ina hu'zana osuo huno osugahie.
Kagra nantahigenka, iza antahintahi'a omane vahe'mo Nagri knare antahi'zankura nagenoka hu'ne hunkama hu'nanana? E'i ana vahera nagragi'na, ke'na antahi'na osugeno nagri antahi'zampinena omaneanagi, knare zantfama hu'nea zanku amne keaga hu'noe.
Anumzamoka hunka, Jopuga kagesa naminege'na keaga nehu'na, mago'a kagenoka hugahuanki kenirera nona hunanto hunka hu'nane.
Kora vahe'mo'za kagri kagenkea nehazage'na antahi'noe. Hianagi menina nagra'a navufinti kagoe.
Maka nanekema hu'noana ete erue. Ana nehu'na menina nasunku'ma huazana ama tanefapine kugusopafi mani'ne'na erinte ama hue.
Hagi Jopu'enema keagama Ra Anumzamo'ma huvagamareteno'a, amanage huno Temani kumateti ne' Elifasinkura hu'ne, Kagri'ene tare ronekagu'enena tusi narimpa aheramante'noe. Na'ankure Nagri eri'za ne' Jopu'ma nagriku'ma tamagema huno huamama hiaza huta, Nagri navu'nava zankura tamagra tamage huta huamara osu'naze.
E'ina hu'negu tamagra 7ni'a ve bulimakao afu'ene 7ni'a ve sipisipi afu'ene avreta Nagri eri'za ne' Jopunte vuta, tamagra'agu huta tevefi kre fanane hu' ofa ome hiho. Ana nehinkeno, Nagri eri'za ne' Jopu'ma tamagriku huno, nunamuma hanige'na, tamagra neginagi kema huta Nagri navu'nava zanku'ma tamage huta huama'ma osu'naza zantera, Jopu nunamuna antahi'na knazana ontamigahue.
Anagema hutege'za Temani kumateti ne' Elifasiki, Suha kumateti ne' Bildatiki, Nama kumateti ne' Zofariki hu'za Ra Anumzamo'ma hihoma huno huzmantea zana amage ante'za tro hu'naze. Ana hazageno Jopu'ma hia nunamuna Ra Anumzamo'a antahimi'ne.
Hagi rone'araminku'ma huno Jopu'ma nunamuma hutegeno'a, Ra Anumzamo'a knare nomani'za ete Jopuna ami'ne. Ko'ma Jopu'ma ante'nea fenozama havizama hu'nerera, tamagerfa huno Ra Anumzamo'a ana mika fenozana ete ami'neno, ana agofetura mago'ene ante agofetu huno amigeno rama'a fenoza ante'ne.
Anama hutege'za afu aganahe'zane asarehe'zane korapa rone'amo'zanena e'za noma'afina ne'zana eme ne'naze. Ana nehu'za Ra Anumzamo'ma knazama atregeno agrite'ma e'nea zankura, Jopuna eme zamasunku hunente'za, azeri hankaveti nanekea hu'naze. Ana nehu'za mago mago vahe'mo'a muse zana, zagone golireti'ma tro'ma hu'naza rini eritere hu'za eme ami'naze.
Ana higeno henka nomani'zama Jopu'ma manino vu'nea nomani zama'afina Ra Anumzamo'a asomu huntegeno ko'ma mani'nea nomanizana rugatere'ne. Higeno Jopu'a menina 14tauseni'a sipisipi afutami anteno, kemoli afutamina 6tauseni'a anteno, hozama e'neria bulimaka'ama zanazeri tragoteno rezmante'nea bulimakao afutamina 2tauseni'a anteno, a' tonki afutamina 1tauseni'a ante'ne.
Ana nehuno Ra Anumzamo'a ru'ene Jopuma ami'neana, 7ni'a ne' mofavre nemino, 3'a mofa'ne ami'ne.
Hagi ese mofa'mofona Jemima'e huno agia antenemino, anante mofa'mofona Kesia'e huno agia antenemino, nampa 3 mofakura Keren-Hapuku'e huno agia antemi'ne.
Hagi anama mani'naza mopa'afina, Jopu mofa'nemo'zama hiranto hu'za knare zantfama hu'nazankna mofa'nea omani'naze. Ana hu'neankino Jopu'ma fenone mopanema refko huno ne' mofavre naga'ama nezamino'a, ana mofane nagara ana zanke huno refko huno zami'ne.
Ana'ma huteno'a Jopu'a 140'a kafu mani'neno, agehone agigone azankonena ke'ne.
Ana'ma huteno'a Jopu'a knare'za huno za'zate maniteno, ozafa reno fri'ne.
Kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmi kea amage'ontege, kumi'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmi zamage ontege, mani'ne'za Anumzamofoma kiza zokago kema hunentaza vahe'enema nomaniza vahe'mo'za asomu eri'za muse hugahaze.
Ra Anumzamofo kasegema avesi avesi hunenteno, masane haninema agesa are'are'ma ana kasegegu'ma nehia vahe'mo'a,
tinkenare me'nea zafamo'ma kna fatgo'are raga'a knare huno renentegeno, ani'na'amo'a harari osu tretre huno meankna huno, maka zama hania zamo'a knare zanke hugahie.
Hagi kefo zamavu'zamava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za anara osugahazanki, zaho'mo witi hona'a eri hareno viankna hugahaze.
E'ina hu'negu kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mota Anumzamo'ma keagama refkohu trate'ma mani'neno keagama refko huramantesigeta anankeaga agatenoresageno, kumi'ma nehaza vahe'mo'zanena fatgo zamavu'zamava'ma nehaza vahe kevufina omanigahaze.
Na'ankure fatgo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmia Ra Anumzamo'a kegava huzmantegahianki, kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za haviza hu'za fanane hugahaze.
Na'a agafare ama mopafima me'nea kumatamimpi vahe'mo'za hara hunakura oku'a nanekea retro nehazage'za, vahe'mo'za nena'a fore osia nanekea oku'a retro hu'za vano nehaze?
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'ma masavema freno huhamprinte'nea kini ne'mofone, Anumzamofonena hara huznantenakura ama mopafi kini vahetamimo'za retrotra nehazageno, kva vahe'mo'zanena ome eritrua nehaze.
Ana hute'za anage nehaze, tagri'ma nofi'ma rerantena'a zana rukampru nehuta, kegavama huneranta'a zana zanatreta fru huta manisune hu'za nehaze.
Monafima kini tra'are'ma mani'nea kini ne'mo'a zamagiza neregeno, Ra Anumzamo'a kiza zokago ke hunezmante.
Ana nehuno arimpahe zampinti kea hunezmino, rimpa akahe ke huno zamazeri koro nehuno amanage hugahie,
Nagra'ni'a Saioni ruotge agonanire kini ne'ni'a azeri oti'noe.
Ra Anumzamo'ma trakema anaki namiankea zmasamigahue, Ra Anumzamo'a amanage huno nasmie, Kagra nenamofoga maninke'na, menina nagra kavre'na negafa'za hue. (Hibru 1:5-5)
Nantahigege'na ama mopafi kumatmina kami'nena erisanti haresankeno, maka mopamo'a kagri'za segahie.
Kazampina aini azompaka'a erinenka vahera kegava hunezmantenka, mopa kavo rufuzafupeankna hunka, ana vahetmina ana azompareti rufuzafupegahane. (Rev-Hufo hu'nea naneke 2:27)
E'ina hu'negu menina kini vahetmimota knare antahi'za e'nerinkeno, ama mopafi kva vahe'mota tamavumro kea antahiho.
Ra Anumzamofona koro hunteta agoraga'a mani'neta eri'zana erinenteta, tamahirahi nere'na koro hunteta agoraga'a mani'neta musena hiho.
Aru arimpa ahesigeno'a tamahe fanane hanigi, nemofona agihene, agona hene hiho. Na'ankure teve anefakna huno arimpama he'zamo'a, ame huno ruhagna hugahie. Agripima frakisu'za vahe'mo'za muse hugahaze.

Ra Anumzamoka ha' vahenimo'za ome ra hu'za hara hunantazanki ko! Rama'a vahe'mo'za oti'za hara renantaze!
Rama'a nagrikura hu'za, Anumzamo'a agura ovazigahie hu'za nehaze.
Hianagi kagra Ra Anumzamoka maka kaziga hankoni'gna hunka manigaginantenka, ra nagia nenaminka naza hanke'na hara zamagate'neroe.
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'ma nzama hinogu'ma krafage hu'na ke'zatugeno'a, ruotge agona'aretira antahinami'ne.
Navura mase so'e hute'na onetue, na'ankure Ra Anumzamo'a kegava hunenante.
Hanki rama'a 10tauseni'a ha' vahe'mo'zama maka kazigati'ma eme navazagi kagisazana, nagra korora zamagrikura osugahue.
Ra Anumzamoka, otio! Nagri Anumzamoka nagu'vazio! Ha' vahe'ni'aramina zamerage rupro hunka nezmahenka, kefo avu'ava'ma nehia vahera zamave rutafrinka zamaho.
Vahe'ma agu'vazi zana Ra Anumzamofompi me'ne. Hagi kagri asomu'mo'a, kagri vahepi megahie.

Anumzanimoka kema hanugenka fatgo navu'navani'a refko hunka negenka antahinamio! Knafima mani'nogenka kagra naza hu'nane. Kasunku hunantenka nunamu'ni'a antahinamio.
Hagi ama vahe'mota nama'a zupa ra nagima nenamiza zana eri rukrahe huta, agafa'a omne'zantera nazeri nagazea nehaze? Nama'a zupa nena raga ore nanekea avesinenteta havi nanekea nevararize?
Hianagi antahio, Ra Anumzamo'a agri'ma nevaririza vahera zamazeri ruotge huno agrarega zamavarenenteno, nagrama nunamuma hanugeno'a antahi namigahie.
Krimpama nehena kumira osuo, tafeka'are masenenka kea osu mani'nenka kagu'afi antahintahia huo.
Ofa fatgo hunka Kresramana nevunka, Ra Anumzamofonte kamentinti huo.
Rama'a hu'za, iza knare'zana taveri hugahie? hu'za nehaze. Hanki Ra Anumzamoka atregeno kavugosafinti masamo'a remsa huranteno.
Kagra tusi'a muse'za nagu'afina ante avitenantankeno witine kasefa wainima vasagazageno rama'a hige'zama musema nehazama'a agatere'ne.
Narimpa fru hu'na korora osu'na masegahue. Na'ankure Ra Anumzamoka naza hanke'na hazenkea e'ori knare hu'na nemanue.

Ra Anumzamoka, nunamu keni'a antahinaminka, knazampima mani'ne'nama kragima neruana, nenagenka antahinamio.
Kagra nagri kini ne' mani'nenka, nagri Anumza mani'nananki, zavi krafage'nia kagesa antenka antahio. Na'ankure nagra kagritega nunamuna nehue.
Ra Anumzamoka nanterama segenka nagerura nentahine, maka nanterana Kresramanama vu'zana retro huntete'na kenonama hunantesanku tusiza hu'na nagesa nente'na kavegantete'na nemanue.
Na'ankure kagra kefo avu'avazanku muse osu Anumza mani'nanankino, kefo avu'avazamo'a kagri tavaontera erava'o osugahie.
Hagi zamavufaga rama nehaza vahe'mo'za kagri kavuga o'otigahaze. Hagi kefo avu'a'ma nehaza vahera kavresra hunka zamagote nezmantane.
Kagra havigema nehaza vahera nezmahane. Ha'ma huno vahe'ma ahefri zanku'ma tusi aga'manetea vahe'ene, knare agerupinti'ma masavenkema huno vahe'ma revatgama nehia vahe'enena, Ra Anumzamoka kavresa hunka zamagote'nezmantane.
Hianagi vagaore kasunku'zamo'a rankrerfa hu'neanki'na amne nonka'afina marerige, ruotge mono nonka'ama me'nerega navugosa hunte'na korora hunegante'na keprihu'na monora hugantegahue.
Ra Anumzamoka fatgo kavukavazampi navrenka vuo, na'ankure ha' vahe'niaramimoza nazeri haviza hu'za nehazanki, navrenkama nevana kana eri fatgo huo.
Na'ankure nagri ha' vahe'mokizmi zamagipina tamage nanekea omnegeno, zamagu'afina vahe'ma azeri haviza hu'zamo avite'ne. Hagi zamananke nofimo'za, vahe'ma asenezmantaza mati kerigna higeno, vahe'ma masavema huno havi kampima avreno vu nanekemo'a, zamagefu'nafina avite'ne.
Anumzamoka keaga huzmantenka hazenke zamio, zamatrege'za zamagri kefo antahintahizamo, hazenkefina zamavareno ufreno. Hazenke zamavu'zmavamo'a marerige'za ha'regantazanki, zamahe natitrege'za kagri tava'ontera omaniho.
Hianagi kagripima eme fra'manekiza vahera zamatrege'za muse hiho. Anama nehu'za zagamema hu'za musena nehanagenka, kegava huzmanto. Kagriku'ma kavesinegantaza vahera kazana rusutenka turunara huzmantege'za kagri turunapi mani'ne'za musenkasea hiho.
Na'ankure tamage hunka Ra Anumzamoka fatgo avu'ava'ma nehia vahera kagra asomu hunezmantenka, knare kavukavazanu hankonuma hiaza hunka maka kaziga anteso hunezmantenka kegava hunezmantane.

Ra Anumzamoka kasima vazizampintira kea onasuge, karimpa ahezampintira nazeri fatgoa osuo.
Ra Anumzamoka hankaveni'a omneanki kasunku hunantenka naza nehunka, zaferinanimo'a omne amanehianki naza huo.
Ra Anumzamoka, nagu' namemo'a tusi kna navenesianki, inankna zupa naza hugahane?
Ra Anumzamoka rukrahe hunka naza nehunka, vagaore kavesizanka'agu nentahinka nagu'vazio.
Fri'za vahe'mo'za fri'nazafintira antahi'nogamizanki, iza zagamera huno fri vahe kumapintira kagri kagia husga hugahie?
Kragri'ma ruvavama huazamo nanankena segeno, maka kenagera navunumo'a tafeni'afina tiru nemaregeno, zavi'ma atoazamo'a pilonimo'a pasupanegie.
Zavi'ma atoazamo navumo'a zoregeno, ha' vahe'nimo'zama hazazamo hige'na zavi'ma atoazamo navumofona hankave'a omane.
Ra Anumzamo'a zavi krafage'ni'a antahianki, kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mota rukrahe huta natreta viho.
Asunku hunantenogu'ma krafama huana Ra Anumzamo'a nentahino, nunamuma huana nentahie.
Ana maka ha' vahe'nimo'za tusi zamagaze nehanige'za antahintahi hakare nehu'za, havi zamagi e'neri'za, ame huno zamagaze nehina rukrahe hu'za vugahaze.

Ra Anumzana nagri Anumzamoka, kagripi fra nekuanki, nahenaku'ma navrarizama ne-esagenka nagu'vazinka naza huo.
Ana'ma osnankeno'a laionimo'ma nehiaza hu'za nahe'za tagna taganu vazisageno mago vahe'mo'e huno eme naza huno nagura ovazigahie.
Ra Anumzana nagri Anumzamoka, nagrama vahe'ma zamazeri haviza huge, nzampima hazenke'zama mege,
hazenke'a omne vahe kefo avu'ava huntege, agafa'a omne zante ha' vahe'ni'amofo feno rohumare'na erige'ma hu'nenuana geno'a,
zamatrege'za ha' vahe'nimo'za narotgo hu'za nazeri'za zamaga kanonu kugusopafi nahetrenage'na ra nagigura nagesa ontahi'na frineno.
Ra Anumzamoka krimpa hezmantenka otinka, ha' vahe'niaramina kasi vazizana eri zamaveri huo. Otinka zamarimpama ahenenantaza ha' vaheni'a fatgo kavukva hunka refko huzmantenka knazana zamio.
Atrege'za maka vahera emeri atru hu'za manigagisagenka, kagra manisga hunka mani'nenka kegava huzmanto.
Ra Anumzana maka vahe'ma refko nehia Anumzamo nagrira refko huno keana, nagra fatgo hu'noe. Fatgo navu'nava'ene knare navu'nava hugeno, hazenke zani'a omane'neanki, marerisa Anumzamoka nagrira refko hunanto.
Fatgo Anumzamoka kagra vahe'mofo antahintahine, tumo'enena negana Anumza mani'nananki, atregeno kefo zamavu'zmavama nehaza vahe'mokizmi kefo zamavu'zmava'mo'a vaganerena, fatgo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahera zamaza huge'za hankaveti'za maniho.
Marerifa Anumzana agra hankoni'agino, agra tumo'amo'ma fatgoma hu'nea vahera zamagu'nevazie.
Anumzamo'a fatgo huno keaga refko nehia Anumzankino, maka kna arimpa ahenezmante.
Hanki mago vahe'mo'ma agu'ama rukrahe osigeno'a, Anumzamo'a kazima'a kume neganeno, ati'a refagigino karina negreno retrotrara nehie.
Vahe'ma ahe fri ha' zama'a retro hunenteno, teve nefa'ane kevea'aramina retro hunente.
Kefo zamavu'zmava'zama nehaza vahe'mo'za kefo avu'ava zamo zamagu'afina avitege'za, a'nemo'za zamu'ene hazaza hu'za hazenke avu'ava zana zamu'ene hu'za krunagema hu'za kasenentaze.
Hagi iza'o vahe'moma taminogu'ma kerima kafintenimo'a, agra'a ana kerima kafintenia kerifi tamigahie.
Vahe'ma hazenkema hunte'nia hazenkemo'a rukrahe huno agri asenire ne-enigeno, vahe'ma azeri haviza hunaku retro'ma hania havizamo'a ete rukrahe huno agri kokovite egahie.
Fatgo avu'ava zama'agura Ra Anumzamofona susu hunente'na, muse zagame hu'na Ra Anumzana Marerifa Anumzamofona agia erisga hugahue.

Ra Anumzana, tagri Anumzamoka maka ama mopafina Kagri kagimo'a mareri agatere'ne! Himamu masaka'amo'a, monaramina agatereno onagamu'a me'ne.
Ne'one mofavreramine, amima nenaza mofavreramina rempi huzminke'za hankaveka'agura huama nehanageno, ha' vahe'kamo'za mago kea nosazageno, ha'ma renerantaza vahe'mofonena kezmia omane'ne.
Tro'ma hunte'nana monaramimpima kesga huna koama, ikane ofuramima tro hunka noma'are'ma ante'terema hu'nana kazanko avoma nege'na,
amanahu nagesa nentahue, nankna hu zaga vahera mani'nonkenka tusi antahintahi hunerantenka, vahera amnezaga mani'nonanagi kegava hunerantane?
Hianagi monafima mani'naza ankeroramina zamazeri antesga hunka tro hunezmantenka, mopafi vahera osi'a ante fenkma atrenka tro hunezmantenka masazanu'ene ragima amizanu'ene fetorira antaninte'nane.
Maka zama tro'ma hu'nana zantmimofo kegava hinogu kva azeri otinentenka, maka zana agri kvafi atrankeno agra kegava hu'ne.
Maka sipisipi afu kevuramine, bulimakao afu kevuramine, afi zaga kafane,
monaramimpima hareza vanoma nehaza namaramine, hagerimpi nozameramine, hagerimpima vanoma nehaza zagaraminena maka agri kavafinke atrenka kegava huo hunka ami'nane.
Ra Anumzana tagri Ra Anumzamoka, maka ama mopafina kagimo'a mareri agatere'ne!

Ra Anumzamofona mika nagu'areti hu'na susu hunente'na agi'a erisga nehu'na, hentofa zama tro'ma hu'nea zamofo agenkea eri ama hugahue.
Marerirfa Anumzamoka, muse nehu'na zagame hu'na kagia erisga hugahue.
Hagi ha' vahe'nimo'zama rukrahe'ma hanu'za, kagri kavuga traka hu'za frigahaze.
Na'ankure kagra kema refko hu trate mani'nenka fatgo hunka keaga refko nehunka, nagrira fatgo hunka refko hunenantane.
Krimpama ahenezmantenka ama mopafi vahera kea nezmasunka, kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahera zamahe frinkeno zamagimo'a fanene nehie.
Ha' vahera zamazeri haviza hunka nevunka, rankumazmia tra'zama tasgi hutreankna hunka vatitrankeno vahe'mo'za mago'enena zamagesa antahi nozmize.
Hianagi Ra Anumzama kini tra'are'ma manivava huno nevia Anumzamo'a, fatgo huno keagama refko hanigura retro nehie.
Fatgo avu'ava huno ama mopafi vahera refko hunezmanteno, fatgo huno vahetmina kegava huzmantegahie.
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'a zamazeri havizama nehaza zamunte omne vahe'mokizmi fraki havegazmi mani'neanki'za hazenke knafina anampinka ome frakiza manigahaze.
Kagri kagima antahi'naza vahe'mo'za kagrite zamentinti nehazanki, kagrama zamaza huogu'ma kantahima negaza vahera, Ra Anumzamoka kamefira hunozamine.
Ra Anumzamo'a Saioni kumatera (Jerusalemi) kini tra'are manisga huno mani'neanki, zagame hunka agi'a erisga nehunka, maka zama hu'nea zamofo agenkea maka ama mopafi vahetmina zamasamio.
Na'ankure vahe'ma zamahe frizare'ma, nona huno nezamahea Anumzamo'a knafima maniza vahera antahi nezmiankino, hazenke'ma zamiza vahe'mo'zama krafagema hanazana, ana krafage zamia antahi amnea osugahie.
Ra Anumzamoka kasunku hunanto, zamavaresrama hunenantaza vahe'mo'za nazeri haviza nehazagenka, kasunku hunantenka, fri kahanteti'ma navresgama hu'nana Anumza mani'nane.
Saioni (Jerusalemi) mofa'nemofo kuma kafantera zagamera hu'na nagu'ma vazi'nana zankura musena hugahue.
Ama mopafi vahe'mo'za zamagrama kafinte'naza kerifi neramisageno, zamagrama eri aka'ma hunte'naza kukompi ufregahaze.
Ra Anumzamo'a fatgoma huno keagama refkoma huno, agra'a avu'avara eriama nehigeno, kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za zamagrama haza kefo zamavu'zmavazamo rukrahe huno zamazeri havizana nehie.
Hagi ama mopafima kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za, ete rukrahe hu'za fri vahe kumapi vanageno, Anumzamofoma zamagema akaninentaza vahe'mo'zanena ana zanke hugahaze.
Hianagi keonke zanku'ma upa'ma nehaza vahera, Ra Anumzamo'a agera akaniozmante'na, zamunte omne vahe'mo'zama amuhama nehaza zamo'a, fananea osugahie.
Ra Anumzamoka otio! Atregeno vahe'mo'a hara azerino agate'orena, atregeno ama mopafi vahe'mo'za keagare kavuga eotiho.
Ra Anumzamoka zamazeri koro huo! Zamatrege'za ama mopafi vahe'mo'za amne vahetafa mani'none hu'za antahiho.
Ra Anumzamoka nahigenka afetera otinka mani'nane? Knazampima mani'nogenka nahigenka frakinka mani'nane?
Kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za zamavufagara hu'za zamunte omne vahera zamazeri haviza hunaku nezmavaririzanki zamatrege'za zamagrama hanaza hazanke zamo zamazeri haviza hino.
Na'ankure kefo zamavu'zmava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za, zamavufagamofo avesizankura zamavufagara nehu'za, zamagri'ama zamazama hania zankuke nentahi'za, Ra Anumzamofona huhaviza hunente'za zamefira hunemize.
Kefo avu'ava'ma nehia vahe'mo'a avufgara nehuno, Anumzamofonkura nohakeno, Anumzana omanine huno antahintahi'afina agesa nentahie.
Hianagi ana vahe'mo'ma maka zama hia zamo'a, knare nehigeno kagrama azeri havizama hanana zamo'ma avegama ante'neazana nonkeno, ha' vahe'zmia kiza zokago ke hunezmante.
Hagi agu'afina amanage huno agesa nentahie, mago zamo'a nazeri kazara osugahie nehuno, maka zupa muse huvava hu'na nevanugeno hazenke zana navatera omegahie nehie.
Hagi agipina kazusi kene, vahe'ma revatgama hu kene, vahe'ma azeri havizama hu kemo avitegeno, agefu'nafina hazenkema hu kene, kefo avu'avazama hu kemo avite'ne.
Hagi kuma tava'onte kafona anteno mani'neno hazenke'a omane vahera ahe nefrino, oku'a frakino mani'neno azanavama antega vahe'ma azeri havizama hania zanku nehake.
Laionimo'ma trampima kafoma anteno mani'neno zagagafama ame huno azeriaza huno, frakino mani'neno zamagra'ama zamazama hugama osaza vahera kukozmifi zamazerite'za zamavazu hu'za nevaze.
Hankavezmima omane vahe'ma evazageno'a, hanavezmima me'nea vahe'mo'za zamahe'za rehapatinetraze. Na'ankure kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahera hanavezmimo'a ra hu'nege'za anara nehaze.
Ana kefo avu'ava'ma nehia vahe'mo'a, agu'afina amanage huno agesa nentahie, nagrama hua navunavara Anumzamo'a agenekanino, avua nonkeankino, onagegahie huno nehie.
Ra Anumzamoka otio! Anumzamoka vahe'mo'zama zamazeri havizama nehazage'za, knazampima nemaniza vahera kagerakani ozmantenka, kazana erisga hunka zamaza huo.
Na'a higeno kefo avu'ava'ma nehia vahe'mo'a Anumzamoka amagena hunegamino, havi avu'ava'ma hua zantera nona osugahie huno agesa nentahie?
Hianagi Ra Anumzamoka hazenkema e'neri'za knazampima maniza vahera kenka antahinka nehanankinka, hazenkema zamiza vahera kagra'a kazanuti nona huzmantegahane. Zamagra'ama zamazama hugama osu'naza vahe'mo'za kagrite zamentintia nehaze. Kagra megusa mofavrerami zamazahu Anumza mani'nane.
Kefo avu'ava'ma nehuno vahe'ma azeri havizama nehia vahe'mofo azana ruhanentaginka, kefo avu'ava nehaza zantera zamarotgo hunka zamahehna huo.
Hagi Ra Anumzamofo mopafintira fanane hugahazanagi, Ra Anumzana mani vava kini mani'ne.
Ra Anumzamoka anteramiza nemaniza vahe'mokizmi zamavesizana negenka, zamagu'a zamazeri hanavenetinka krafa kezmia kagesa antenka nentahinka,
megusa mofavreramine vahe'mo'zama zamazeri havizama nehaza vahetega antenka zamahora nekane. E'ina'ma hanke'za ama mopafi vahe'mo'za koro nehu'za, mago'anena vahera zamazeri korora osugahaze.
Nagra Ra Anumzamofompinka frakina nemanuanki, nahigenka nagrikura namamo'za zamagu'vazinaku hare'za agonarega frazankna hunka korora nefrane hunka nehane.
Na'ankure kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'zama fraki'za mani'ne'za, fatgo vahera zamahenaku atizamifi keve erinte'za eri negrize.
Hagi kasegema amage anteno fatgo avu'ava'ma hu'zama omanesigeno'a, fatgo vahe'mo'za na'a hugahaze.
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'a Agra'a ruotage mono nompi monafina kini tra'are mani'neno, avua omege emege nehuno, Agra'a avurgareti vahera rezagneno nezamage.
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'a fatgo vahera refko huno nezamage. Hianagi havi zamavu'zmavama nehu'za, vahe'ma hazenkema nezamiza vahera tusi avesra hunezmante.
Hagi ana nehuno kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'ma hazenkema zamisiana monafinti amuho teve tankanuza herafi atrenigeno ko'arianka huno eramino zamahegahiankino, e'i miza zamia erigahaze.
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'a fatgo avu'ava nehia Anumza mani'neankino, fatgo avu'ava zanku ave'nesie. Hanki fatgo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'zage, Agri avufina kegahaze.

Ra Anumzamoka nazahuo, na'ankure fatgo vahera omanitfa higeno, kema antahino amage antega vahera ama mopafina omani'naze.
Hagi mika vahe'mo'za havige vaheke nemani'za, tare zamagu'areti masavenkea nehu'za vahera rezamavataga nehaze.
Ra Anumzamo Agrake havigema nehaza vahe'mofo zamagira ruhamunegino, zamavufaga rama nehaza zamaganefu'na ruhamunenkie.
Zamagra ana vahe'mo'za hu'za, tagra tavufga rankema hanuna zamo vahera zmagateregahunanki, iza tagrira kva vahetia manigahie hu'za nehaze.
Na'ankure kefo vahe'mo'za zamunte omane vahera zamazeri haviza nehu'za, kna nezamizanki'na, Nagra kegava huzmante'nuge'za havi vahe'mo'za zamazeri havizana osugahaze huno Ra Anumzamo'a hu'ne.
Ra Anumzamofo nanekemo'a, agru hu'neankino silvama 7ni'a zupa tevefi kreno eri agru hiankna huno agrunentake hu'ne.
Ra Anumzamoka, havi zamavu zamava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'zama zamazeri havizama hu'zankura zamagu'vazinka maka knafina kegava huzamante vava huo.
Hagi kefo avu'avazamo'ma vahepima ome rama nehige'za kefozama nehaza vahe'mo'za zamavufaga ra huza vano nehaze.

Ra Anumzamoka nama'a knafi kagera kaninantegahane? Ana maka kna kaganera kaninantegahampi? Nama'a knafi kamefira hunaminka onagegosane? Ra Anumzamoka za'za knafi kagera kaninantane. Za'za kna kamefira hunaminka onagane.
Nagra za'zate nasuzampina nemanugeno nagu'namemo'a knazampina manino nevie. Nahigenka natranke'za ha' vahe'nimo'za nazeri havizama haza zankura zamavufaga rana nehaze?
Rukrahe hunka nenagenka Ra Anumzana nagri Anumzamoka kenona hunanto. Ru mase'nurega frinugi, navurga eri hari hunka hanavea namige'na, ofri kasefa hu'na mani'neno.
Hagi ha' vahe'nimo'za amanage hugahaze, tagra hara hugateronkeno'e hu'za musena hugahaze.
Hianagi nagra vagaore kavesi zanka'agu namentintia nehu'na, nagra nagu'ma nevazina zanku musena nehue. Nagra Ra Anumzamofonku zagamera hugahue. Na'ankure Agra knare'zana rama'a hunante'ne.
Hagi neginagi vahe'mo'za zamagrama zamagu'afima antahi'zana Anumzana omanine nehaze. Hagi zamagra havizantfa hu'nazanki'za kasrino haviza hu'nea zamavu zamava nehu'za, havi vaheke manizageno magore huno knare vahera omani'ne.
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'a monafinka mani'neno, kema antahi ama'ma hu vahe'mo'zama Anumzamofonku'ma antahimiza amagema nentaza vahe'ma mani'nenagura kefenkatreno ama mopafina nege.
Hianagi mika vahe'mo'za rukrahe hu'za zamagena hunemiza, kefo vaheke mani'naze. Hagi magomo'e huno knare avu'vazana osu'neanki, mika vahe'mo'za kefo vaheke mani'naze.
Hagi kefo zamavu zamava'ma nehaza, bretima nenazaza hu'za nagri vahera zamazeri havizama nehu'za, Ra Anumzamofona nunamuna hu'za antahi nonkazafi?
Hianagi ana vahe'mo'za tusi'a koro hugahaze, na'ankure Anumzamo'a fatgo vahe'ene manigahie.
Hagi zamunte'ma omane vahe'mo'zama antahintahima retro'ma nehaza zana, havi zamavu'zamava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za huhaviza nehazanagi, Ra Anumzamo zamunte omane vahe'mokizmi frakino zamagu'vazi kumazamia mani'ne.
Hagi nagrama antahuana, agu'vazi zana Saioni agonaregati egahiankino, Israeli vahera zamagu'vazigahie. Hagi Ra Anumzamo'ma naga'amofo maka'zama eri knarema hanigeno'a, Jekopu naga'mo'za musenkase nehanageno, Israeli vahe'mo'za tusi muse hugahaze.
Ra Anumzamoka, iza kagri mono nompina manigara hu'ne? Iza ruotgema hu'nea agona ka'arera manigara hu'ne?
Iza'o hazenkema nosuno fatgo avu'ava'ma nehuno, agu'aretima huno tamage kema nehuno,
vahe'mofo azeri haviza hu kea nosuno, vahe'mofo huhaviza hunenteno, tavaoma'are'ma nemanimofoma havigema hunonteno,
kefo avu'ava'ma nehia vahe'ma amagena hunemino, Ra Anumzamofoma amagema nentaza vahe antahine'zamino, knazampina unefreno'a, huvempama hu'nea zanku agesa nentahino runotagreno,
zagoma ami'nerema, rama'a zagoma ante agofetu'ma huno eme zamizanku'ma nontahino, zamagri'ma zamaza huno hazenke'a omane vahe'ma zamazeri haviza hinogu'ma masavema hu'za zagoma amiza zagoma e'noria vahe'mo'a, oti hankanavetino manigahie.
Ra Anumzamoka nagu'vazio, na'ankure kagripinka mani'nena nagra nagura nevazue.
Hagi Ra Anumzamofonkura nagra hu'na, mika knare zama e'neruana kagritegati ne-e.
Hagi Anumzamofo vahe'ma amafima mani'naza vahera knare vahe mani'nazage'na, zamagranema mani'zankura nagra musena nehue.
Hagi havi anumzama nevaririza vahe'mo'za, rama'a zamasu zampi manigahaze. Hagi nagra ana havi anumzante'ma tima tagitre ofama huogu'ma, korama eri'za eme namisazana erina ofa huontege, ana havi anumzantamimofo zamagirera huamara osugahue.
Hagi Ra Anumzamoka nagrama erisanti hare'nua zane, tintafeni'a Kagrake mani'nenka, henkama manisua zani'a eri knare hugahane.
Hagi mopa'ma nami'nana mopamo'a, knare hu'nege'na musena nehu'na, hentofa zantamina erisanti neharoe.
Nagra nazeri fatgoma nehia Ra Anumzamofona agi'a erintesaga hugahue. Na'ankure hanimpinena ana nanekemo'a nagu'afi me'neno rempi hunenamie.
Nagra antahi'noe, Ra Anumzamo'a mika knafina nagrane nemanino hanavea nenamiankina, mago zankura korora hu'na antria osugahue.
E'ina hu'negu nagu'areti hu'na muse nehuankino, musezamo nagripina avinetege'na knare hu'na nemanue.
Na'ankure kagra natrenanke'na fri'na fri vahe kumapina uomanige, atrenankeno ruotagema hu'nea vahekamo'a frino onkasarigahie.
Hagi kagra nomani'zamofo kana naveri nehankeno, kagri tava'ontera musezamo'a avineteankina tamaga kaziga kzantega mani'nena musena huvava hugahue.
Ra Anumzamoka mani fatgo hu'na mani'nuegu kantahinegoanki nunamuni'a antahinamio. Hagi nzama huogu'ma krafagema nehu'na, nagra regavatga nosuanki nunamuni'a antahinamio.
Hagi kagra mani'nantegatira nazahunka refko hunantenka, nazeri knare huo. Na'ankure kagrake knare'ma hu'naza vahera zamagenka refakoa nehane.
Hagi kagra hanimpina antahizani'a refako hunka negenka, nagu'amofona renahenka negane. Hianagi mago kumira nagripina kenka erifore nosane. Hagi kegaganifina mago kefo kea omanesie hu'na nehue.
Hagi kagri kasegema amagema nentoa zamo nazahige'na, haframa nehaza vahe'mokizmia namage'na hunezamue.
Mika zupa kagri kanteke nevugeno, nagamo'a kririno havifina vuno enora nosie.
Ra Anumzamoka kagritega kezana netuanki antahinamio. Ra Anumzamoka kagesa antenka nunamu keni'a antahinamio.
Hagi vagaore kavesi zanka'a hentofaza hunka eri ama huo. Ha' vahezamigu'ma koroma nehaza vahera, Kagra hanave kazanu zamagu nevazina ne' mani'nane.
Hagi Kagra kavurgama kegavama nehanankna hunka kegava hunantenka, kagekonanu refitenanto.
Kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za nazeri haviza huza nehazagenka nagu'nevazinka, ha' vahe'nimo'za nahenaku'ma navazagi kaginagenka nagu'nevazine.
Hagi zamagra mago vahekura zamasunkura hunozamante'za, zamavufaga ra hu nanekege nehaze.
Hagi kama nevuge'za zamagra navaririza nevu'za, mopafi nahetrenaku navazagi kagine'za, zamavu ante'za mani'naze.
Zamagra laionimo zagagafa aheno tapage hunaku eme krino maniaza nehu'za, agaho laionimo zagagafa ahenaku frakino maniaza hu'naze.
Hagi Ra Anumzamoka otinka ha' vahe'nia ha' huzamantenka zamahe mopafi zamatro. Kagra'a bainati kazinknonteti kefo vahepintira hara hunka nagu'vazio.
Hagi Ra Anumzamoka ama mopafi zama erisantima harenaku'ma tusizama nehaza vahe zamazampintira hanave kazanuti nagu'vazio. Ana nehunka miko knaza zamimofo avamente antenka mizana zamio. Ana nehunka zamagripintima fore hu anante nante hanaza vahera knazana zaminka vugahane.
Na'ankure nagra fatgo hu'na knare hu'noankina, henkama otinu'na kagri kavufina negage'na musena hugahue.

Ra Anumzamoka nagra navesigantoe, nagri hanavea Kagrake mani'nane.
Ra Anumzamo'a ra haveni'ane, vihuni'a mani'neno nagura nevaziankina, agripinka frakugeno hankoni'a mani'neno nagura nevazie. Ra Anumzamo'a nagri hankone hankavenine nazahu have mani'neno, fraki kumani'a mani'ne.
Nagra Ra Anumzamofonku nunamu hu'na antahigogeno, ha' vahe'nimofo azampintira naza hu'neanki'na, Ra Anumzamofona ra agi nemina agi'a hentesga hugahue.
Nofi'mo nazeri kagiankna huno fri'zamo'a nazeri kanegigeno, ti hageno refiteankna huno hazenkezamo'a refitenante'ne.
Hagi fri'zamo'a nofikna huno anaki nenantegeno, fri'zamo'a krifumo zagagafa azeriankna huno naze'nerie.
Hagi nagra narimpa natazane knazanifi mani'nena Ra Anumzamofona krafage hunentogeno, Agra ra mono noma'afinti ana krafageni'a agesa anteno antahi'ne.
Hagi mopamo'a imi e'nerigeno, toretore nehigeno, agonamofo tramo'a kazakaza hu'ne. Na'ankure Ra Anumzamofona arimpa ahenegeno anara hu'ne.
Hagi agonagampintira toki nehigeno, agipintira maka'zama tefanene hu tevemo hagana hagana nehigeno, teve tankanu'zamo ankanuferami ankanuferami hu'ne.
Hagi Agra mona kafana erinagino ne-egeno, agagusamofo fenka kaziga haninentake hampo me'ne.
Hagi serafimie nehaza ankeromofo agofetu hareno ne-eno, zaho'mofo agekonare mani'neno hareno evu'ne.
Hagi haninu agra'a azeri ano nevazino, koma neria hamponteti Agra'a azeri ano vazinte'ne.
Hagi masazama'amo'a ana hampona rupapa huno nevigeno, komopa komo'a nehigeno, tevemo'a teragareno vuno eno huno erami'ne.
Hagi marerifa Ra Anumzamo monafinkati kema nehigeno'a, agerumo'a tusi'a monage hiaza hu'ne. Hagi kema nehigeno'a, tevemo'a ankanuferamino vuno eno nehigeno, komopa komo'a hu'ne.
Hagi Agra keve'aramina ahetreno ha' vahe'a zamahe panani nehuno, tusi'a masa'areti kopasinamo ru marave marave hiaza huno zamahe savri hu'ne.
Hagi Ra Anumzamoka kasimu'ma nentankeno'a, hagerimo'a apapa huno vuno eno higeno mopa fore nehigeno, tusi'a keri fore higeno, mopama azeri'nea tra'mo'a amate me'ne.
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'a monafinka mani'neno azana antefenka atreno, hagerimo nazeri nakri'za nehigeno naza huno navre'ne.
Hagi hanavenentake ha' vahe'mo'zama nahe'zama nehazageno'a, Agra naza nehuno zamavaresrama hunantaza vahepinti'enena naza hu'ne. Na'ankure ha' vahe'nimo'za hanavenentake hu'za nagri nagatere'nazagu anara hu'ne.
Ha' vahenimo'za hanaveni'ama omnea knafi hara eme hunante'nazanagi, Ra Anumzamo'a naza hu'ne.
Hago Agra navareno nagu'vazinia kumapi ome nantene. Na'ankure Agra nagria muse hunante'negu anara hu'ne.
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'ma knare'ma hunante'neana, nagrama fatgo navunava'ma hu'noa zante nona huno mizani'a nami'ne. Nazamo'a agru higena mago hazenke'ma osu'noa zante, nona huno mizana nami'ne.
Na'ankure nagra Ra Anumzamofona kasege'a amage nentena, nagra havi navu'navara hu'na Anumzamofona otre'nogu huno anara hu'ne.
Nagra kasegea mika amage nentena, magore hu'na tra ke'a ruotagre'noe.
Nagra kumira nosuna, Ra Anumzamofo avufina kumi'ma huzankura kegava hu'na mani'noe.
Ana hu'negu Ra Anumzamo'a knare navu'nava'ma hunore nona huno mizana nami'ne. Na'ankure Agrama keana nagri nzampina hazenke'zana omneno agru hu'negu huno, anara hu'ne.
Hagi manifatgoma huza maniza vahera, fatgo kavukva hunezamantenka, hazenkezmima omne vahera knare kavukva hunezmantane.
Hagi agruma hu'nea zamavu zamava'ma nehaza vahera, agru hu'nea kavukava hunezmantenka, fatgoma osu zamavuzamava nehaza vahera, fatgo kavukva hunka, ana avu'avazantera nona hunezmantane.
Hagi zamavufagama anteramiza maniza vahera zamazeri antesaga nehunka, zamavufagama antemareriza vahera zamazeri fenkami netrane.
Hagi Ra Anumzamoka Kagra tavira rekru hunenantenka, hanizana nagripintira eri netrane.
Hagi Anumzanimoka Kagra nzahankena hanave ha' vaheni'a nezamahe'na, Kagra nzahankena ranra kuma kegina takaure'na nevue.
Anumzamofo avu'avamo'a knare hu'ne. Ra Anumzamoka ke'mo'a tamage ke me'ne. Hagi Agra hankogna hu'nege'za vahe'mo'za agripinka ome franekize.
E'ina hunanku ina Anumzamo kagri knara huno Ra Anumzana mani'ne? Magore huno ra anumzana omani'neanki, tagri Anumzamoka Kagrake hanavenentake havetia mani'nenka, kva hunerantane.
Hagi magoke Anumzamo agrake hanavea nenamino, fatgo kantera knare huno navareno nevie.
Hagi Agra nagiamofona azeri hanavetige'na dia afumo'zama nehazaza hu'na agona morusapina vano nehu'na, tarakara nosue.
Hagi Ra Anumzamo'a ha'ma hu'zana rempi hunenamino, hanave namige'na bronsireti tro hu'naza hanavenentake atia erigrinkenke nehue.
Hagi Ra Anumzamoka Kagra nagu'vazi hanko nenaminka, tamaga kazanu nazerisga hankena, hara hu'na vahe'mokizmi zamavurera nagine vahera mani'noe.
Hagi nagamo'ma krarizankura Kagra ranka varinantanke'na traka osu nevue.
Hagi nagra ha' vaheni'a zamarotago hu'na ome zamazeneri'na, zamarotago huge'na otre'noanki, zamarotago huvava hu'na miko zazmia eri haviza nehu'na zamahe vagare'noe.
Hagi nagra zamahe'na rehapatuge'za, nagafi ufrinte efrinte hu'za oratigara osu'naze.
Hagi ha' vaheni'anema ha'ma hanua hanavea Kagra nenaminka, ha' vaheni'a zamatranke'za nagafi eme kepri hunante'naze.
Hagi Kagra ha' vaheni'a zamazeri koro hanke'za, zamefira rukrahe hu'za onke fre'za vazage'na, zamavesrama hunenantaza vahera mika zamahe vagare'noe.
Hagi zamazama hanaza vaheku kezati'nazanagi, magomo'e huno zamaza osige'za, Ra Anumzamofonku taza huo hu'za hazanagi, zamaza osu'ne.
Hagi nagra ha' huzmante'na zamahe kasopoge'za, zahomo kugusopa eri hareno vuno eno hiankna hu'za miko kokantega umani emani hu'naze. Hagi ha' vaheni'a ha' huzmantena zamahena rehapatuge'za, kampi hapa kna hu'naze.
Hagi Kagra ha'ma renenantazagenka, nagu'vazinka nzamahankena ha' vaheni'a hara huzamagatere'noe. Hagi Kagra kva vahera huhampri'nantake'na kumatamina kegava hu'noge'za, zamage'na antahina osu'noa vahe'mo'zanena nagri nagoraga manine'za erizani'a eri'naze.
Hagi nagri nagenkema miko kaziga vahe'mo'zama nentahiza, zamanogu nehu'za nagri nagafi anterami'za mani'naze.
Hagi ha' vahe'nimokizmia miko hanavezamia vagarege'za zamahirahiku nehu'za, fra'ma nekiza vihu'zamia atre'za nagrite e'naze.
Hagi kasefa huno mani'nea Ra Anumzana nagri fraki havenia mani'neanki'na, agi'a ahentesga nehu'na, nagu'ma vazi'nea Anumzamofo agi'a ahentesga hugahue.
Hagi ama ana Anumzamo, nagri'ma nazeri haviza hu'naza vahera nona huno zamazeri haviza nehuno, ru kazigati vahera zamavarenamige'za nagri nagafina mani'naze.
Ha' vahe'ni'mo'zama nahenaku nehazageno'a naguvazi'ne. Hagi hazenke vahe'mo'zama nazeri havizama hu'za nehazagenka Kagra nagu'vazi'nane.
E'ina hu'nanku, maka kumapi vahepintira nagra muse zagamera hu'na Ra Anumzamoka kagia erisga hugahue.
Hagi Kagra kinima nazeri oti'nana ne'kamo'na hanavea nenaminkena hara azeri agatenerogenka, Kagra masavema frenka huhampri nante'nana ne'mo'na kavesinenantenka Deviti'nane nagripinti'ma fore'ma hania vahera kavesi rante vava hugahane.

Hagi monamo'a Anumzamofo hankave'a erinte ama nehigeno, monafima me'nea zantamimo'a Agri erizankama'a erinte ama hu'ne.
Hagi magoke magoke knamo'a Anumzamofoku hu'ama nehigeno, maka kenagemo'a Agri antahi'zama'a erinte ama nehaze.
Hagi masane haninemokea kegaga neha'anagi, zanagerura ontahigahaze.
Naneke zanimo'a mopane mopane vuno eno hu'ne. Hagi zagemofo nonkumara Anumzamo'a monafi retro hunte'ne.
Hagi anampinkatira zagemo'a aravema hunaku hu'nea ne'mo atiramino eaza huno ne-eno, agare zokago nerea ne'mo agarenaku muse nehia kna nehie.
Hagi zagemo'a mopamofona mago kazigati hanatino mago kaziga unefreankino, mago zamo'a agri amuhofintira frakigara osu'ne.
Hagi Ra Anumzamofo kasegemo'a fatgo hu'neno kasefa tasimu neramie. Hagi Ra Anumzamofo kemo'a, knare antahi'za me'neankino antahizama'a omne vahera azeri ante fatgo huno knare antahi'za nezamie.
Hagi Ra Anumzamofo kasegemo'a knare zantfa hu'neankino, tagu'afina musezanente. Hagi Ra Anumzamofo kasegemo'a, agru hu'neankino vahe'mofo avua eri hari nehuno, ama' antahiza nemie.
Hagi Ra Anumzamofonku'ma kore'ma huntezamo'a agru hu'neankino mevava hugahie. Hagi Ra Anumzamofo kemo'a tamage ke me'neankino, makazana fatgo huno refako nehie.
Hagi ana ke'amo'a, rama'a golima kre'za eri agruma hu'naza golimofo mizama'a agaterene. Hagi ana ke'amofo haga'amo'a tume rima'amofo haga'a agatere'ne.
Hagi ana kekamo'a eri'za vahekamo'na havi avu'ava'ma huzanku koro kea nenasmino, ana nanekeka'ama amage'ma antaza vahera knare museza nezmie.
Hagi inankna hu'na nagripima me'nea kefozana kena antahina hugahue? Ra Anumzamoka kagrake oku'ama frakino nagripima me'nea kumini'a atrenantenka nazeri agru huo.
Hagi havizama hugahuanki hu'na antahine'nama hu kumipina natrege'na uofra'neno, hagi atregeno kumi'mo'a nazeri nagatereno navareno ovuno. Hagi natrege'na kumimpintira fru hu'na mani'neno.
Hagi Ra Anumzamoka atregeno kenimo'ene nagu'afima antahintahima nehua zamo'a kagri kavufina knare huno me'nena musena hunanto. Kagra Ra Anumzamoka fraki have mani'nenka, nagu'vazi ne' mani'nane.

Hagi hazenkefima ufresankeno'a, Ra Anumzamo'a kagu vazigahie. Jekopu Anumzamo'a kegava hugante'nie.
Hagi Agra mono noma'afi mani'neno kza nehuno, Jerusalemi kumateti kza hu'zana atrenigeno egahie.
Hagi mika ne'za ofama hananana, antahi'negamino tevefima kre fanene hu ofama hananana, antahi muse hanie.
Hagi Agra kagri'ma kvesinia zana negamino, nazano tro'ma hunaku keagama retro hanana zana amane hugantenigeno knare zanke hugahie.
Hagi Kagrama ha'ma agatere'nanketa tagra musenkase huta kaninereta, Anumzantimofo agire krauvefana erisaga hugahune. Ra Anumzamo agrake mika nunamuma hanazana antahiramisie.
Hagi menina nagra antahi'noe, Ra Anumzamo'a monafinka ruotge kuma'afi mani'neno, Agra'ama huhampri'nante'nea kini ne'mo'na nunamuni'a antahinenamino kenona hunanteno, tamaga azanteti hanave'a eri ante ama huno naza huno navregahie.
Hagi mago'a vahe'mo'za hosi afuzmine karisi zmimofo hanavegu antahinezamize. Hianagi tagra Ra Anumzana tagri Anumzamofonte tamentintia nehune.
Hagi mago'a vahe' mo'za evuramiza haviza hugahazanagi, tagra oti'neta hankavenentake huta manigahune.
Ra Anumzamoka aza hunka kini nera agu'nevazinka, taza huoguma krafagema nehanunkenka, krafa ketia antahiramio.

Ra Anumzamoka, kagrama kini ne'mofoma hankavema nemina zanku, agra tusi muse nehuno, azama hankeno ha' vahe'ama ha'ma huzmagatere'nea zankura tusiza huno kagrikura musenkasea hunegante.
Agri'ma agu'afima avesiazana amne neminka, nazankuro kantahigea zana, i'ora osunka amne nemine.
Kagra tamagerfa hunka kini nera asomu hunentenka, knare zantfa hu'nea golireti tro hu'naza kini fetori anuntera antani nentane.
Kini nemo'ma kantahigeno za'zate kasefa hu'na manisanuema higenka, Kagra hu izo hunka asimura neminka, kna'a eri zaza hankeno mani vava nehie.
Kagra kini nera aza hankeno, ha' vahe'a hara huzmagaterege'za agrira ragia ami'naze. Kagraka'a ra agima eri'zane hanavenena ami'nane.
Tamagerfa hunka mevava asomura hunentenka, tavaonkare avrentankeno muse huno Kagrane nemanie.
E'ina hu'negu kini ne'mo'a, Ra Anumzamofonku antahi amuhara nehuno, Marerisa Anumzamofona vagaore avesizanku nentahino, antria nosuno oti hankavetigahie.
Ra Anumzamoka hankavenentakema hu'nea tamaga kaziga kzanteti ha' vaheka'a hara hunezmantenka, kagri'ma zamavesrama hunegantaza ha' vaheka'a zamazeri haviza hugahane.
Kagrama efore'ma hanana knazupa, kagri ha' vahera Kagri tevenefake tevemo teno eri fanane hugahie. Ra Anumzamoka tusi krimpa ahenezmantenka tevefi zamahe fanene hugahane. Ana nehanigeno Anumzamofo tevemo'a ana vahera teno eri fanane hugahie.
Ana vahepintima fore hu anante anante'ma hu'za ama mopafima mani'naza vahera, ama mopafintira zamahe vagaresnanke'za, ama mopafina omanigahaze.
Kagrira ana vahe'mo'za kazeri haviza hunaku kea anaki'naze. Hianagi ana kezamimo'a, amne zankna hugahie.
Na'ankure Kagra keveka'a atifima erintenka zamahenaku'ma eri karisnanke'za, koro atre'za fregahaze.
Ra Anumzamoka kagri hankavegu kagia ahentesga nehune. Ana nehuta kagri hihamugu zagamera huta kagia ahentesga nehune.

Anumzanimoke Anumzanimoke, na'a higenka kamefira hunenamine? Nazama huoguma kragima nerugenka, nahigenka naza osu afetera nemanine? (Matiu 27:46, Maki 15:34)
Anumzanimoka kagritega manigasa osuna mika knafina zagene haninena kagritega zavi krafagea nehuanagi, kagra antahi nonamine.
Ana hu'neanagi kagra ruotage hu'nana Anumzankinka kini trakare mani'nanke'za Israeli vahe'mo'za kagia erihentesga neheze.
Korapara tagri tagehe'za Kagrite zamentintima hazagenka, zamagu'vazinka ete zamavare'nane.
Kagritega zavi krafa hazagenka nentahinka, zamagu'vazi'nane. Ana nehanke'za kagrite zamentintia nehu'za zamagazegura osu'naze.
Hianagi nagra vaheknara osu'na hagirfagna vahe mani'noanki'za, maka kea nenasu'za zamefi hunenamize.
Maka vahe'mo'zama nenage'za, ki'za zokago ke hunenante'za, zamagefu'na hakana hunenami'za zamagena neru'za,
zamagra amanage hu'za nehaze, Ra Anumzamofonte amuhara nehuno amentintia nehianki, atrenkeno Ra Anumzamo aguravazino, Agra aza hino hu'za nehaze. (Matiu 27:39, 43. Maki 15:29. Luku 23:35)
Ana hu'neanagi kagrake'za naza hanke'na antanimofo arimpafintira so'e hu'na atirami'noe. Ana nehunka osi'ma manine'na antanimofo amima nenoa knafina naza hankena namentintia kagritera hu'noe.
Antanimo'ma kasenante'nea knareti'ma eno menima ama knare'ma egenka, kagra kegava hunenantenka, kagra nagri Anumza mani'nane.
Nagrira natrenka afetera omanio, na'ankure knazamo'a tavaonte me'neankino, mago vahe'mo'e huno naza hugara osu'ne.
Rama'a ha' vahe'mo'za ve bulimakao afu'mo'za nehazaza hu'za manikagi nante'naze. Ana vahe'mokizmi hankavemo'a Basani kazigama nemaniza ve bulimakao afutamimofo hankavezmimo'ma nehiaza huza mani kaginante'naze.
Nagri ha' vahe'mo'za laionimo agira aka huno mago'a zagagafa aheno nenaku krafa nehuno rotago nehiaza hu'za, nahenaku narotago nehaze.
Tima eri tagi atregeno'ma hiaza huno hankavenimo'a omanegeno, zaferinanimo'a avazu hu'ne. Ana higeno tumoni'amo'a kragefe masavemo nehiaza huno nagu'afina ze'ze huno pakepake hu'ne.
Zagere ante hagege hu'nea mopa kavomo tako hiankna huno hankavenimo'a omnegeno, nagefunamo'a navagu'nafare marerino antrako hu'ne. Ana higenka Anumzamoka kagra frio hunka natranke'na kugusopafina mase'noe.
Kramo hiaza hu'za ha' vahe'nimo'za mani kanegizageno kefo vahe'mo'za navazagi kagi'naze. Nazampine, nagiafinena rerapone'naze.
Ana hazagena ana maka zaferinani'a hampri'na ke'noe. Hagi ha' vahe'nimo'za uruha nenage'za zamagu muse nehu'za orevumi arevumi hu'naze.
Ana nehu'za ana vahe'mo'za nagri kukena refko hu'za eri zamente hu'za eneri'za, nagri kukena erinaku satu zokago re'naze. (Matiu 27:35. Maki 15:24. Luku 23:34. Jon 19:24.)
Hianagi kagra Ra Anumzamoka nagrira natrenka afetera omanio. Na'ankure kagra nagri hanave mani'nananki ame hunka enka eme naza huo.
Nagu'vazinka naza huge'za vahe'mo'za kazintetira nahe ofriho. Kagra naza huge'za, knare'ma hu'na mani'nofintira kragna vahe'mo'za nahe ofriho.
Laionimo'ma naheno nezama nehifintira naza nehunka, afi bulimakao afumo'ma pazivema nare'zama nefintira naza hunka nagu'vazio.
Nafu nagnahe'mokizmia Kagri kagia huama hu'na nezamasami'na, atruma hu'za mono'ma hanaza vahe amu'nompi oti'na kagia ahentesga hugahue. (Hibru 2:12)
Hagi izagato Ra Anumzamofonku'ma koro'ma nehanamota, Agri agia ahentesga hiho. Ana maka Jekopu agehe'mota Agri agi'a ahentesga huta monora hunteho. Israeli agehe'mota Ra Anumzamofonku koro hunenteta, Agri agorga maniho.
Iza'zo zamatafima mani'ne'za zamagra'ama zamazama huga'ma nosaza vahera, Ra Anumzamo'a amefira hunozamie. Ana nehuno zamagritera ke amnea huno frara nokianki, iza'o aza hinogu'ma nunamuma huno zavi krafama huno antahigea vahera, nunamu'a antahimino aza nehie.
Hanki Ra Anumzamoka kagri vahe'mo'zama mono'ma hunaku'ma eme atru'ma hanafina, Kagra muse zanka'a nagu'afina ante avite'nanke'na kagri kagia ahentesga hugahue. Kagriku'ma koroma nehaza vahe zamavufi, ko'ma huvempama hu'na hugahuema hu'na hu'noa zantamina ana maka huvagaregahue.
Zamunte'ma omane vahe'mo'za ne'zana nezamu hugahaze. Ra Anumzamofonku'ma nehakesaza vahe'mo'za, Agri agia ahentesga hugahaze. Anama hanaza vahera Anumzamo'a vagaore museza antezmanteke'za, musena hu'za vugahaze.
Ama mopafima maka kazigama mani'naza vahe'mo'za Ra Anumzamoka kagrira antahi negami'za rukrahe hu'za kagritega egahaze. Ana nehanage'za ama mopafima mani'naza maka vahe'mo'za nagate nofite hu'za Kagri kagiafi zamarena eme re'za monora hugantegahaze.
Na'ankure Ra Anumzamo'a Agra'a kinia manino, maka ama mopafi vahera kegava hu'ne.
Maka feno vahe'mo'za, ne'zana nene'za Ra Anumzamofona monora huntegahaze. Ana nehanage'za ana zanke hu'za frisaza vahe'ma mani'naza vahe'mo'za e'za, Ra Anumzamofo avuga zamarena eme re'za monora huntegahaze.
Henkama fore'ma hu'za mani'zama vanaza vahe'mo'za Ra Anumzamoka kagri eri'zana eri'za nevanage'za, mofavretimo'za kaguvazama eri fore'ma hu'nana zamofo agenkea antahigahaze.
Hagi ana fatgo avu'avazama hu'nea zana nezmarera rimpafima mani'naza mofavre nagamokizmia nezamasamisnage'za, maka'zama eri fore'ma hu'nea zamofo agenkea antahigahaze.
Ra Anumzamo'a kva vaheni'a mani'neanki'na, mago zankura atupara osugahue.
Ana hu'neankino afovage huno tretre'ma hu'nea trazampi nantege'na mani fru nehue. Ana nehuno kaza osu tintega navareno vige'na, tina ne'noe.
Agra hanaveni'a ete eri kasefa nehuno, Agra'a agigu nentahino navareno fatgo avu'avazamofo kantera nevie.
Ana nehu'na knazamo'ma rehanima hige'na, hanimpi neviankna hugahuanagi, anankna zamo'ma eme nazeri havizama hu'zankura korora osugahue. Na'ankure Ra Anumzamoka sipisipi kva vahe'mo'zama e'nerizankna azompaka'ane, sipisipima runeharizankna knonka'a eri'nenka nagrane mani'nanke'na ana zama negogeno'a, narimpamo'a fru nehie.
Ha' vahe'nimofo zamavuga, ra ne'zana retro hunenantane. Ana nehunka nasenifina masave taginka fre nenantenka, huhampri nantankeno, kapufinti'ma avite'noma herafiramiaza huno musezamo'a nagu'afintira aviteno varehineramie.
Tamagerfa huno Ra Anumzamofo knare avu'ava zamo'ene agri avesi'zamo'a ofri'nama kasefa hu'na ama mopafima manisua kna'afina, namage navararino vano hugahie. Ana nehanige'na Ra Anumzamofo mono nompi maka zupa manivava hugahue.
Ama mopa Ra Anumzamofo suza megeno, ama mopafima maka'zama me'nea zantamimo'a agri zanke megeno, maka vahe'mo'zanena agri vaheke mani'naze.
Na'ankure agra ama mopamofo tra'ama amefenkame tami'nea hagerimofo agofetu tro hunenteno, timofo agofetu mopa tro hunte'ne.
Ina vahe'mo Ra Anumzamofo agonafina marerigahie? Ina vahe'mo Ra Anumzamofo ruotage mono nompina ome otigahie?
Hagi agu'amo'ene azamo'enema agru nehanigeno, havi anumzante'ma mono'ma hunonteno havigema nosania vahemo anampina vugahie.
E'inahu vahe'mo Ra Anumzamofontegatira asomura erigahie. Anumzamo'a agu'vazino nevreno, fatgo vahe mani'ne huno huntegahie.
E'inahu vahe'mo Anumzamofonkura nehakeno monora hunenteno, Jekopu Anumzamofo tvaontera urava'o nehie.
Kuma kahantamimota anagita ru hagro nehinkeno, korapa'ma me'naza kahamota anagita ru hagaro nehinkeno, hankave'ane kini ne'mo'a efreno.
Hagi ana hankave kinia iza'e? E'i agra Ra Anumzana hihamu'ane hankanave Anumzankino, Agra hankavetino hara hugaterega Anumza mani'ne.
Kuma kahamota anagita ruhagro hiho, ana nehanageta korapa kahamota, anagita ru hagaro hiho. Ana nehinkeno hankave'ane kini ne'mo'a efreno.
Hagi ana hankave kinia iza'e? Ra Anumzana hankavenentake Anumzamo agrake ugagota kinia mani'ne.
Ra Anumzamoka kagrite nagu namena eri'na e'na ama nunamuna nehue.
Kagra nagri Anumza mani'nanke'na, kagrite namentintia nehue. Kagra natrege'na nagazegura osaneno. Hanki ha' vaheni'a zamatrege'za, hara hu nagate'nere'za musena osiho.
Kagrite'ma amuha nehu'za zamentintima nehaza vahera zmatresnanke'za, zamagazegura osugahaze. Hianagi kagri'ma ha'ma renegantaza vahe'mo'za, osuga zamavu zamava'ma hu'naza zanku zamagesa nentahi'za zamagazegura hugahaze.
Ra Anumzamoka knare kavukva zana naveri nehunka, Kagri'ma kavaririnua kana rempi hunamio.
Tamage nanekeka'afi kegava hunka navrenka nevunka, anankema amage'ma antesnua zana rempi hunamio. Na'ankure kagra nagri Anumza mani'nenka, nagu'vazinka ete nenavrane. Ana nehanku maka knafina Kagrama nazama hananku, amuhara nehue.
Ra Anumzamoka kasunku zanku'ene vagaore kavesi zankura kageraokanio. Na'ankure ana kavukva zana korapa knareti hume enka, meninena ana kavukvara nehane.
Ra Anumzamoka, ko'ma mofavrema mani'nenama hu'noa kumi'ene kefo avu'ava zani'a, vagaore kavesizanku kagesa nentahinka kumini'a atrenanto. Na'ankure Ra Anumzana Kagra kasunku Anumza mani'nane.
Ra Anumzamo'a knare hu'neno fatgo hu'neankino, kumi'ma nehaza vahera rempi huzamige'za, agri avesi'zana amage nentaze.
Zamavufgama anteramiza maniza vahera, fatgo avu'ava huno kegava huzmanteno zamavareno nevuno, Agra'a avu'ava zana rempi hunezamie.
Ra Anumzamofo kasegene trakenema amage'ma nentaza vahera, agra vagaore avesi zanteti zamavesi nezamanteno, hugahue huno'ma huzmante'nea ke'are oti'neno anaza nehia Anumza mani'ne.
Ra Anumzamoka, nagri kumira rama'a me'neanagi kagri kagimofo knare zanku kagesa nentahinka, muse hugantoanki kumini'a eri atrenanto.
Iza'o Ra Anumzamofonku'ma koro'ma hunte'nesnia vahera, Agra'a huhampri'nesia kante vuo huno huntenigeno vugahie.
Ana vahe'mo'za knare nomani'zampi nemanisnage'za, zamagrama kase zamantesnaza vahe'mo'za ama mopa erisanti hare'za so'e hu'za manigahaze.
Ra Anumzamo'a agriku'ma koro nehu'za, agri agoragama nemaniza vahera, zamatrege'za agri rone'a nemanizageno, oku'a me'nea kasege'a eri ama huno nezamasamie.
Maka zupa nazama hanigu Ra Anumzamofonteke navua nentoe. Na'ankure nagri'ma nazeri traka'ma hunaku'ma hania kukompintira nazeri atregahie.
Ra Anumzamoka rukrahe hunka nenagenka, kasunkura hunanto. Na'ankure nasuzampi mani'noe.
Nagri nagu'afima me'nea knazamo'a ome ra huno nevie. Ana knafima manine'na antahintahi hakarema nehua zampintira, katufenka navre atro.
Knazamo nazeri havizama nehige'na, narimpa knafima mani'noa zana nenagenka, maka kumini'a eri atrenanto.
Nagri ha' vahera rama'a efore nehu'za, nagri'ma ha'ma renenante'za zamavesrama hunantaza zana kagra ko.
Kagra nagu'nevazinka kegava hunka navrenka vuo. Natrege'za nazeri nagaze osiho. Na'ankure Kagripi e'na eme franekue.
Fatgo avu'avazamo'ene, mani fatgoma huno mani avu'azamo kegava hunantegahie. Na'ankure nagra nazama hanankura kagriku amuhara nehue.

Ra Anumzamo'a nagri tavi mani'neno, nagu'vazi ne' mani'neankina, nagra na'anku korora hugahue? Ra Anumzamo'a nagrira hankave vihuni'a mani'neanki'na, na'anku nagra nahirahikura hugahue?
Hanki havi avu'ava zama nehaza vahe'mo'zama nazeri haviza hunaku erava'o nehanageno, ha' vahe'nimo'za nahenaku egahazanagi, ana vahe'mo'za traka hu'za masegahaze.
Rama'a sondia vahe kerafamo'za nahenaku kafo eme ante'za navazagi kagigahazanagi, nagra korora osugahue. Ha' vahenimo'za hara agafa hu'za eme hunantegahazanagi, Ra Anumzamofonku amuhara hugahue.
Ra Anumzamofona mago zanku antahigesue, Knare nagrira natresanigena kasefa'ma hu'nama manisnua kna'afina, Agri nompina manivava nehu'na, knare avu'ava'a nege'na, musena hunente'na Agri mono nompi mani'nena kama naverima hanigura kegahue.
Hanki hazenke zama esania knafina, Agra'a navre franekino, Agra'a seli mono nompi navre frakigahie. Ana nehuno navresga huno onagamu'a have agofetu nantesige'na knare hu'na manigahue.
Anama hanige'na nagri'ma nazeri kagi'naza ha' vaheni'a naza hanige'na hara huzmagetenerena, ranke hu'na musenkase nehu'na, Ra Anumzamofo mono nompina ofa kresramna vugahue. Ana nehu'na zavena ahe'na zagamera Ra Anumzamofontega hugahue.
Ra Anumzamoka naza huogu'ma kagritegama nunamuma nehanugenka, kasunku hunantenka nunamuni'a antahinamio.

Ra Anumzamoka Kagra'a kavukvara rempi hunamio. Ha' vaheni'amo'za kafonte'za mani'nazanki, kegava hunantenka navrenka knare huno fatgo hu'nea kantera vuo.

Ana Ra Anumzamofo eri'zanku'ene, Ra Anumzamo'ma azampinti'ma tro'ma hu'nea zantaminkura antahi amne nehaze. Ana hu'nazankino zamazeri havizantfa hutresnige'za, mago'enena oti'za so'ea hu'za omanigahaze.
Ra Anumzamofona agi'a ahentesga hugahue. Na'ankure kasunku hunanto hu'nama kezatugeno'a, kezanke'ni'a antahinami'ne.
Ra Anumzamo'a hankveni'ane, hankoni'ane mani'ne. Ana hu'negeno nagu'amo'a agripi me'nege'na namentintia nehugeno, agra naza nehie. Ana nehigeno nagu'amo'a tusi muse nehianki'na, muse zagame nehu'na susu huntegahue.

Ra Anumzamoka nagri vahere nehunka, fenozama hiaza hunka'ma erisinte'ma hare'nana vahera asomu hunezmantenka, zamaza huo. Ana nehunka sipisipi kva vahe'mo'ma nehiaza hunka, maka knafina kazampi zamavarentenka kegava huzmante vava hunka vuo.

Ra Anumzamoka kagra knare kavukva hunantenka nazeri hankavetinke'na agonamo'ma oti hankavetiaza hu'na oti hankaveti'noe. Hianagi kagrama kavugosama rukrahe hunka kamefi'ma hunaminke'na, nagra koro hu'noe.

Ra Anumzamoka nagrama nehuankea antahi'nenaminka, kasunkuma hunantenka naza huoguma nunamuma nehuana antahinaminka naza huo.

Ra Anumzamoka kagripi franekuanki natrege'za magore hu'za nazeri nagazea osiho. Hanki fatgo kavukva zampinti nagu'vazio.

Ra Anumzamoka Kagra fraki haveni'ane, hankave vihuni'anena mani'nane. Kagri kagimo'ma knare haniazanku nentahinka nazeri fatgo hunka kegava hunanto.

Hagi Ra Anumzamoka kasunku hunanto. Na'ankure nagra knazampima mani'ne'na zavi'ma atoa zamo'a navumo'a pro nehigeno, navufgamo'enena ome haviza hie.
Maka kna nasuzampi nemani'na, knazampima mani'na vuazamo, higeno kafuni'amo'a atupa nehie. Kumi avu'avazampi mani'na vuazamo higeno hankaveni'a omnegeno, zaferinani'a omne amne nehie.

Fri'nea vahe'ma zamagekaniaza hu'za zamagekani nentazage'na nagra tako hu'nea mopa kavogna hu'noe.
Rama'a vahe'mo'za huhaviza hunentaza naneke nentahi'na tusi koro hu'noe. Hagi zamagra nahe frinaku oku'a atru hu'za kea anaki'naze.
Hianagi Ra Anumzamoka kagrite namentintia nehu'na nagri Anumza kagra mani'nane hu'na nehue.
Nasimu'mo'a Kagri kazampi me'neanki, ha' vahe'niamo'zama nahenaku'ma nenavaririza vahe'mokizmi zamazampintira nagu'vazio.

Hanki Ra Anumzamoka kagripi nagra franekue. Hagi natrege'za ha' vahetmimo'za nazeri nagazea osiho. Fatgo kavu'kvaka'afinti nagu'vazio. Hagi kefo zamavu'zmava'ma nehaza vahera zamazeri zamagaze nehunka, zamagira ruhamunkige'za friza matipi maseho.
Havigema nehaza zamagefu'na erirava nehenka, fatgo zmavuzmava'ma nehaza vahe'ma huhaviza nehu'za zamavufaga ra kema nehaza zamagira eriravaho.
Ra Anumzamoka knare kavukvamo'a rankrerfa hu'neankinka, kagri'ma koro'ma hugante'za kagoraga'ama nemaniza vahera rama'a zmasimu ante vite'nezmantane. Hagi kagripima eme frakinaku'ma aza vahera knare kavukva zana antevite nezmantenka asomura hunezmantake'za maka vahe'mo'za nezamagaze.
Ha' vahe'mo'zama zamahe'zama nehazagenka Ra Anumzamoka zamazeri franekinka, zamagipinti'ma huhavizama nehazagenka zamazeri fra'nekine.
Ra Anumzamofona ra agi erisga hanue. Na'ankure ha' vahe'nimo'zama mani'noa rankumama avazagi kagizageno'a, Agra vagaore avesizama'areti nagu'vazi'ne.
Hagi antrima nehu'na amanage hu'noe, Ra Anumzana atre'na nagra ogama afete e'noe hu'na hu'noe. Hianagi naza huogu'ma krafagema huana antahinka naza hu'nane.
Anumzamofo vahe'mota Ra Anumzamofona tamavesinteho. Na'ankure Ra Anumzamo'a Agri'ma avariri fatgoma nehaza vahera hazenkema erizankura kegava hunezmante'anagi, zamavufaga rama nehaza vahera zamazeri havizantfa nehie.
Ra Anumzamofonte'ma amuha'ma nehaza vahe'mota korora osu hankavetita maniho.

Agra, Ra Anumzamo hagerina repapa higeno magokepina umareno moriri huno marerigeno, tinkerifima tima afinteankna huno hagerina magokepi renatinte'ne.

Hagi tagra zagemo'ma rentegeno vahe'mofo ame'ma'ama fore'ma hiaza hu'nonankita, amuhoma huta eritruma hu'na zamo'a amnezankna nehie. Fenoma eritruma nehuna zana, ina vahe'mo erisantiharegahie ontahineta eritru nehune.
