Hanki kumini'afintira nagu'nevazinka, atregeno neginagi vahe'mo'za kizazokago kea huonanteho.
Hagi nagira hamunki'na kea osu manigahue. Na'ankure Kagra knazana nenamine.
Hianagi muse hugantoanki knazama nenamina zana hanki eritro. Hazenkema namina zamo'a tusiza huno nazeri haviza hianki natro.
Hagi kumi'ma huna zante'ma knazama tamina zamo'a, zago'amo marerirfa zama antenonkeno hakanomo'ma tragama hiankna huno, tazeri haviza nehie. Maka vahe'mota tagra asimu'ma antegeno'ma vahe'mofo agipinti'ma amu'ma atiramiankna hu'nonankita, ame huta fanane hugahune.
Ra Anumzamoka nunamuni'a antahio! Naza huogu'ma zavi'ma netoana krafageni'a antahinamio! Zavi'ma netogeno'ma navunumo'ma nehiazana keamnea osuo. Na'ankure nagra nantu vahekna hu'na ama mopafina e'noankina nagehemo'zama hu'nazaza hu'na ko fri'na vugahue.
Hanki karimpama ahenenantana zana natrege'na, osi'a knafina musena hu'na mani'nena fri'na va'neno.

Hagi Ra Anumzamo'ma nzama hanigura akohe'na avega ante'na mani'nogeno, Agra rukrahe hunamino zavi krafageni'a antahi'ne.
Ana nehuno hapake kerifima antahintahi hakarema nehu'na mani'nogeno, navazu husga huno havere nantege'na, oti hankaveti'na oti'noe.
Ana huteno Anumzantimofo agima erisgama hu' zagamera kasefa zagame nami'ne. E'ina hu'neana vahe'mo'zama nege'za Ra Anumzamofoma koro'ma hunte'za Agrite'ma zamentintima hanagu anara hu'ne.
Hanki zamavufaga rama nehaza vahete'ene havi anumzante'ma zamentintima nehaza vahete'ma amema renti osuno, Ra Anumzamofonte'ma amentintima hanimo'a, agra muse hugahie.
Ra Anumzana nagri Anumzamoka vahe'mota osugaza rama'a hentofa zantamina hurante'nane. Tagri'ma hurante'nana zantmimofo antahintahima retro'ma huntenana antahintahia, rama'agino avompina krentegara osu'ne. Hanki mago vahe'mo'a kagri knara osu'ne. Kagrama hentofa zantmima hu'nana zantmima hampri'nama kesuana ana makara hampri vagaoregosue.
Hagi kresramnama nevuno ofama hu zankura musena nosane. Hanki menina nazeri ani hanke'na antahi ani' hue. Kagra tevefima kre fananehu ofane kumi ofagura nantahinonkane.
Hagi anante nagra amanage hu'noe, ko, Nagra ama oe. Anumzamofo avontafepina nagriku hu'za avona krente'naze.
Anumzanimoka kagri kavesi'ma avaririzanku muse nehue. Hagi kasegeka'amo'a tumonifi me'ne.
Nagra fatgo kavukava zanka'a eri fraraoki'na, ana maka vaheka'a zamasami'noe. Ra Anumzamoka Kagra kenka antahinka hu'nane, nagra vahekura korora hu'na nagira hamunki'na omani'noanki vahe'ma zmagu'ma vazi'nana zana huama hu'na vahe kevua zamasmi'noe.
Hagi fatgo kavukava'ma nehana zanka'a nagu'afina atrogenora frakino omne'ne. Hanki kema hu'nana kere'ma amage'ma antenka vahe'ma zamagu'ma nevazina hihamuka'amofo agenkea eriama hu'na zamasmi'noe. Hagi tusi'a vahekrerfa mani'nazafi eriama hu'na vagaore kavesi zamofone, kema hu'nana kere'ma otinenka ana zama hu kavukavara eriama hu'na zamasmi'noe.
Hanki Ra Anumzamoka, kasunkuma hunenantana zana azeorinka, vagaore kavesizane ke'ma hunana kere'ma amage'ma antenka ana zama hu kavukava zamo'a kegava hunantegahie.
Na'ankure ohampriga'a hazenkemo kaginante'ne. Hagi kuminimo'a agonagna huno marerineno kama vanuankana rehiza hunantenege'na, ke'zanku nehue. Ana nehu'na kuminimofo nampamo'a nasenifima me'nea zamo'a nazokamofo nampana azeri agateregeno hankaveni'a omne amne hie.
Hanki Ra Anumzamoka muse hugantoanki nagu'vazio! Ra Anumzamoka ame hunka enka nazahuo!
Hanki nagri'ma nahe frinaku'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za zamagazegu nehanageno antahintahizmimo'a savari hugahie. Hanki hazenkefima mani'noge'zama musema nehaza vahe'mo'za zamagazegu hugahaze.
Hanki hunte'za nagiza nere'za, ehe ehe! hu'zama nehaza vahe'mo'za zamagazegu hugahaze.
Hianagi maka vahe'mo'za Kagri'ma negavaririza vahe'mo'za Kagri'enena muse hu'za manigahaze. Kagrama zamagu'mavazi'nana zanku'ma zamave'nesia vahe'mo'za, Ra Anumzamo'a marerisa Anumza mani'ne hu'za hiho.
Hanki nagra namunte omne kne mani'noankino, Ra Anumzamo'a nagrikura agesa antahinami vava nehie. Ra Anumzanimoka Kagra nazahu ne'maninka nagu'vazi ne' mani'nananki, ame hunka eme nazahuo.

Hagi zamunte omne vahe'ma knare zamavu'zmava'ma hunezmantaza vahera hazenke zama esigeno'a, Ra Anumzamo'a zamagu'vazigahie.
Ra Anumzamo'a zamagu nevazino zamaza hanige'za ofri'za knare hu'za manigahaze. Ana nehuno zamaza hanige'za maka zama hanaza zamo'a knare nehinkeno, ha' vahe'mo'zama zamahenaku'ma hanageno'a zamagu'vazigahie.
Hagi krima erizageno'a, Ra Anumzamo'a kegava hunezmanteno krizmia zamazeri negnamare.
Ra Anumzamokarega nunamuna nehuanki kasunku hunantenka nazeri kanamaro. Na'ankure osuo hunkama hu'nana kumi hu'noe.
Hianagi ha' vahe'nimo'za huhaviza hunante'za amanage nehaze, nazupa frinigeta tagera akanigahune?
Zamagra ronenimo'zama nantu'ma ante'nantazankna hu'za nantu ante nante'nazanagi, havigema hu'za nagenkema hanagu nanekea emerite'za vu'za nagenkea ome hugantikma nehaze.
Zamago'ma ante'nenantaza vahe'mo'za nazeri haviza hu kea sumi sumi hu'za nanekea ananeki'za,
agra havi kri erino tafe'arera mase'neankino onkanamregosie hu'za nehaze.
Knare aronenima mani'negena antahima nemina, magopinti'ma ne'zama neno'a vahe'mo'a amefi hunenamie.
Hianagi Ra Anumzamoka kasunku hunantenka krini'a nazeri knamrege'na ana vahera nona huzmantaneno.
Nazama hananke'na ha' vahe'ni'ama ha'ma huzmagateresu'na, Kagra muse hunenantane hu'na hugahue.
Ra Anumzamoka nagrira hazenkeni'a omne vahe mani'nogu hunka, maka zupa kavuga nantanke'na mani' vava nehue.
Ra Anumzana Israeli vahe Anumzana mani'neno manivava Anumzanki, huta agi'a ahentesga hanune. Tamage, tamage.

Dia afumo'ma tinku'ma ave'nesigeno tinku'ma hakeno vanoma nehiaza hu'na Anumzamokagura nagu'amo'a tusiza huno ave'nesie.
Tinku'ma ave'nesigenoma hiaza huno nagu'amo'a kasefa'ma huno mani'nea Anumzamofonkura nave'nesige'na nazupa agri avurera vugahue hu'na nagesa nentahue.
Hanine zagenena zavi'ma netogeno navunuma hiazamo'a nezaniagna nehigeno, ha' vahenimo'za hu'za kagri Anumzana iga mani'ne? hu'za hu'naze.
Hagi mono'ma hunegantona knare'ma, ko'ma vahe kevuma zamavare'na mono nonka'afima, nevuge'zama zagamema hu'za musenkasema nehaza zanku'ma nagesa nentahugeno, tumonimo'a netanie.
Hagi nagafare nagu'amo'a kna nehie? Nagafare tumo'nimo'a netanege'na nasunkura nehue? Nagra Anumzamokare namentintia nehuanki'na, Agrama nagu'mavazi'nea zanku agia ahentesga hugahue.
Hagi menina nagu'amo'a kna nehianagi, Jodani mopafima ogantuma me'nea Hemoni agonare'ene Misa agonare mani'nena Anumzanimokagura nagesa antahimigahue.
Hagi hagerimo'ma knafu knafu'ma huno agasasama neriankna huno, knazamo'a eme narefinete.
Hianagi mago mago kna Ra Anumzamo'a vagaore avesizama'areti avesinentege'na, mago mago kenegera zagamera hu'na agia erisga nehu'na, nasimu'ma namige'nama mani'noa Anumzamofontega nunamuna nehue.
Hagi nagra Anumzanimofontega krafagea hu'na, Anumzanimoka hankave havegani'a mani'nananki, nahigenka kagerakaninenantane? Na'a hige'za ha' vahenimo'za nazeri haviza nehazage'na nasuzampina vano nehue?
Hagi maka kna ha' vahenimo'zama kefinti'ma nazeri haviza nehu'za, iga Anumzanka'a mani'ne hu'zama haza zamo'a zaferinani'a ruhantagi'za rufuzafunepaze.
Nahigeno nagu'amo'a kna huno evuneramie? Hagi nahige'na nasuzampina mani'na nevue? Nagra Anumzamo'ma nazama hanigu amuhara hugahue! Nagu'mavazi ne', Anumzanimofona mago'ene zagamera hu'na agia erisga hugahie.
Anumzanimoka nagrikura fatgo avu'ava'ane ne' mani'ne hunka vahepina huama huo. Kagri'ma nogavariri'za vahe'mo'zama keagama hunenantenagenka nagri kazika antenka nazahu keaga hunka naza huo. Fatgo huzama refkoma nosaza vahe'mo'zama havigema hunentazana nagu'vazio.
Na'ankure Anumzanimoka Kagra fraki vihuni'a mani'nane. Nahigenka natufetranke'za, ha' vahe'mo'za knazana nenamizage'na nasuzampina vanovano nehue?
Hagi Anumzamoka masazanka'ane tamage nanekeka'a atregeno kana naveri huno navareno ruotge agonaka'a, Saionima nemanintega vino.
E'ina'ma hnanke'na kre sramanavu itaka'are vu'na nazeri musema nehana Anumzanimoka hapu zavena ome ahe'na zagamera hu'na kagia erisga hugahue.
Nahigeno nagu'amo'a kna huno evuneramie? Hagi nahige'na nasuzampina mani'na nevue? Nagra Anumzamo'ma nazama hanigu amuhara hugahue! Nagu'mavazi'nea Anumzanimofona mago'ene zagamera hu'na agia erisga hugahue.

Anumzamoka korapa'ma nazano tagehe'mokizmima huzmante'nana zana ko tasamizageta tagra tagesafinti antahi'none.
Kagra hihamu ka'anu ama mopafima nemaniza vahetmina zamahe kasope netrenka, ana maka mopafina tagehemokizmia avimazavi hankreankna hanke'za mani'naze. Kagra ha' vahetia zamahe hana hanke'za ama mopa tagehe'moza eri'za knare hu'za mani'naze.
Hagi tagehemo'za bainati kazintetira ha' vahera harahu zamagatere'za ama mopa e'ori'naze. Huge zamagra'a hankaverera hara hu zamagateore'naze. Hanki Kagri hankavenentake tamaga kazamo'ene kavugosafinti masamo zamaza hu'ne. Na'ankure Kagra kavesizmante'nane.
Kagra nagri kini mani'nenka, nagri Anumzana mani'nane. Kagra hanke'za Israeli vahe'mo'za ha' vahe'zmia hara huzmagatere'naze.
Kagri hankavefi ha' vahetia hara huta zamatufeta ometre emetre nehuta, Kagri kagireti ha'ma hurantenaku'ma hanaza vahera zamagofetura tagia reta zmare hapakopatigahune.
Hagi atini'agura antahinomi'na, kazinknoni'amo'a nagu'vazigahie hu'na amuhara hunomue.
Na'ankure Kagrake'za taza hanketa, ha' vahetia hara huzmagaterenone. E'ina hunka zamavaresrama hunerantaza vahera zamazeri zamagaze hu'nane.
Hagi maka kna nanterantetima vuno kinagama omeseana Anumzamokagu akagia nereta, zagamera huta kagia erisga nehune.
Hagi menina kamefi huraminka tatrankeno ha' vahe'mo'za tazeri tagaze nehaze. Ko'ma ha'ma hunaku'ma nevunkenkama nehanaza hunka tagri'enena hatera vunka ome taza nosane.
Hagi tatranketa ha' vahetimofo koro nefronke'za, ha' vahetimo'za rohu eme tre'za keonke'zantia e'nerize.
Hagi tatrankeno ha' vahe'mo'za sipisipi afu'ma ahe'za nenaku'ma hiankna hu'za nerahe'za tahe panani hazageta vahe mopafina hazagreta umani emani hu'none.
Hagi marerifa vaheka'a osi'a zagore atrenka mago zagoa retrora osu'nane.
Kagra tatranke'za tava'ontire'ma nemaniza vahe'mo'za kiza zokago kea hurante'naze. Hagi tagri mopa atupa ometre emetrema hu'neregama manigagi'naza vahe'mo'za kizazokago ke hunerante'za tazeri haviza nehaze.
Tagrira kizazokago ke hunteza tazeri retro hanke'za, zamagena neru'za kizazokago hurante'za tazeri fenkami netraze.
Maka kna hugeforenenantazage'na, tusi nagazegu nehu'na vano nehue.
Hagi maka kema antahunana kizazokago kema hurantaza kege nentahita, ha' vahetimo'zama nonama hu'za ha'ma hurante'zama nehaza zanke negone.
Kagrira tamefira hugamita huhagerafi huvempa keka'a ha'ontaginonanagi, ama ana zantamimo'a tagritera fore nehie.

Hagi Ra Anumzamoka otinka taza huo! Nahigenka kavura nevasane? Kagera kanirante vava osunka otinka tazahuo.
Nahigenka ke'amnea nehane? Tatama tami'za tazeri havizama nehazageta knafima mani'nonana nahigenka Anumzamoka ontage vahe knara nehane?

Anumzamoka kini traka'amo'a mevava hugahie. Fatgoma huno keagama refkoma nehana azompaka'anu vahera kegava nehane.
Kagra fatgoma huno keagama refkoma hu zanku kave'nesinka kefo avu'avazankura kavesra nehane. E'ina hu'negu Anumzana Kagri Anumzamo'a masavena kasenifina tagino kazeri ruotgera nehuno, musezamofo masavena mago'a vahera rugatereno kagritera rama'a taginte'ne.
Hagi merema nehaza mnazamofo mnama, aloveramofo mnama, kasiema nehaza zamofo mnamo'a kini vahe'mo'za za'za kukenaka'a eri mnanentake hugahie. Hagi elefanti aveteti'ma kinte'naza kini vahe kumapina strini nofite'ma rente'za nehaza zavena nehe'za kazeri muse nehaze.
Kini ne'mofo mofa'nemoza agima me'nea anene mani'naze. Hagi kuini a'mo'a Ofiri kumateti eri'naza golireti trohu'naza zantaminu avasasea hu'neno kazantamaga kaziga oti'ne.
Kini netema maniku'ma nehana mofamoka kama kagesa antenenka antahio. Keonke zagaka'ama kumaka'aregama zamatrenka e'nanana kagekanio.

Ama mopafima me'nea kumatamimpintira vahe'ma azeri agore hu agasasaneranigeno, kini vahe'mo'zama kegavama hu'naza kumatmimo'zanena fuzafupe'za amane zankna hugahaze. Hanki Anumzamo'ma ageru'ma aranigeno'a, tevemo'ma plastikima temramra'ma hiaza huno ama mopamo'a maramra hu'ne.

Hagi ama mopafi kini vahe'mo'za sondia vahezmia erimago hu'za ana rankumara hara hunte'naku urava'o nehaze.
Hianagi e'zama eme nege'za antri nehu'za, tusi zamagogogu nehu'za, atre'za koro fre'naze.
Zamagrira tusi zamahirahi nerege'za, a'nemo'za mofavre kasenteku zamatagu nehazankna hu'naze.
Hagi kagra zage hanati kazigati hanavenentake zaho'mo Tasisi kumate hanave venterami eri tagana taganu vazitreankna hunka kagra zamahe vagare'nane.
Ke'age nehazageta ana rankumamofo konarari'agura antahi'nonanagi, Monafi sondia vahe'mofo Ra Anumzamofo rankumara menina tagra tavufinti kone. E'i ana kumara tagri Anumzamofo rankumakino Agra'a kegava huvava hugahie.
Anumzamoka mono nonka'afina mani'neta, vagaore kavesizantetima kavesinerantana zankura tagesa antahinegamune.
Anumzamoka kagi'amo'ma hu'neaza hu'za zagame'ma hu'za kagima erisgama hanaza zamo'a mopa atumparega vuno eno hugahie. Hanavenentake tamaga kazampina fatgo avu'avazamo avite'ne.
Saioni agonafi nemaniza veamo'za muse nehanage'za, Juda mopafima me'nea kumatamimpima nemaniza vahe'mo'za muse hiho. Na'ankure Kagra fatgo kavukvama hunka vahe'ma refkoma nehana kavukava zanku anara hugahaze.
Saioni rankumara kaginka negenka, mani'neza kuma'ma kegavama nehaza za'za nontamima kinte'nazana hamprinka ko.
Kuma vihuma kino mareri'nea zana negenka, fraki hankave vihu keginama hu'nea kumara ketenka, henkama efore hu'za esnaza vahera nanekea zamasmio.
Na'ankure Anumzamo'a e'inahu hu'ne. Agra manivava Anumzanti mani'neankino, Agra kegava hurante'nenigeta manime vuta ufrigahune.

Nanekema hanuana maka vahe'motma nentahinkeno, ama mopafima mani'naza maka vahe'mo'zanena zamagesa ante'za antahiho!
Marerifa vahe'ma, tami vahe'ma, feno vahe'ma, tamunte omne vahe'motanena antahiho!
Na'ankure knare antahi'zamofo naneke huama nehugeno, nagu'afina antahi ama' hu antahizamo avite'ne.
Nagra knare antahi'zamofo nanekegu nagesa ante'na nentahi'na, hapu zavena nehe'na, fraki nanekea zagamepi erinte ama hu'na hugahue.
Hazenke zama ne-enigeno, ha' vahe'mo'zama eme navazagi kagisazana, nahanige'na nagra korora hugahue?
Zamagra fenoma ante'naza zante zamentintia nehu'za, tusi zago fenoma ante'naza zanku zamavufa ra hu'za akagi neraze.
Tagra antahi'none, mago vahe'mo'a frizampintira agra'a aguravazige, Anumzamofona atesinteno nefuna ovaregosie.
Mago mizantetira vahe'mo'a atesino, agra'a agu'vazigara osu'ne. Na'ankure mago mizantetira mizaseno,
frino onkasarino, manivava huno ovugosie.
Negonke'za knare antahi'zane vahe'mo'za nefrizageno, ana hukna hu'za neginagi vahe'ene antahintahi omne vahe'mo'zanena nefrizage'za, ru vahe'mo'za ana vahe'mokizmi fenozana erisanti neharaze.
Ana vahe'mo'za rama'a mopa eri'za zamagia ana mopazmirera asamregahazanagi, matimati'mo'a manivava nonkumazmi senige'za fri'za matipi umanigahaze.
Hagi fenoma antene'za ra zamagima e'neriza vahe'mofo zamagimo'a zazatera meno ovugahianki, zagagafama fri fananema nehiaza hu'za fri'nageno, zamagimo'a fanane hugahie.
Hagi knare vahe mani'none hu'za neginagi vahe'mo'zama nehaza vahete'ene, ana vahe'mokizmi kere'ma zamentintima nehaza vahete ama anazana fore hugahie.
Sipisipi afute kva vahe'mo, sipisipi afutami zamavareno viaza huno fri'zamo'a zamavareno fri vahe kumapina vugahie. Hagi nanteramasena Anumzamofo vahe'mo'za kegava huzmantegahaze. Kumazmimofona afete'are matipi zamavufagamo'a kasrigahie.
Hianagi nagrira nagu'nevazino, fri'zamofo hihamufintira Anumzamo'a eri varino navaregahie.
Hagi vahe'mo'zama rama'a fenoma ante'za hage'za mareneri'nageno, nonkumazmifima knare zantmimo'ma avimatesia zankura korora osiho.
Na'ankure zamagrama frisageno'a, maka fenozamimo'a amanezankna hugahiankino, anazana eri'ne'za fri kantega ovugahaze.
Kasefama huno mani'nea knafina maka zampina knare hu'noe huno agra'a husga nehanigeno, vahe'mo'zanena humuse huntegahaze.
Hianagi ko'ma zamagehe'zama hu'nazaza hu'za fri'za nevu'za mago'enena zagemo'ma remsa hania masa onkegahaze.
Hagi fenozmigu'ma akagima neraza vahe'mo'za zamagra maka zana antahi anira nosazanki'za, afukra friaza huza frigahaze.
Ra Anumzana Hankavenentake Anumzamo'a zage fre kazigati evuno zage hanati kazigama evu'nea vahekrerfa ke huno eritru nehie.
Saioni kumara konarari'amo agatererfa kuma me'neankino, Anumzamofo masazamo'a remsa huno ana kumapinti enevie.
Hagi Anumzantimo'ma esiana agasasane egahiankino, maka zama tefanene hu tevemo avuga neresigeno, tusi ununko netanifi Agra egahie.
Agra monane mopane ke hanigeno emanineke negesakeno, Agra'a vahera keaga huzmanteno refkoa huzmantegahie.
Nagri'ma zamagu'aretima hu'za namage'ma nente'za, huhagerafi huvempa kema hune'za nagrite'ma kresramnama vunenantaza vahera ke huge'za eho.
Hagi fatgoma huno refkoma hu avu'ava zama'agura monamo'a huama hino. Na'ankure Anumzamo'a Agra'a keaga refko hugahie.
Nagrama kema hanuana vahe'nimota kama antahiho. Ama'na zantminte Israeli vahe'mota huama huramantegahue. Nagra Anumzankina, tamagri Anumza mani'noe!
Tamagrama kresramnama nevaza zantero, tevefima krefanane hu ofama nagri navugama erita evavama nehaza zantera keaga huoramantegahue.
Hianagi bulimakao afu keginaka'afinti ve bulimakao afukuro, meme afu keginaka'afinti ve meme afukura avrenka eno hu'na osugahue.
Na'ankure zafa avo'nompima maka zagagafama mani'nazana nagrike zaga manizageno, tauseni'a agonaramimpima mani'naza bulimakao afutamina nagrike suza mani'naze.
Maka namaramima agonafima mani'nazana nagra kena antahina nehugeno, maka zagagafama hofa avo'nompima vanoma nehaza zagaramina nagrike suza mani'naze.
Hanki Nagri'ma naga'ma tenige'na mago zankura tamagrira tamantahi onkegahue. Na'ankure maka zama ama mopafima me'neana, nagrike zantaminke me'naze.
Nagra ve bulimakao afutamimofo ame'ane, ve meme afu'tmimofo koranena nenofi?
Marerirfa Anumzamofonte'ma huvempama hu'nana naneke avaririnka, musenkase huno susu'ma hunte ofa Anumzamofona hunto.
Ana nehunka hazenkefima ufresunka nagritega nunamuna huge'na kaguvazinugenka, nagrira ra nagia namigahane.
Hianagi Anumzamo'a kefo zamavu'zmava'ma nehaza vahetminkura huno, tamagra kasegeni'a huamara hugara osu'nazanki nagafare kasege'ni'a huamara nehuta, huhagerafi huvempa kea tamagitetikera nehaze?
Na'ankure tamazeri fatgoma nehugeta tamavesra hunenanteta, anankeni'a tamamefi humita amagera nontaze.
Musufa vahe'ma nezamageta, zamazeri rone nehuta, ru vahe'mofo aro, vema azeri savri huno anteno nemasea vahetamine tragoteta nemanize.
Tamagipina, kefo avu'avazama hu nanekemo avitegeno, havigema hu nanekege tamagefu'nafintira atineramie.
Tamagra zogitru huta mani'neta tamafuhe'i zamagenke nehuta, neramarera nemofo neramafuna havige hunezmantaze.
E'ina'ma nehazage'na nege'na kema nosugeta, tamagrama antahi'zana, Anumzamo'a tagrikna hu'ne huta nehaze. Hianagi menina maka'zama hu'narera keaga huramantegahue.
Hagi Anumzamofonku'ma tamage'ma nekaniza vahe'mota kama antahiho, tamagu'a rukrahe huta tamasunku hiho. Hanki ana'ma osnazana, tamahe'na rutagana taganu vazitranena vahe'mo'za tamaza osugahaze.
Hianagi muse nehuno susu hu ofama hunenantea vahe'mo'a, Anumzamo'na ra nagi nenamianki'na, agu'mavazisua kana averi hugahue.


Anumzamoka kasunku hunanto. Vagaore kavesizanteti rama'a kasunku hunantenka kumini'a eritre vagaro.
Kefo avu'avazani'a sese hunantenka nazeri avusese nehunka, kumini'a sese hunka nazeri agru huo.
Na'ankure nagra kumini'a ke'na antahi'na hu'nogeno, maka zupa antahintahifina eri'zana e'nerie.
Nagra kagri kea hantagi'na ha' renegante'na, kagri kavurera kumi hu'noe. E'ina hu'noankinka tamage hunantenka fatgo kazigati refko hunka keaga hunenantane.
Nagra kumi vahe mani'nogeno, nenrera'a kasenante'ne. Na'ankure nenrera arimpafina kumi vahe fore hu'noe.
Hianagi tamage nanekemo'a nagu'afi avitesie hunka Kagra kagesa nentahine. E'ina hu'negu knare antahi'zana nagu'afina rempi hunamio.
Kumini'a hisopureti nazeri agru huge'na agru ha'neno. Sese hunka nazeri agru huge'na, efeke hamponkna ha'neno.
Hanki ete musenkasema huno mani avu'ava zana namigeno, nazeri fru hina ruhantaginana zaferinanimo'za musenkasena hiho.
Kumini'arera ketenka omaninka, kefo avu'avazani'a eri atre vagarenanto.
Anumzamoka agru tumo nagu'afina tro hunenantenka, Kagrite'ma mani fatgoma hu'za nagu'afina antenanto.
Kavugatira nahenati notrenka, Ruotge Avamuka'a nagu'afintira eri otro.
Nagu'ma vazinkenama musema hunoakna musezana ete nenaminka, keka'ama antahino kavariri navesi zana namio.
E'ina'ma hananke'na kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmia kagri kavukavara rempi huzminuge'za, kumi vahe'mo'za ete kagrite rukrahe hu'za egahaze.
Vahe'ma ahe'na korama eri tagi'noa kumira Anumzamoka apase nenantenka nagu'vazio. Ana'ma hananke'na fatgo kavukvama hunka nagu'ma vazi'nana zankura, musenkasena hu'na zagamera hugahue.
Ra Anumzamoka nagira eri o'za huge'na, zagamera hu'na kagia ahentesga ha'neno.
Na'ankure nagra ofa erina eme kamigahuanagi, kre fanene hu ofagura musena nosane. Kagrite'ma kre fananehu ofama kresramnama vuzankura kave'nosie.
Hagi kagri'ma kavenesia kresramna vu ofa, e'i avufgama anteramino mani'zane. Avufgama anteramino nemanino agua'retima huno asunku'ma huno agu'ama rukrahema nehia vahera Anumzamoka kamefira hunomine.
Kagra kavesintenka Saioni rankumara azeri knare nehunka, Jerusalemi kumamofo kegina huo.
Ana hutenka mani fatgo hu'za mani'neza fatgo avu'ava'ma hu'za kresramna vanaza ofagi, tevefima kre fananehu ofagi, maka zagagafama tevefi krefanene hu ofagi, bulimakao afu'ma kresramna vu itaka'arema kresramna vu ofagura musena hugahane.


Hankavenentake sondia ne'moka, nagafare kefo avu'ava zama nehana zankura kavufga rana nehane? Hagi Anumzamo'ma fatgo avu'ava'ma huno, maka knafima nevia zankura kagesa nontahino?
Maka kna vahe'ma azeri haviza hu antahintahige retro nehunka, havigema huno vahe'ma azeri haviza hu kemo'a asane'nea resagna huno kagipintira atineramie.
Kagra knare avu'ava zama kavesi nentana avamena agaterenka, havi avu'ava'zana kavesi nentenka, tamage kema kavesi nentanama'a agaterenka havigea kavesinentane.
Knare osu keka'aretima vahe'ma azeri havizama hu'zanku kavenesia nekinka, kagra havige ne' mani'nane!
Hianagi Anumzamo'a kahe fanane hanigenka, ru'enena omanigosane. Traza vatitreankna huno nonkuma ka'afintira Anumzamo'a kavazu hutrena ru'enena mopafina omanigahane.
Fatgo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za nege'za, zamagogogu hugahaze. Anazama kagrite'ma fore'ma hanige'za negenu'za, kagiza nere'za amanage hugahaze,
Anumzamo naza hugahie huno antahi omino, agra'a hankavegu'ma nehia hankavenentake sondia nete'ma fore'ma nehia zana keho. Agra'a feno zante amentinti nehuno, ru vahe'mokizmia hanavetino kefo avu'ava'zana huzmante vava huno nevie.
Hianagi nagra Anumzamofo nompina olivi zafamo tretre huno amu mareankna nehuanki'na, maka kna Anumzamofo vagaore avesizante namentintia huvava hugahue.
Knare kavukva'ma hunantana zankura Anumzamoka kagia erisga huvava nehu'na, Kagri kagire amuhara hugahue. Na'ankure Kagri kagimo'a, knare zantfa hu'ne. Kavariri fatgoma nehaza vahe'mokizmi zamavufi kagri kagia nagra husga hugahue.

Neginagi vahe'mo'zage zamagu'afina anagea nehaze, Anumzana omani'ne hu'za zamagesa nentahize. E'inahu vahera ko haviza hu'nazanki'za zamavuzmava zmimo'a kefoza hu'neankino, magomo'e huno knare avu'ava zana nosie.
Anumzamo'a monafinka mani'neno, iza ama' antahi'zane vahera ama mopafina mani'neno, agrira amagera nentefi huno, kefenkma atreno maka vahera nerage.
Hianagi magore huno fatgo vahera omani'neanki maka vahe'mota Anumzamofona tamagena humita havizantfa hu'none. Maka vahe'ma mani'nonana kefo avu'avake hunkeno mago'mo'e huno fatgo vahera omani'ne.
Ana kefo zamavu'zmavama nehaza vahe'mo'za magore hu'za rempia hu'za nontahize. Hanki bretima neankna hu'za nagri vahera zamahe'za nene'za Anumzamofontegama nunamuma hu'zankura zamagesa nontahize.
Hianagi tusi koro nehu'za zamagogofena, ha'ma regantesaza vahe'mokizmi zaferina herafi atregahie. E'ina hanigenka kagra zamazeri zamagaze hugahane. Na'ankure Anumzamo'a amagena huzmino zamatregahie.
Hanki Israeli vahe'ma zamagu'ma vazisia ne'mo'a Saioni agonaregati'ma esiana knare hugahie. Hanki Anumzamo'ma Agra vahe'ama eme zamavareno ete zamazeri so'ema hanigeno'a, Jekopu naga'mo'za ranke hu'za zagamera hu'za musena nehanageno, Israeli vahe'mo'zanena musenkase hugahaze.


Anumzamoka kagika'areti nagu'vazio. Hankanaveka'anu nagu'a refko hunka nago.
Anumzanimoka nunamu keni'a nentahinka, nanekema kasami'nuana kagesa antenka antahio.
Na'ankure ru vahe'ma emani vahe'mo'za hara renantazageno, vahe'ma zamazeri havizama nehaza vahe'mo'za nahefri'za nehaze. Zamagra Anumzamofonkura antahi amaneza nesaze.
Hianagi Anumzamo nazahu nera mani'ne. Agra naza hige'na kasefa hu'na mani'noe.
Ha' vahe'nimo'zama nagri'ma nazeri haviza hu antahintahima retro'ma haza antahintahia, eri arukrahe hugeno, zamagri zamazeri haviza hino. Anumzamoka kagrama huvempama hunana kante antenka, ana vahetmina zamahe fri vagarege'za mago'enena ama mopafina omaniho.
Ra Anumzamoka nagra navesite kagritera ofa kresramna nevu'na, susu hugante'na kagia ahentesga hugahue. Na'ankure e'inama hanuana knare hu'ne!
Na'ankure kagra maka hazenkenifintira nagu nevazinka, nazahanke'na ha' vahe'ni'aramina hara huzmagatere'noe.

Anumzamoka naza huogu'ma nunamuma nehuana antahi amnea osunka, kagesa antenka nunamuni'a antahinamio.
Muse hugantoanki, nunamuni'a antahinaminka kenona hunanto. Na'ankure hazenke zamo'a nazeri haviza hige'na kragira nerue.
Ha' vahe'nimo'za kezati'za rankege hunenantage'za, kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za knazana nami'za nazeri haviza nehu'za, tusi zamarimpa ahenenantaze.
E'ina'ma hazageno'a tumonimo'a faki faki nehige'na, fri'zankura tusi koro nehue.
Tusi nagogo nefegeno koro zamo'ene nahirahimo'enena nahenefrie.
Maho namamofoma hiaza hunora nagekona huntenege'na, hare'na knare'ma hu'nea kumatega mani fruma hu'na umanuresina knare hisine.
Nagra hare'na afete'are ka'ma kokampi umanuresine.
Ununkomo'ene zasi komo'ma hifintira, nagra ame hu'na fre'na afete ome fraki'na umanuresine.
Ra Anumzamoka ha' vahe'nimozama retroma nehaza antahintahia eri savri hunka eri haviza huo. Na'ankure vahe'ma azeri haviza hu avu'avazane, mani fru osu avu'avaza rankumapina negoe.
Hanine zagenena ku'ma keginare vano nehu'za kegava nehazanagi, tamage huno ha'zamo'ene kefo avu'ava zamo'a kuma agu'afina avite'ne.
Maka zama eri haviza hu'zamo ama ana kuma amu'nompina megeno, vahe'ma knama amino azeri haviza nehuno, revatgama hu avu'avazamo'a ana kumara atreno novie.
Ha' vahe'nimozama huhaviza hunantazasina, nagra ana zankura nagesa ontahuresine. Hagi ha' vahe'nimo'zama ha'ma eme hunantazaresina nagra frakuresine.
Hianagi mago avamente'ma manino'a ne'moka anara nehane. Kagra nagri'enema tagrotenka vanoma nehankena, kagena antahina hu'noa navate ronenimoka anara nehane.
Korapara kagranena knare huta magopi nemanita, tusi'a vahe'ma Anumzamofo mono nontegama nevazafima magokama nevu'ane.
Ha' vahe'ni'aramina atregeno antri hanazaza huno fri'zamo'a zmavatera ne-enkeno, matimo'a zamavu aga zmasgahu nakarino. Na'ankure kefo zamavu'zmava zamo'a zamagu'afina nonkino me'ne.
Hianagi Anumzamofonku kea hanugeno, Ra Anumzamo'a nagu'vazigahie.
Knazani'afima mani'nena nanterane, feru'ene kenage'enena krafagea nehugeno, Ra Anumzamo'a antahi nenamie.
Ra ha'pintira nahokeno ete nagu'vazine. Na'ankure rama'a ha' vahe maninazafinti naza huno navare'ne.
Anumzana Agra kini mani vava huno ne-ea kini ne'mo krafage'ni'a antahino zamazeri haviza hugahie. Na'ankure nagri ha' vahe'mo'za zamavu'zmavara rukrahera osuge, Anumzamofona korora huntegera nosaze.
Ronenimo'a ha'renanteno huhagerafi huvempagema hu'neana ruhanentagie.
Naneke'amo'a batagna huno frufru hu'neanagi, agu'afina ha'ma hu'za me'ne. Naneke'amo'a olivi masavenkna huno frufru hu'neanagi, agu'afina asane bainati kazi me'ne.
Knazanka'a Ra Anumzamofo azampi antegeno, Agra knazanka'a e'nerino kazeri hanavetino. Agra fatgo zamavu'zmava'ma nehaza vahera zamatrenige'za regarari'za trakara osugahaze.
Hianagi Anumzamoka kefo zamavu'zmava'ma nehaza vahera zamavarenka hazenke zamofo kerifi zamatregahane. Hagi vahe'ma zamahe nefri'za vahe'mo'zane krunagema nehaza vahe'mo'zanena kasefa vahe mani'ne'za ko frigahaze. Hianagi nagra Kagriku antahi negamina namentintia nehue.

Anumzamoka kasunku hunanto, na'ankure vahe'mo'za nahe'za narotago nehaze. Maka kna ha' vahenimo'za nazeri havizantfa nehaze.
Ha' vahe'nimo'za nahenaku knane knanena nenavararizageno, zamavufaga ra hanaza kazigati rama'a vahe'mo'za hara eme hunenantaze.
Hianagi koro'ma hanua knafina, Kagrite namentintia hugahue.
Anumzamo'ma huvempama hu'nea kere namentintia nehu'na, agia ahentesga nehue. Nagra Anumzamofonte namentintia nehuankina, na'a hanigena amne vahetfankura korora hugahue?
Nagrama hua nanekea zamagra eri rukrahe nehu'za, nazeri haviza hunaku maka kna mani'ne'za oku'a kea retro nehaze.
Nagri'ma nazeri'za nahenakura, oku'a kea retro hu'za kafona ante'za vano nehu'za, kama vano nehuge'za zamavunte'za nenagaze.
Kefo zamavu'zmavama nehaza vahera ana zamavu'zmava zantera Anumzamoka zamahe kasopetro. Hanki krimpa ahezmantenka zamazeri fenkami atro.
Kagra nasunku'ma huazana kavuntenka nenagane. Zavi'ma atogeno'ma navunu'ma hia navunura tafempi afinte'nane. Magoke magoke zana avompi krente'nane.
Hagi nazama huogu'ma Kagritegama kezamati'nena, ha' vahe'nimo'za koro fregahaze. E'ina'ma hanage'na Anumzamoka nagri kaziga mani'nenka hara huzmantane hu'na ke'na antahi'na hugahue.
Anumzamo'ma Agrama huvempama hu'nantenegu nentahina agi'a ahentesga hugahue. Tamage Ra Anumzamokama huhampri nante'nana zanku kagia erisga hugahue.
Nagra Anumzamokare namentintia nehuanki, na'a hanige'na amne vahetfankura korora hugahue. Agra vahetfa mani'neanki na'a hunantegahie?
Nagra huvempama hu'noa kere amage ante'na, nazama nehana zantera susu hu'na ofa hugantegahue.
Na'ankure Kagra fri zampintira nagu'nevazinka, tanafa'ma hu'za nehugenka naza hu'nane. E'ina hu'nananki'na menina amne Anumzamoka kavuga vano nehu'na, vahe'moma asimu'ma erino nemania tavitera vano hugahue.

Kasunku hunanto Anumzamoka, kasunku hunanto! Na'ankure nagra kagripinka franekue. Kagri kagekonamofo turunapinka, fraki'na mani'nenugeno hazenke zamo'a nagateregahie.
Marerirfa Anumzamofontega nagra kezatigahue. Maka zama hugantegahuema nehia zama hunenantea Anumzamofontega kezanatigahue.
Agra monafinkati nazama hu'zana atresigeno eme nagura vazigahie. Nagofetu'ma zamagama re'za vonoma nehaza vahetmina, Agra zamazeri zamagaze hugahie. Anumzamo'a monafinkati vagaore avesizane, hugahuema hu'neaza huno navesinte vava hugahie.
Nagra vahe'ma amprizama nenaza laioniramimofo amu'nozmifi mani'noe. Zamave'mo'ma keve kna higeno zamagefu'namo'ma bainati kazinkno kna'ma hu'nea vahetmimofo amu'nompi mani'noe.
Anumzamoka monaramina agaterenka onagamu mani'nananki'za husga hugantegahaze. Hagi masazankamo'a maka ama mopafina remsa hanie.
Ha' vahe'nimo'za nahenaku krifu anagi ante'nazageno nagu'amo'a kna nehie. Hanki kama vu'na e'nama nehufina, keri kafinte'nazanagi, ana kerifina zamagra'a tamigahaze.
Anumzamoka nagu'areti hu'na nagra kagritera namentinti nehue. Nagra nagu'areti namentinti nehuanki'na zagamera hu'na kagia ahentesga hugahue.
Nagu'amoka otio. Hapu zavenane laeri zavenanena oti'o. Nagra zagame hu'na ko'matu'zana azeri otigahue.
Nagra maka kokankoka vahe'mokizmi zamavufina, susu hu'na kagia ahentesga hugahue. Maka vahe'mokizmi zamavufina zagamera hu'na Anumzamoka kagia ahentesga hugahue.
Anumzamoka vagaore kavesizamo'a, monagna huno amunagamu marenerigeno, hugahuema hu'nana kema amage antenka hu kavukava zamo'a amunagamu marerino hampona avako nehie.
Anumzamoka monaramina mani agaterenka onagamu mani'nanankino, vahe'mo'za husga hunegante'nageno masazanka'amo'a maka ama mopafina remsa hugahie.

Tamagra kva vahe'mota fatgo naneke keagafina nehazafi? Tamagra fatgo huta vahe'mokizmi naneke refko nehazo?
I'o, tamagu'afina kefozama hu antahintahi retro nehuta, ama mopafi vahera zamazeri haviza nehaze.
Kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za anama kasezmantetegati kana atre'za hazagre'naze. Zamagra nezamarera ku'afi mani'neza havigege hu'naze.
Nanekema hazazamo'a ha' osifavemofo avu'ataga zankna nehige'za, nanekema nehazazamo'a kobra osifavemo'ma hiaza hu'za kea nontahize.
Hagi zavenama aheno osifavema azeri oti vahe'mo'a, eri ruzahu ruzahu huno'ma zavenama ahesiana, ana osifavemo'a ontahigosie.
Anumzamoka zamagipima me'nea zamavera rutafri atro. Ra Anumzamoka ama ana laioniramimofo zamagemazampa rutavegri atro.
Zamatrege'za hagege mopafima tima tagiramino ome fananema hiaza hu'za fanene hiho. Zamatregeno zamazampima eri'naza kevemofo agonazmimo'a atupaseho.
Zamatrege'za koravemo'za hagage hazaza huge, osi mofavremo ana kasentegeno zage onkeneno friankna hiho.
Kavoramimo'ma tevere'ma me'neno amuhoma nehia kna'a agetereno, Anumzamo'a ame huno kasefa vahero, ozafa tavavaro, kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahera ruharafi hutregahie.
Anumzamofoma amage'ma nentaza vahe'ma, kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'zama zamazeri havizama nehaza zante'ma Anumzamo'za nonama huno zamahenige'za, kenu'za muse hugahaze. Anumzamofoma amage'ma nentaza vahe'mo'za kefo zamavu'zamava'ma nehaza vahe'mofo korampi zamagia sese hugahaze.
Ana hanige'za maka vahe'mo'za amanage hugahaze, tamage huno fatgo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmia mizazmia me'neankino, fatgo huno'ma ama mopafima vahe'ma refkoma nehia Anumzana mani'ne hu'za hugahaze.

Anumzamoka ha' vahe'nimofo zamazampintira nagu'vazio. Ha' vahe'nimo'zama ha' hunantenaku'ma neazana nahokenka navre frakio.
Kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmi zamazampintira nazeri vario. Vahe korama eri taginaku'ma, tusi'zama hu'za vanoma nehaza vahe'mokizmi zamazampintira nagu'vazio.
Hagi ko, zamagra nagri nahenaku kafona nentaze. Ra Anumzamoka nagra havizana hunozmante'na kumira osu'noanagi, hankavenentake ha' vahe'mo'za nahenaku antahintahia retro nehaze.
Nagra mago havizana osu'noanagi, ha' hunante'naku zamaga re'za ome retrotra nehaze. Otio! Otinka nagri'ma hunante'zama nehaza zana negenka naza huo.
Ra Anumzana Monafi sondia vahe'mokizmi Anumzamoka, Kagra Israeli vahe Anumza mani'nananki, otinka kokankoka vahe'mo'zama ha'ma hunante'zama nehaza vahera knazana zaminka zamazeri haviza huo. Kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'tmina, kasunkura huozamanto.
Ana maka kinaga e'za rankumamofona megi'a eme kagigagi nehu'za, kramo'ma nehiaza hu'za hauhau hu'za vano nehaze.
Knare osu nanekema zamagipinti'ma atineramiana ko. Zamagipinti'ma rukahama huneramia nanekemo'a, bainati kazi atiramiankna nehige'za amanage nehaze, Iza naneketia antahigahie hu'za nehaze.
Hianagi Ra Anumzamoka Kagra ana vahetmina zamagiza nerenka, kokankoka vahetamina kiza zokago ke hunezmantane.
Kagra nagri hankave mani'nananki'na, Kagri kavega mani'nenugenka, nagura vazigahane. Na'ankure Kagra Anumzamoka, nagrama frakisua hankave vihuni'a mani'nane.
Nagri Anumzamo'a vagaore avesizama'areti avesima nenantea ne'mo naza hugahie. Anumzamo'a naza hanige'na, ha' vaheni'a zamage fenkaminete'na zamagiza regahue.
Ra Anumzamoka zamahe ofrio. Na'ankure nagri vahe'mo'za ame'ama hu'za rempima huzmina zana zamagenekanize. Hanki hihamukanu zamahe arava hege'za zamarena reho. Ra Anumzamoka kagra tagri hanko mani'ne.
Hagi ana vahe'mo'za kumi'mo avite kege nehaze. Na'ankure ana vahe'mokizmi zamagipina kefo kemo avite'ne. Zamatregeno zamagri zamavufaga ra hu'zamo, zamazeri haviza hino. Na'ankure zamagra kazusi ke nehu'za, krunage nehaze.
Ra Anumzamoka karimpa ahe zamantenka zamahe fanane huo! Zamahe fanane huge'za magore hu'za omaniho. E'ina huge'za maka ama mopafi vahe'mo'za Anumzamo'a Jekopu naga Israeli vahera kegava huzmantene hu'za ke'za antahi'za hiho.
Ana maka kinaga ete e'za rankumamofona megi'a eme kagigagi nehu'za, kramo'ma nehiaza hu'za, hauhau hu'za vano nehaze.
Zamagra ne'zankura maka kaziga hake'za vano nehu'za, ne'zama nezamu'ma nosu'za hauhau hu'za vano nehaze.
Hianagi nagra hihamukagura zagamera hugahue. Maka nanterana vagaore kavesizankura zagamera hu'na kagia ahentesga hugahue. Na'ankure Kagra knazampima mani'nogenka, nagrira fraki kuma'ene naguvazi kuma'ene mani'nane.
Anumzamoka kagra hankavenia mani'nananki'na, Kagritega zagamera hu'na kagia ahentesga hugahue. Kagra fraki kumani'a mani'nanankinka, vagaore kavesizanka'aretima kavesima nenantana Anumza mani'nane.


Anumzamoka, Kagra ko tatrenka tazeri haviza hu'nane. Kagra krimpa aherantenka e'nananki, menina ete tazeri knare huo!
Kagra mopa eri tore hankeno, kekora reno vuno eno hu'neanki, ana kekokana renagro. Na'ankure mopamo'a zahufa kazara nehie.
Kagra vaheka'amofona rama'a knaza zaminka zamazeri amuho nehunka, hankave waini taminketa neteta neginagia hu'none.
Hianagi Kagri'ma koro'ma hugante'za, mono'ma hunegantaza vahera kevemo'ma zamavate'ma zamazeri zankura, mago avameza zami'nane.
Kagrama kavesima nezmantana vahera zamagu'vazio. Tamaga kazanu taguranevazinka, nunamuntia antahiraminka kenona huranto.
Ruotge hu'nea konarari'afi mani'neno, ama huvempa kea hu'ne. Nagra muse hu'na Sekemu kumara eri fako nehu'na, Sukoti agupomofo zaza'ane upa'anena mesarimi hu'na kegahue.
Giliati'ene Manase'enena nagri suza mani'na'e. Hanki Efraemi'a Nagri fetori manigeno, Juda'a kini azompani'a mani'ne.
Hianagi Moapu mopa tima nefroa zuompani'a me'nigeno, Edomu mopare nagia anona zafitregahue. Filistia vahera hara huzamagatere'na musena hugahue.
Hagi iza navareno hankavenentake vihuma me'nea rankumapina vugahie? Iza navareno Edomu moparera vugahie?
Anumzamoka Kagra tatrenka kamefira huneramino? Kagra ru'enena tagri sondia vahetaminena hatera ovugosano?
Taza hunka ha' vahetia hara huzmanto, na'ankure vahetfamo'za taza hugara osu'naze.
Anumzamofo hanavereti ha' vahetia hara huzmagateregahune. Agra ha' vahetia zamahetreteno, zamagofetu agia reno zamare hapatigahie.

Anumzamoka krafage'ni'a antahio! Nunamu ke'ni'a kagesa antenka antahio!
Nagu'amo'ma knama nehige'na, mopa atumparegati naza huogura Kagritega kezana netue. Hanki navrenka hanavenentake havere marerige'na nagu'vazi'neno.
Na'ankure Kagra fraki kuma'ni'a mani'nenka, vihuni'a mani'nanankino ha' vahe'nimo'za eme onahegahaze.
Natrege'na mono nonka'afi manivava hu'na va'neno. Natrege'na Kagri kagekonafinka fraki'na mani'neno.
Na'ankure huvempama hu'noana, Anumzamoka antahi'nane. Kagri kagigu'ma koro'ma hu'za mono'ma hugantesaza vahe'mo'za erisanti haregahaze hunkama ante'nana zana nagri nami'nane.
Kini ne'mofona mago'ene kafuzage'a erinte za'za huo. Vahe'ma forehu anante anante'ma huno'ma vania knafina, agra zazate ama mopafina manigahie.
Agra Anumzamofo avuga kini manivava huno vugahie. Hagi vagaore kavesi zamo'ene hugahuema hu'nana zama hu kavukva zamo'a, kegava huntesie.
Ana'ma hananke'na knane knanena kagia ahentesga huvava hugahue hu'nama huvempama hu'noa kante antena, zagamera hu'na kagia ahentesga hugahue.

Anumzamo'ma nazama hanigu akohe'na avegante'na mani'noe. Na'ankure Agrake nagura nevazie.
Agrake'za fraki haveni'a mani'neno, nagura nevazie. Agra fraki kumani'a mani'neankina, antria hu'na korora osugahue.
Hago zazate ana maka vahe'mota magoke nera hara renteta aze. Ana maka'moza nahenaku nenavararize. Zamagrama nagazana nagra fraguvazirami have keginagna huge, kuraramperami keginagna hu'noe.
Nagrama ra nagima eri'na mani'noa zana, nazeri fenkami atrenaku, keaga retro nehaze. Havigema hu'za nagri'ma nazeri havizama hu'nakura tusi muse nehaze. Navurera husga hunenantazanagi, zamagu'afina antahi haviza hunenantaze.
Anumzamoka Kagrikuke nagra akohe'na kavega ante'na mani'noe. Nagra Kagripi amuha zani'a ante'noe.
Agrake'zage framaki hanave havenia mani'neankino, kegava hunenanteno nagu'nevazie. Agra fraki kumani'a mani'neankina, antria hu'na korora osugahue.
Anumzamoke nagura nevazino, ra nagia nenamie. Anumzamoke havegani'ane, fraki kumani'anena mani'ne.
Vahe'nimota Agriteke maka kna tamentintia hiho. Maka tamagu'a Agriteke anteho, na'ankure Agra fraki kumati mani'ne.
Agima me'nea vahetetima vuno agima omane vahetema vu'neana, mago asimu'ma hutreankna hu'nazankiza, zamagra amne'za Agri avufina mani'naze. Hanki zamagra'a knama sigelire'ma erinte'zama kesazana, knazmimo'a zahomofo kna'a agateore'ne.
Vahe'ma knama amino azeri havizama hu'zamo naza hugahie hunka kamentintina huge, musufamase avu'avazamo naza hugahie hunka amuhara huge, fenozanka'amo'ma ome rama huno nevanigenka, ana zamo'a naza hugahie hunka amuhara osuo.
Anumzamo'ma magoke kema nehige'na, tare zanku nagesa nentahue. Hihamu hankaveane Anumza mani'nane.
Vagaore kavesizana, Ra Anumzamoka Kagri suzane. Tamage hunka maka vahera refko huzmantenka nazanoma hu'nenarera nona hunka mizana zamigahane.

Anumzamoka Kagra nagri Anumza mani'nanke'na, Kagrikura tusiza hu'na nehakroe. Nagu'amo'a tinku'ma hiaza huno, Kagrikura navenesigeno, tima omne hagage kokampina navufgamo'a Kagrikura tusiza nehie.
Hagi Anumzamoka mono nonka'afina negage'na hihamukane, masaka'anena ke'noe.
Na'ankure vagaore kavesi zamo'a asimu'ma erino mani'zana agatere'neanki'na, kagi'a erisga huvava hugahue.
Nasimu'ma erina mani'na vanua knafina, kagi'a ahentesga nehu'na, nazana erisga hu'nena Kagritega nunamuna hugahue.
Knare ne'zama naminke'na nenamura nehuankina, muse zagame hu'na husga hugantegahue.
Hanki tafenire'ma masenena, kagrikura nagesa nentahi'na, ana kenagera nunamuna nehu'na, nagesa antahigami'noe.
Na'ankure Kagra nazahu ne' mani'nananki'na, nagra Kagri kagekonamofo turunapinka mani'nena muse zagamera hugahue.
Anumzamoka nagu'amo'a Kagrite tragoteno me'negenka, tamaga kazanu nazeri antrako nehane.
Hianagi nagri'ma nahenaku'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za haviza hugahaze. Zamagra friza fri vahe'mofo kumapi amefenkame mopa agu'a uramigahaze.
Bainati kazinknonu zamahe vagaresigeno, afi kramo'za zamavufaga'a traga hu'za negahaze.
Hianagi kini ne'mo'na Anumzamokagu musena hugahue. Anumzamofonte'ma zamentintima nehaza vahe'mo'za, Anumzamofona agia erisga nehanageno, havigema nehaza vahe'mo'za kea osugahaze.

Anumzamoka narimpa havizama hu'zama huama'ma hanuana antahi nenaminka, ha' vahe'mo'za nazeri koro ke nehu'za, nahe'za nehazanki kegava hunanto.
Kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za nahenaku nanekea oku'a retro nehazanki, nazeri franekinka, ranke rankema nehaza kefo vahe'mokizmi zamavureti nazeri frakio.
Zamagra ana vahe'mo'za bainati kazin kume'ma kaneaza hu'za, zamagefu'na kumera negane'za, nanekema hazana, kefo nanekezmimo'a kevema ahetrazaza nehaze.
Ana vahe'mo'za kafoma ante'nazafinti kezmima omane vahera kevea nezmahe'za, antri hazaza hu'za korora osu tusiza hu'za hara hunezmantaze.
Zamagra kefo avu'avazama hunakura kea huganti hugama hu'za zamazeri hankaveneti'za, vahe krifuma anagintesagura oku'a keaga retro nehaze. Ana nehu'za mago vahe'mo'a onketfa hugahie hu'za nehaze.
Hazenkema hu' kema retroma nehu'za amanage nehaze, knare antahintahirafa retro hune hu'za nehaze. Vahe'mofo agu'afine antahintahifina vahe'ma revatga huzamoke avite'neankinka keamara osutfa hugahane.
Hianagi Anumzamo'a Agra kevea zamahe'nige'za, ame hu'za hazenkea erigahaze.
Zamagri zamagefu'namo zamazeri haviza hanige'za, zamagesaza vahe'mo'za zamagena neru'za, kiza zokago kea huzmantegahaze.
Ana hanige'za maka vahe'mo'za koro nehu'za, Anumzamo'ma kaguvazama hia zankura huama nehu'za, maka avu'avazama eri fore'ma hia zamofonkura antahintahia huvava hugahaze.
Anumzamofoma amage'ma nentaza vahe'mo'za Ra Anumzamofonkura muse nehu'za, Agri turunapinka manigahaze. Ana nehanage'za fatgo zamavuzmava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za, muse nehu'za agi'a ahentesga hugahaze.

Anumzamoka Saioni kumapi rankagia kamigahaze. Na'ano hugantegahune hutama ko'ma huvempama hu'nenuna zana tagra hugahune
Na'ankure Kagra nunamuntia nentahine. Maka vahera Kagriteke egahune.
Tagrama kumitigu'ma antahintahi hakarema nehunkenka, Kagra ana kumitia apaserante'nane.
Kagrama huhamprintankeno, ruotge kuma tava'onte'ma nemanimo'a rama'a asomu erigahie. Kagri mono nompinka rama'a knare zane musezamo'enena avite'ne.
Anumzamoka knarezantfa huno mareri agatere'nea fatgo kavukva hunka nunamuntia antahinka nona hunerantane. Anumzamoka Kagra tagu'vazi ne' mani'nane. Ama mopafi vahe'mo'za Kagrite zamentintia nehazageno, hagerimpima afetema nemaniza vahe'mo'zanena kagrite zamentintia nehaze.
Kagra hihamukareti agonaramina trohunentenka, hanaveka'a eri ama hu'nane.
Hagerimo'ma krantokrantoma nehigenka, Kagra azeri arava nehenka, kokankoka mopafi vahe'mo'zama rankerankema nehazagenka, zamazeri neraganane.
Mopa atumparegama nemaniza vahe'mo'za ruzahu ruzahu kaguva zantamima erifore'ma hana zankura, ama zana, naza fore nehie hu'za nehu'za, tusi zamagogogu nehaze. Zage hanati kazigati vuno zage fre kazigama umani emanima nehaza vahe'mo'za Kagrama hana kavukvamo zamagu'a zamazeri otige'za tusi muse nehaze.
Kagra mopa kegava hunenka tina aminkeno mopamo'a knare huno masavena nehie. Anumzamoka maka kaziga tina tro hunte'nanankino, knare huno witia tina amigeno, rama'a raga renente. Na'ankure Kagraka'a e'inahu huno fore hugahie hunka retro hunte'nana kante anteno efore nehie.
Hozama rekorinte mopafina Kagra kora atrankeno runteno mopa ru fru nehuno, mopa ragana runezmane. Ana nehunka ata kora atrankeno hozafina runtegeno ne'zamo'a knarera huno nehageno rama'a ne'zana renente.
Kagra mago kafufina asomu hurantankeno, ne'zamo'a tusi'za huno amponere. Ana nehigeno kama vanoma hupinena nezamo'a aviteno herafineramie.
Hanki ka'ma kokampina trazamo'a hageno tretre nehigeno, agonaramimpina trazamo'a tretre huno refitegeno musena nehaze.
Hanki krahopina sipisipi afutamine, meme afutamimo'za avitazageno, agupofina witi hozamo'a fankanino kankmuna omnetfa hu'ne. Ana maka trazama nenaza afu'mozane hozamozanena ranke hu'za zagamera hu'za musena nehaze.
Maka ama mopafima nemaniza vahe'mota, ranke huta zagamera huta Anumzamofona agi'a ahentesga hiho!
Anumzana Agri agimofo hihamu hanave'agura zagamera huta agi'a ahentesga hiho. Zgame huta Agri hihamu masazama'agura erinte ama hiho!
Anumzamofonkura, kavukva zamo'a knare zantfa huno mareri agatere'ne hiho. Ha' vahekamo'za Kagri hihamu hankavegura koro hu'za zamavufaga eri anaki'za Kagritega neaze.
Maka ama mopafima me'nea zantamimo'za monora hunegante'za, zagamera hu'za kagia ahentsga hugahaze. Zgamera hu'za rankagia ahentesga hugahaze.
Eta tagri Anumzamo'ma hu'nea zana eme keho. Agra knarezantfa huno mareri agatere'nea avu'avaza, maka vahe'mofontera eri fore hu'ne.
Hagerina eripapa hugantigama huno kana erifore hige'za, Agri vahe'mo'za hagege mopafi rugitagi'za kantukaziga vu'naze. Hanki Agriku musena hanune.
Agra kinia mani'neno tusi'a hihamu'areti kegava huvava hugahie. Agra kokankoka vahera maka kna avua anteno nezmageanki, ke ontahi vahe'mo'za hara reonteho.
Maka ama mopafi vahe'mota Anumzamofona husga hunteho. Ranke huta agia ahentesga nehinke'za vahe'mo'za antahiho.
Tagrama fri'zankura kegava huneranteno, tatregeta regaririta trakara nosune.
Anumzantimoka rerahenka knazana neraminka, silvama tevefi kreno eri agru hiaza hunka tazeri agru hane.
Kagra kuko atrenka tazeritenka, tagumpina tusi'a knaza eri kofirantane.
Ana nehunka tatrankeno tasenia refrage mafrage hu'za karisia eri'za vano hu'naze. Tevefine timpinena ufre'nonanagi, ete Kagra tavrenka anketa maka'zama ampore'nea mopafi one.
Nagra tevefi kre fanane hu ofa mono nonka'afi eme hugantegahue. Nagrama huvempama hu'noa zantera ofa hugahue.
Nagra ra hazenkefi mani'nena, huvempa hu'noe.
E'ina agafare tevefima kre fanene hu ofa Kagritega hugahue. Nagra so'ema hu'nenia agonknaza ohari ve sipisipi afu kresramna vanugeno knare mna nevina, Nagra ve bulimakao afu'ene meme afu'enena Kagritega kresrama vanugeno, knare mna marerigahie.
Anumzamofoma koro'ma hunentaza vahe'mota, eta eme nentahinke'na Anumzamo'ma hunante'nea zana tamasmi'neno.
Nazama hinogura Agritega krafa nehu'na, nanekema hufina agi'a erisga huvava nehue.
Nagrama kumini'ama huama'ma osuresina, Ra Anumzamo'a nunamunkeni'a ontahisine.
Hianagi Anumzamo'a nunamuni'a nentahie. Nunamunkeni'a agesa anteno nentahie.
Anumzamo'a ra agi erisie. Agra nunamuni'a antahi amnea nosuno vaga ore avesizama'a nagritetira eri notre.

Anumzamoka kasunku hurantenka asomura hunerantenka, kavugosa rukrahe huramigeno kavugosafinti masamo'a remsa huranteno taza hino.
E'ina hanankeno Kagri kavukva zana ama mopafi vahe'mo'za ke'za antahi'za nehanageno, tagu'ma vazi'nana hihamu hankaveka'a kokankoka vahe'mo'za ke'za antahi'za hugahaze.
Anumzamoka, vahe'mo'za kagia ahentesga hugahaze. Tamage maka kokankoka vahe'mo'za zagamera hu'za kagia ahentesga hugahaze.
Ana maka vahe'ma ama mopafima nemaniza vahe'mo'za musena nehu'za, zagamera hu'za kagia ahentsga hugahaze. Na'ankure Kagra mago avamenteke fatgo hunka vahera refko henezmantenka, kokankoka vahera antahintahia zaminka zamazeri fatgo nehane.
Maka vahe'mo'za zagamera hu'za Ra Anumzamoka kagia erisga hugahaze. Ana maka vahe'mo'za kagia erisga hugahaze.
Ana hanageno ama mopafina ne'zamo'a amporegahie. Anumzana tagri Anumzamo'a rama'a zampi asomura hunerante.
Anumzamo'a asomu hurantesie! E'ina'ma hanigeno'a ana maka vahe'ma ama mopafima mani'naza vahe'mo'za Anumzamofona korora huntesaze.

Anumzamo'a otino ha' vahe'aramina zamahe panani hanie! Agri'ma avesrama hunentaza atre'za koro fregahaze.
Zamahe panani huge'za zahomo tevegu eri amne huno vuno eno nehiaza hu'za freho. Fukimo tevemofo tava'onte me'neno temramra hiaza hu'za, kefo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mo'za Anumzamofo avuga haviza hu'za fanene hugahaze!
Hianagi fatgo zamavu'zamava'ma nehu'za Anumzamofo amage'ma nentaza vahe'mo'za muse hiho. Anumzamofo vahe'mo'za agri avuga musena nehanageno, musezamo'a zamagripina avitegahie.
Anumzamofona zagamera huta agi'a ahentesga hiho. Hampo agofetu'ma manino vanoma nehia nera husga hunteho. Agi'a Ra Anumzanki, Agri avuga musena hiho.
Agra megusa mofavre'ramimofo nezmafa mani'ne. Agra ruotge hu'nea kuma'afi mani'neno, kento a'neramina zmahonekea Anumza mani'ne.
Hagi agraku'ma nemania vahera Anumzamo'a naga'afi avrentegeno muse huno nemanigeno, kinama hu'zama mani'naza vahera kinafintira zamavare fegi atrege'za musena hu'za knare nomani'zana nemanize. Hianagi Agri'ma ha'ma renentaza vahera, hagege hu'nea mopafi zamantege'za nemanize.
Anumzamoka vaheka'ama Isipiti'ma zamavare atineraminka kagia kazana ometre eme atre hunka masi hunka hagege kokampima vugota hunka nevankeno,
mopamo'a momi'momi huno tore'vare hu'ne. Anama hu'neana Anumzamoka kavuga, Sainai agonamofo Anumzane, Israeli vahe Anumzamoka kavuga anara hu'ne.
Kagri vahe'mo'zama erisantiharesaze hunkama hagege mopama zami'nana mopafina, rama'a ko atrankeno, kora aru kasri kasri huno maka zana azeri kasefa hu'ne.
Ana mopafi na Kagri vahera mani'nazagenka, ne'zana eri amporenampinti zamunte omne vahera ne'zana Anumzamoka zami'nane.
Ra Anumzamo'ma vahe'mokizmima nanekema zamasamigeno, rama'a a'neramimo'za ana nanekea eri'za vu'za ome huama hu'naze.
Hagi Kini vahe'mo'zane sondia vahe'mo'zanena maka zana atre'za fre'naze. Zamagra makazana atre'za frazage'za Israeli a'neramimo'za fenozmia refko hu'za eri'naze.
Hagi zamagra sipisipi afu kevufima nemasageno, maho namamofo agekonare silvanu rekamarenteankna nehuno, azokate golinu rekamrenteankna huno refitegahie.
Hankavenentake Anumzamo'ma ana mopafima nemaniza kini vahe'ma zamahe panani'ma hu'neana, Zalmoni agonafi ko'mopa ko tamiankna huno zamahe panani hu'ne.
Basani agonaramina tusinasi agonarami me'ne. Basania rama'a agonaramina amunagamu mareri'nea agonarami me'naze.
Rama'a agona morusama me'nea agonamoka, nagafare Saioni agonare'ma Anumzamo'ma manigahue hu'noma hu'nea agonagura, kegasanea nehane? Tamagerfa huno Ra Anumzamo'a ana agonare manivava huno vugahie.
Ohampriga'a karisiramimo'za Ra Anumzamofona azeri kaginte'nazageno, Saioni agonaretira eno ruotgema hu'nea mono noma'afinka emareri'ne.
Hanki mareri agatere'nea agonafima marenerinka kina vahetmina zamavarenka marerinke'za, ke ontahi vahe'mo'zane ha'ma renegantaza vahe'mo'zanena musezana negamize. Menina Ra Anumzamo'a tagrane ama agonafina manigahie hu'za nehaze.
Ra Anumzana tagu'vazi Anumzamofona husga hunteho! Na'ankure maka knafina knazantia Agra e'nerie.
Tagri Anumzana Agra tagu'ma nevazia Anumza mani'ne. Mareri agatere'nea Ra Anumzamo frizampintira tagura nevazie.
Hianagi Anumzamo'a ha' vahe'aramina zamaseni rurako huno nezmaheno, ke ontahi kefo zamavu'zmava zanku'ma zmavesinente'za ana zamavu'zmavama nevaririza vahera Anumzamo'a zamaseni zaferina rufuzafupegahie.
Ra Anumzamo'a huno, ha' vahera Basanitira zamavare'na egahue. Amefenkame hageri agu'atira zamavare'na marerigahue.
Ana hanugeta nagri vahe'mota zamagri korampi tamagia sese nehanageno, kraramimo'zanena ana korana negahaze.
Anumzamoka Kagri nagara rama'amo'za erimpi hu'za neazage'za vahe'mo'za nezamagaze. Nagri Anumzana kini'nimoka naga'mo'za mono nompi erimpi hu'za unefraze.
Zgame'ma hu' vahe'mo'za vugota hazageno, zamefira ruzahu ruzahu zavenama ahe vahetami vazageno, amu'nompina mofa'nemo'za nevu'za nase'nasepana nehaze.
Maka Israeli vahe'ma atruma hanafina zagame huta Anumzamofona agi'a hentesga hiho. Israeli vahe'ma zamasimu'ma nezmia Ra Anumzana Zgame huta agi'a husga hunteho.
Osi nagara Benzameni naga'mo'za egote'za azageno, rama'a kva vahetmina Juda nagapinti azageno, maka Zebuluni nagapinti'ene Naftali nagapinti maka kva vahetmina e'naze.
Anumzamoka hihamuka'a eriama huo. Anumzamoka korapa'ma hu'nanaza hunka hankaveka'a eriama huo.
Ama mopafi kini vahe'mo'za musezana eri'za mono nonka'afi Jerusalemi egahaze.
Kokankokama ha' vahetamima mani'naza vahetamina zamazeri korio. Varoza trazampima afi zagama mani'naza zagaramina zamazeri korio. Bulimakao afutmima hankavezmi omne bulimakao anenta taminema mani'nazana zamazeri korio. Zamazeri arava hege'za silvane golinena eri'za takisia eme kamiho. Hanki ha'ma hu'zanku'ma musema nehaza vahetmina, zamahe panani huge'za freho.
Isipi vahe'mo'za zago'amo'ma marerirfa haveramina eri'za musezana eme negamisageno, Itiopia vahe'mo'za eme kepri hu'za monora hugantegahaze.
Ama mopafima kini vahe'mo'zama kegavama hu'naza kumatamimpima nemaniza vahe'mota, Ra Anumzamofona zagamera huta agia ahentesga hiho.
Korapa'ma me'nea hampomofo agofetu'ma manino'ma harenoma enevia nera zagamera huta agia erisga hiho. Kema nehigeno'a, agerumo'a monagemo'ma hiaza nehie.
Anumzamofo hihamu hankavemofo agi agenkea, huama hunka vahera zamasamio. Agri konarari masa'amo'a Israeli vahera remsa hunezmantegeno, anami monafina hankave'amo'a avite'ne.
Anumzamo'a mono noma'afina knare'zanfta huno mareri agatereno mani'ne. Israeli vahe Anumzamo Agra'a vahera hihamu hankavea nezmiankino, Agrake'za ragia erisie!

Anumzamoka nagu'vazio! Na'ankure timo'a ti hageno nazeri nakrinaku nanankente ne-e.
Hapapi hampakanena amefenkame supa'nena uneramue. Hankave moparera nagia noroe. Timu'nompi nevugeno timo'a nazeri nakari'za nehie.
Anumzamoka nazama huogu'ma kavegama ante'nena krafagema nehua zamo'a hanaveni'a omanegeno, navurgamo'a nata negrigeno, nanankemo'a tusiza huno hagege nehie
Mago haviza osu'nore'ma zamavaresrama hunenantaza vahe'mo'za nanumpima me'nea nazokara agatere'za rama'a vahe mani'naze. Anumzamoka hankavenentake ha' vahe'mo'za havige hu'za nahe fri'za nehaze. Havige hu'za e'ori'noa zankura musufa se'nananki tamio hu'za nehaze.
Anumzamoka Kagra neginagi navu'nava zani'a kenka antahinka hu'nanankino, maka kumini'amo'a Kagri kavurera frara okigahie.
Ra Anumzamoka kagrite'ma zamentintima nehaza vahera, nagrama hanua navu'navazamo'a zamazeri zamagazea osino. Monafi sondia vahe'mofo Ra Anumzamoka nagrama hanua navu'nava zantera zamazeri fenkamia ozmatro. Kagra Israeli vahe Anumza mani'nane.
Na'ankure nagra Kagri kamagema antoa zanku kiza zokago kea hunenantazage'na nagazegura nehue. Ana nehugeno nazeri havizama nehaza zamo'a tusiza huno nazeri nagaze nehie.
Nafuhemo'zama nenage'za keno antahino'ma osu'nea vahe'ma agatereankna nehaze. Hagi nenrera mofavremo'za rurega vahe'ma huntazankna zamavu'zamava hunenantaze.
Mono nonka'agu'ma navesintoa zamo'a nagu'afina tevema reankna nehigeno, Kagri'ma kazeri havizama hu kema nehaza vahe'mo'za nagri'enena nazeri haviza hu naneke nehaze.
Hanki zavi'ma nete'na kave'ma a'o'ma hu'na nunanuma nehuge'za vahe'mo'za, nazeri haviza hu ke nehaze.
Nasunku'ma nehu'na nasunku kukenama huazankura, zamagra hunte'za kiza zokago ke hazage'na nagra zamagri zamavurera kiza zokago zankna hue.
Hanki rankuma kafante'ma nemaniza kva vahe'mo'za nagenke nehazageno, akatima nene'za neginagima nehaza vahe'mo'za nazeri haviza hu zagame asunenantaze.
Hianagi menina kna fatgo'are nunamuna nehuanki Anumzamoka vagaore kavesi zanteti kavesinantenka nona hunantenka tamage hunka nagu'vazio.
Anumzamoka hapapintira navresga hunka nagu'vazio. Hanki natrege'na hapapina hampakanena uofra'neno. Zamavresrama hunenantaza vahe'mokizmi zamazampintira nagu nevazinka, tirupintira navazuhuti atro.
Anumzamoka natregeno tima hageno esiantimo'a eme narefi otege, tirumo'a nazeri onakrige, fri vahe kerimo'a nasgahu onakrino.
Ra Anumzamoka nunamuni'a antahinaminka nona hunanto, na'ankure vagaore kavesizamo'a knarezantfa hu'ne.
Anumzamoka eri'za vahekamo'na kamefira huonaminka, ame hunka nunamu keni'a antahinka nona hunanto. Na'ankure ra hazenkefi mani'noe!
Anumzamoka erava'o hunka nahokenka nagu'vazio. Ha' vahe'ni'amofo zamazampintira ete nagu'vazinka navro.
Ha' vahe'nimo'zama nazeri nagaze nehu'za, hu haviza hunenante'za, nagima eri havizama nehaza zana Kagra ko kenka antahinka hu'nane.
Kema nenasuza nazeri havizama haza zamo'a, tumoni'a netanege'na kria enerue. Hagi zamasunku hunantegahazafi hu'nama hua vahe'mo'za zamasunkura hunonantaze.
Hagi ne'zama namigazana netre'za, vahe'ma ahe nefriaza avu'atgaza nezampina ante'za nenami'za, tinku'ma navenesige'za tima namigazana atre'za, aka waini nami'naze.
Atregeno rama'a ne'zama retro hunte'za nenaza zamo'a, kukonkna huno zamazeri haviza nehina, maka zampima knare'ma hu'za nemaniza nomanizamo'a krifugna huno zamazeri haviza hino.
Atregeno zamavumo'a asu nehinke'za, zamavua onkeho. Ana nehunka zamatregeno zamavufagafina hanavezmia omne amne nehina, hanavezmia atreme vu'za ome haviza hiho.
Kagra karimpa ahe'zamantenka zamazeri haviza nehunka, tusi'a kasivazi nezmantenka zamahe hana huo.
Nonkumazmimo'a haviza nehinkeno, nevasaza seli nozmimo'a vahera omaninigeno zutesie.
Na'ankure Kagrama knama zaminka zamazeri havizama hana vahera zamahe'za zamasu'za nehu'za, zamazeri havizama nehanke'za zamatagu'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmia ki'za zokago ke hunezmantazageno mago'ane zamatagura nehaze.
Kumi'zmia erinte agofetu agofetu nehunka, ana kumizmia apasezmantenka zamagura ovazio.
Asimu eri avontafepima zamagima me'neana renehaganenka, fatgo avu'ava'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmi zamagima krentesampina zamagia kreonto.
Anumzamoka knazampi mani'nena natagu nehuanki, vahe'ma zamagu'ma nevazina hihamuka'anu nagu'vazio.
E'inama hananke'na zagame hu'na kagia ahentesga nehu'na, susu hugante'na husga hugantegahue.
Na'ankure e'i ana'ma hanua zamo'a bulimakao afu'ma aheno kresramna vuge, maka pazive'ene agigo azankonema me'nenigeno kresramna vanigeno Ra Anumzamo'ma musema hu'zana agatere'ne.
Zamavufama anterami'za nemaniza vahe'mo'za Anumzamo'ma eri'zama erisia zana nege'za, musena hugahaze. Anumzamofonku'ma nehake'za nunamuma hunentaza vahe'mo'za hankavea erigahaze.
Na'ankure Ra Anumzamo'a maka zanku'ma upama nehaza vahe'mokizmi krafagea nentahino, Agri naga'ma zamavare'za kinama ome huzmante'naza vahera ozmatregahie.
Maka monamotane, ama mopamokanena Ra Anumzamofona agia ahentesga nehinkeno, hagerine maka ana hageri agu'afima nemaniza zagamotanena zagamera huta agia ahentesga hiho.
Na'ankure Anumzamo'a Jerusalemi kumara agu'nevazino, Juda rankumatamina eri fatgo huno kigahie. Ana hanige'za Agri vahe'mo'za anampi mani'ne'za zamagra mopazmia erisanti haregahaze.
Eri'za vahe'amofo nezmagehoza erisanti hare'za nemanisage'za, agri'ma amagema nentaza vahe'mo'za anampina manigahaze.

Muse hugantoanki Anumzamoka nagu'vazio! Ra Anumzamoka ame hunka enka eme nazahuo.
Nahenaku'ma nehaza vahera zamazeri fenkami netrenka, zamazeri zamagaze huo. Hagi hazenkefima mani'noge'zama musema nehaza vahera zamazeri rukrahe huge'za zamagazegu nehu'za viho.
Oho! Meni keta eri fore hu'ne hu'zama nagriku'ma nehaza vahetmina, zamazeri zamagaze huge'za zamagazegu hiho.
Hianagi Kagriku'ma nehakaza vahe'mokizmia, tusi'a muse'za ante avite'zmantesane. Zamagu'ma vazi'nana zanku'ma zamave'nesia vahe'mo'za Anumzana marerirfa Anumza mani'ne hu'za ranke hu'za kagia ahentesga huvava hanaze!
Hianagi nagra namunte omne maka zankura upa nehua ne' mani'noe. Hanki Anumzamoka muse hugantoanki, ame hunka eme naza huo. Kagrake'za naza hunka naguvazi' nera mani'nananki, Ra Anumzamoka ame hunka eme nazahuo.
Ra Anumzamoka kegava hunantogu Kagritega neoanki, natrege'za ha' vahenimo'za nazeri nagazea osiho.
Nahokenka nagu'vazio, na'ankure Kagra fatgo avu'ava zanke nehana Anumza mani'nane. Kagesa antenka krafageni'a nentahinka nagu'vazio.
Hanavenentake havegani'a mani'nege'na anampinka fre'na maka kna ome frakineno. Kagra huzmantege'za nagura vaziho. Na'ankure Kagra nagu'vazi havegani'ane vihuni'ane mani'nane.
Kefo zamavu'zmava'ma nehaza vahe'mokizmi zamazampinti'ene, vahe'ma zamazeri havizama nehaza vahe'mokizmi zamazampintira nagu'vazio.
Na'ankure Ra Anumzamoka kagrake'za nagri amuha zani'a mani'nane. Mofavrema mani'nena agafa hu'na kagritera namentintia hu'noe.
Kasema nanteneregati kagrake'za naza hankena mani'na e'noe. Kagra nenarera arimpafintira navre atirami'nane. E'ina agafare zagamera hu'na Kagri kagia ahentesga huvava hugahue.
Maka zama nagri mani'zampima fore'ma nehia zana, rama'a vahe'mo'za ke'za antahi'za nehu'za rempi nehaze. Na'ankure kagra hanaveni'a mani'nenka, kegava hunenantane.
E'ina agafare tagane'na omani zagamera hu'na kagi'a ahentesga huvava hugahue. Ana nehu'na maka kna kagri hihamu masakagura huama hugahue.
Hanki ozafama renugenka Anumzamoka onatro. Hankaveni'ama omanenigenka kamefira huonamio.
Na'ankure ha' vahe'nimo'za nazeri haviza hu naneke nehu'za, nahe frinaku oku'a nanekea retro nehaze.
Zamagra amanage nehaze, Anumzamo'a amefi humianki, avaririta ome azerisune. Na'ankure mago vahe'mo'a ahora okegosie hu'za nehaze.
Anumzamoka nagrira natrenka afetera omanio. Anumzani'amoka ame hunka enka eme naza huo.
Havigema hunante'za nazeri havizama nehaza vahe'mokizmia, zamazeri zamagaze nehunka zamazeri haviza huo. Hanki hazenkema naminaku'ma nehaza vahera zamazeri fenkami netrenka, zamazeri zamagaze huo.
Hianagi nagra kagrite amuhara huvava nehu'na, zagamera hu'na mago'ene kagia ahentesga huvava hugahue.
Fatgo kavukava zanka'agura nagra huama nehu'na, vahe'ma agu'ma nevazina zankura maka zupa huama hugahue. Na'ankure kagra tagu'ma vazi'nanana ra zankrefa tro hu'nanankina, nagra ke'na antahina hugara osu'noe.
Ra Anumzamoka hanavenentake eri'zama eri'nana zankura nagra husga hugantegahue. Kagra maka'zama kegava hu'nana Anumzana mani'nanankina, fatgo kavukava'ene Anumza kagrake mani'nane hu'na mika vahera zamasmigahue.
Anumzamoka mofavrema mani'noretima agafa huno amare'ma eana, Kagra rempi hunaminka neanke'na hentofazama hu'nea kavukva zanka'agura huama hu'na vahera zamasami vava nehue.
Ozafama resugeno efe nazoka'ma tagisiana, Anumzamoka onatrenka naza huge'na mani'nena, hihamu hankaveka'ane, ranra kaguvazama erifore'ma hu'nana zantminkura, menima fore'ma nehaza vahera zamasmi'neno.
Anumzamoka fatgo kavukva zankamo'a mona agatereno ame'anagema mareri'ne. Kagra ruzahu ruzahu kaguva zanke erifore hu'nane. Anumzamoka kagri kna vahera ama mopafina omani'ne.
Kagra antahinenka natranke'na hazenkefine knazampinena unefroe. Hianagi kagra nazeri knare nehunka, amefenkame mopa agu'ama mani'nofintira ete navre atiramigahane.
Navresga hunka ra nagi nenaminka, mago'ane nazeri knare hunanto.
Hapu zavena ahena kagia ahentesga hugahue. Na'ankure kagra huvempama hu'nana keka'are amage ante Anumzani'a mani'nane. Israeli vahete'ma Ruotge'ma hu'nana Anumzamoka, nagra laeri zavena nehe'na zagamera hu'na kagia ahentesga hugahue.
Nagra ranke hu'na muse zagamera nehu'na, Kagia ahentesga hugahue. Na'ankure kagra nagu'vazinka ete navre'nane.
Hagi fatgo kavukva zanka'agura maka kna huama hu'na vahera zamasami vava hugahie. Na'ankure nazeri havizama hunaku'ma nehaza vahera zamazeri fenkami netrenka zamazeri zamagaze hu'nane.
Anumzamoka fatgoma huno refkoma hu' avu'ava zana kini nera neminka, fatgo kavukva zanka'a kini ne'mofo nemofona amio.
Fatgo avu'ava huno vaheka'a refko hunezmanteno, zamunte omne vahera fatgo avu'ava hunezmanteno kegava huzmantesie.
Ranra agonaramimo'za knare huno manifru hu nomani'za avre'za vahetera ne-enageno, neone agonaramimo'za fatgo avu'ava zamofona nena raga'a rentegahaze.
Zamunte omane vahera zamahonekeno, maka zanku'ma upa'ma nehaza vahe'mokizimi mofavreramina zamagu nevazino, vahe'ma ha'ma renezmantaza vahera zamazeri haviza hugahie.
Zagema reno nevanigeno ikamo'ma remsa nehanire, fore'ma hu anante anante'ma hu'za vanaza vahe'mo'za korora hunegante'za monora hugante vava hu'za vanaze.
Hagi kini ne'mo'ma vahe'ma kegavama hania avu'ava zamo'a, menima apri'nea apepate'ma ko'ma runteankna nehuno, mopafima atako'ma runteankna hugahie.
Kini ne'mo'ma kegavama hania kna'afina, Anumzamofoma amage'manentaza vahe'mo'za mani'za zmifina knare hu'za hagegahaze. Ikamo'ma remsama nehanifima maka'zama hanaza zamo'a, knare zanke huno tretre hanie.
Hagi mago hagerinteti'ma vuno mago hagerintema vanigeno, Yufretisi tinteti'ma vuno, mopa atumparegama vuno e'noma haniana, ana kini ne'mo miko vahera kegava hanie.
Hanki hagage kokampima nemaniza vahe'mo'za agrite zmarena emere'za kepri nehanageno, ha' vahe'aramimo'za zamavugosaregati avuga masene'za kugusopa negahaze.
Hanki Tasisi kumate kini vahe'mo'zane, hageri amu'nompima nemaniza vahe'mo'zanena takisi zagoa eri'za kini nera eme amigahaze. Ana nehanageno Seba kumate kini ne, Seba'enena ana hu'za musezana eri'za kini nera eme amigahaze.
Maka kini vahe'mo'za agrite kepri hunentesageno, maka kokankoka vahe'mo'za agri eri'za erintegahaze.
Na'ankure zamunte omne vahe'mo'zama krafagema nehanageno'a, agra antahizmino zamagu vazigahie. Vahe'mo'za zamazeri havizama nehazage'zama, vahe'mo'zama zamazama nosaza vahera, agra zamaza hugahie.
Zamunte omne vaheku'ene maka zanku'ma upama nehaza vahekura agra asunku hunezmanteno zamagu' vazi'nige'za ofrigahaze.

Hianagi Anumzamo'a Agra'a vahetmina sipisipi afutmima vugoteno avreno'ma viankna huno hagege kokampina kegve huzmante so'e huno zamavareno vu'ne.
